## `src/se3/server/` — The optional, separately-installed `se3[server]` central control-plane package: a fail-closed multi-tenant FastAPI server (app, ws, state, persistence, identity, crypto, bootstrap) that aggregates outbound daemon WebSocket connections and re-exposes their machines/flows/history over a REST/WebSocket API, plus the pluggable auth provider chain and the bundled single-page web UI static assets. <!--#a5a30f2841d417f9|648c461bd923f6b5-->

### `src/se3/server/__init__.py` (python) — The `se3-server` console-script entry point and package docstring for the separate, optional-extra server package, whose `main` intercepts `--version` and `bootstrap-token` on the lightweight path, then verifies the FastAPI/uvicorn `server` extra is installed (printing an install hint and exiting non-zero otherwise) before delegating to `se3.server.app.main`. <!--#100d9dbc5eb7b9e6|f583c61a40c09d3b-->
- `main` (function) — The `se3-server` console-script entry point that handles `--version` and `bootstrap-token` on the lightweight path, then verifies the FastAPI/uvicorn `server` extra is installed (printing an install hint and exiting non-zero if not) before delegating to `se3.server.app.main`. <!--#e7924e3140aae035-->

### `src/se3/server/app.py` (python) — Assembles the SE3 central-server FastAPI application — the `/ws` daemon/UI WebSocket endpoints, the `/api/*` REST surface for machines, flows, issues, history and authentication, the owner-auth provider chain and session/rate-limit wiring, and the bundled static web frontend (including i18n locale discovery) — kept behind the optional `se3[server]` extra so the core CLI never imports FastAPI. <!--#748c46ffdf24118f|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `src/se3/server/bootstrap.py` (python) — A deliberately dependency-light module providing the `se3-server bootstrap-token` CLI subcommand that mints the one-time break-glass admin escape-hatch token, persisting only its SHA-256 hash while revealing the plaintext to the console exactly once. <!--#117c67460bfbfc86|aa87810d05a4dd59-->
- `issue_breakglass_token` (function) — Mints a break-glass token against a given store, persisting only its hash and returning the (plaintext, token_id) pair with an optional TTL. <!--#43a92d1a8aa0f88a-->
- `print_breakglass_token` (function) — Opens the sqlite store at a path, mints a token, prints it once to a stream (the design-mandated single console reveal), and returns the plaintext. <!--#4e816632366833c2-->
- `_print_banner` (function) — Formats and writes the boxed console banner that reveals the token plaintext, id, and optional expiry exactly once. <!--#3b167444ad0773f8-->
- `main` (function) — Argparse entry point for the `se3-server bootstrap-token` subcommand, parsing --db-path/--ttl and triggering the one-time token print. <!--#cc33210abb24b513-->

### `src/se3/server/crypto.py` (python) — Credential cryptography module for the se3 multi-tenant server, providing slow salted password hashing (argon2id preferred, bcrypt fallback with deferred backend imports), high-entropy token generation with SHA-256 hashed storage, and constant-time comparison plus safe redaction/fingerprint helpers for logging. <!--#6cb4d5475664c3ed|7f035102747c14d4-->
- `PasswordBackendUnavailable` (class) — Exception raised when neither argon2-cffi nor bcrypt is installed, signaling the missing se3[server] extra on the password hash/verify path. <!--#8099c2e82c0aa84f-->
- `_argon2_hasher` (function) — Lazily import argon2 and return a PasswordHasher instance, or None if the backend is unavailable. <!--#fc52a7d3aa6dc5df-->
- `_bcrypt_module` (function) — Lazily import and return the bcrypt module, or None if it is unavailable. <!--#307a490487c8b7a8-->
- `_bcrypt_prep` (function) — Normalize a password into a fixed-length, NUL-free bytes value (SHA-256 + base64) to work around bcrypt's 72-byte and NUL-byte limitations. <!--#bb06af56be76fe88-->
- `hash_password` (function) — Hash a password with a slow salted algorithm, preferring argon2id and falling back to bcrypt, raising PasswordBackendUnavailable if neither exists. <!--#dec0485d3794dc2f-->
- `verify_password` (function) — Verify a password against a stored hash by dispatching on its algorithm prefix, returning False rather than raising on any mismatch or malformed input. <!--#647d73f726c8eeb8-->
- `token_hash` (function) — Return the hex SHA-256 of a token plaintext for fast, deterministic hashed storage and lookup. <!--#439625ff8bcb39f8-->
- `generate_token` (function) — Generate a high-entropy random token (optionally prefixed) and return its one-time plaintext alongside its storage hash. <!--#4604b91686f646f1-->
- `verify_token_hash` (function) — Constant-time check that a token plaintext hashes to a given stored hash. <!--#1e8b2fd48a378aaa-->
- `const_eq` (function) — Constant-time equality wrapper over hmac.compare_digest that accepts str or bytes and returns False on unsupported types. <!--#0378385214c29b7c-->
- `token_fingerprint` (function) — Return a short, non-reversible SHA-256-derived fingerprint of a secret for safe identification in logs/UI. <!--#07765d495538db1c-->
- `redact` (function) — Return a fixed placeholder for a credential that reveals neither its value nor its length. <!--#593a6a3cb211b8ef-->

### `src/se3/server/identity.py` (python) — The multi-tenant server's provider-independent identity/authorization layer over the persistence Store, resolving owners from hashed daemon keys and external (provider, external_id) identities, gating sensitive cross-provider identity linking behind an admin/verified-claim trust gate, and maintaining a live in-memory machine→owner binding index. <!--#38cf14a8062afaee|3948191864038871-->
- `UntrustedIdentityLink` (class) — Exception raised when an external identity is linked to an existing owner without passing the trust gate, guarding against account-takeover via blind auto-merge. <!--#f5020a578fd0f10a-->
- `IdentityService` (class) — Service that resolves owners from daemon keys and external identities, gates cross-provider identity linking, and maintains the live in-memory machine→owner binding index. <!--#e688faa5f37e4f48-->
  - `IdentityService.__init__` (method) — Initializes the service with a backing Store, an empty machine→owner dict, and a lock guarding that live index. <!--#949331c4e76504ed-->
  - `IdentityService.resolve_owner_for_key` (method) — Hashes a daemon key plaintext and delegates to the Store to resolve its owner_id, returning None for missing or non-matching keys. <!--#19b0bdb7d1db42ab-->
  - `IdentityService.resolve_owner_by_identity` (method) — Resolves a (provider, external_id) auth identity to its owner_id via the Store. <!--#874d22333f39d734-->
  - `IdentityService.link_identity_to_owner` (method) — Links an external identity to an existing owner only through the trust gate (admin override or both-sides-verified claim), staying idempotent for the same owner and rejecting conflicts. <!--#40178afed914ab1d-->
  - `IdentityService.bind_machine` (method) — Records under lock that a machine_id is currently owned by a given owner_id in the live index. <!--#bbba8ed39a3d379a-->
  - `IdentityService.owner_of_machine` (method) — Returns the owner bound to a machine_id, or None if unbound. <!--#80b6670164d240c6-->
  - `IdentityService.unbind_machine` (method) — Drops a machine's owner binding, e.g. on daemon disconnect. <!--#92a047a6ee556f74-->
  - `IdentityService.machines_for_owner` (method) — Returns the list of machine ids currently bound to a given owner_id. <!--#8c16d5f8ea6b335b-->
  - `IdentityService.snapshot_bindings` (method) — Returns a copy of all current (machine_id, owner_id) bindings under lock. <!--#aa1ad1922a731355-->

### `src/se3/server/persistence.py` (python) — The multi-tenant server's stdlib-sqlite3 persistence layer, exposing a thread-safe `Store` repository (with `Owner`/`DaemonKey` records and `IdentityAlreadyBound`) that owns all SQL and schema migrations for the durable auth facts — owners, identity bindings, local password hashes, daemon keys, and break-glass tokens — while transient machine/flow state stays in memory. <!--#90a534427104698e|70468e33a16ab4b9-->
- `Owner` (class) — Dataclass record for a persisted owner (stable owner_id, optional display name, admin flag, creation time) returned by the repository instead of a raw Row. <!--#bfe14bf8541354b0-->
- `DaemonKey` (class) — Dataclass record for a persisted daemon-key hash bound to an owner, with metadata and a revoked-at timestamp. <!--#b89b153a17848a21-->
  - `DaemonKey.revoked` (method) — Convenience property reporting whether the daemon key has been revoked (revoked_at is set). <!--#fb4bc884e0c8e4a4-->
- `Store` (class) — SQLite-backed repository encapsulating all SQL for the server's persisted facts, thread-safe via per-thread connections (or one shared lock-serialized connection for in-memory DBs). <!--#6a71c6a3e84c8889-->
  - `Store.__init__` (method) — Initializes the store for a file or in-memory DB, setting up locking/thread-local connection state, ensuring the parent dir exists, and running schema init. <!--#1d462c82a964e6e5-->
  - `Store._new_connection` (method) — Creates a new sqlite3 connection configured with Row factory, WAL journaling (file DBs), busy timeout, and per-connection foreign-key enforcement. <!--#1f7d9b1eb489947a-->
  - `Store._conn` (method) — Returns the appropriate connection for the caller — the shared one for in-memory DBs, otherwise a lazily-created thread-local connection. <!--#7be1eb71508e7627-->
  - `Store.close` (method) — Closes the shared and current-thread connections, clearing their stored references. <!--#9378a1bb19b255bb-->
  - `Store._init_schema` (method) — Reads the DB's user_version under lock and applies migrations if it is behind the current SCHEMA_VERSION. <!--#c387f248c591076c-->
  - `Store._apply_migrations` (method) — Applies the ordered (target_version, sql) migration steps from the current version up to SCHEMA_VERSION, bumping user_version after each. <!--#a3afc0d69e77afc3-->
  - `Store._now` (method) — Static helper returning the current wall-clock time for created/updated timestamps. <!--#194cd7b5e7248d18-->
  - `Store._new_id` (method) — Static helper generating a fresh opaque hex UUID for primary-key identifiers. <!--#205e13ff4affe569-->
  - `Store.create_owner` (method) — Inserts a new owner row and returns its stable internal owner_id. <!--#cfda8cc79821f6eb-->
  - `Store.get_owner` (method) — Fetches a single owner by owner_id, returning an Owner record or None. <!--#9805ae3e143bce5f-->
  - `Store.list_owners` (method) — Returns all owners as Owner records ordered by creation time. <!--#d9e1988a56e1e133-->
  - `Store.delete_owner` (method) — Deletes an owner (cascading to its bindings/credentials/keys) and reports whether a row was removed. <!--#711d2b75fecce53e-->
  - `Store.set_admin` (method) — Updates an owner's is_admin flag, returning whether the owner existed; backs the admin toggle-admin endpoint. <!--#e69d5b897d58e73f-->
  - `Store._count_real_admins` (method) — Lock-held helper counting admin owners excluding the break-glass subject, used to enforce the last-real-admin invariant in the same critical section as a write. <!--#1f3d3d282a0a0e14-->
  - `Store.delete_owner_guarded` (method) — Deletes an owner but atomically refuses if it is the last real admin, returning a 'not_found'/'last_admin'/'deleted' status. <!--#dc19e70db5cc369c-->
  - `Store.set_admin_guarded` (method) — Sets an owner's admin flag but atomically refuses a last-real-admin demotion, returning a 'not_found'/'last_admin'/'updated' status. <!--#7dfd730f059f977d-->
  - `Store.create_local_user` (method) — Atomically creates an owner, its (provider, external_id) identity binding, and its local password-hash credential in one transaction, raising IdentityAlreadyBound on a duplicate identity. <!--#dd9973ad116e60a4-->
  - `Store.link_identity` (method) — Attaches a (provider, external_id) binding to an owner (idempotent for the same owner), raising IdentityAlreadyBound if it maps to a different owner. <!--#fff8ca88f8ed33c9-->
  - `Store.resolve_owner_by_identity` (method) — Looks up the owner_id bound to a given (provider, external_id) identity, or None. <!--#f213f5753de9638b-->
  - `Store.list_identities` (method) — Returns the list of (provider, external_id) identity bindings attached to an owner. <!--#a8842435882279b8-->
  - `Store.set_password` (method) — Upserts the already-hashed local password for an owner, never handling plaintext. <!--#76f08302cd060b3c-->
  - `Store.get_password_hash` (method) — Returns the stored local password hash for an owner, or None. <!--#4b6e3684831998cf-->
  - `Store.issue_daemon_key` (method) — Persists a daemon-key hash bound to an owner and returns its generated key_id. <!--#df3f970b9328badd-->
  - `Store.resolve_owner_by_daemon_key` (method) — Returns the owner_id a non-revoked daemon-key hash belongs to, or None. <!--#d7a862790a09dda3-->
  - `Store.revoke_daemon_key` (method) — Marks a daemon key revoked by key_id (idempotent), returning False only if the key_id genuinely does not exist. <!--#910630e46c88ad28-->
  - `Store.list_daemon_keys` (method) — Returns an owner's daemon keys as DaemonKey records, optionally excluding revoked ones, ordered by creation time. <!--#92d3d96ccd59c1e2-->
  - `Store.put_breakglass` (method) — Persists a break-glass admin token hash (with optional expiry) and returns its token_id. <!--#d0cf28881699ea5b-->
  - `Store.consume_breakglass` (method) — Atomically consumes a break-glass token by hash, returning True exactly once for a valid/unexpired/unconsumed token and marking it consumed. <!--#42e03299c1a89b1d-->
  - `Store.purge_breakglass` (method) — Deletes all break-glass tokens (e.g. before re-issuing) and returns the number removed. <!--#e0a39cb75dfc461e-->
- `IdentityAlreadyBound` (class) — Exception raised when linking an external identity that is already bound to another owner. <!--#e57ce650eec6fb27-->

### `src/se3/server/state.py` (python) — Defines the SE3 server's in-memory state layer: the `ServerState` store (asyncio-lock-guarded registry of connected machines, their aggregated flows, relayed history index/bundles and cursors, generation and recovery/full-pull bookkeeping, and mirrored per-project issues) plus its supporting `MachineRecord`/`FlowSnapshot`/`HistoryWriteOutcome` records and helpers for owner-scoped visibility, history progress-token encode/decode and bundle signatures. <!--#c659a875fa257dd6|6a966d0606c9524a-->
- `_display_step_id` (function) — Pure helper that converts a history cursor key (a physical `*.jsonl` filename) into the `step_id` the daemon stamps on that file's records, keeping any `.from-<branch>` sidecar marker so primary and sidecar streams stay distinct. <!--#6e3918bc60358153-->
- `_is_worktree_session_path` (function) — Structural-only helper that returns whether a project_root path's last two segments are `se3/worktrees`, used to recognize an orphan worktree session for end/cleanup without filesystem access. <!--#c1e37948c9c27c2a-->
- `_progress_payload` (function) — Builds the canonical sorted-key JSON byte payload binding (version, generation, offset, machine_id) that backs a history progress token. <!--#252830f5782afc92-->
- `encode_progress` (function) — Encodes an opaque base64url history progress token from (generation, offset, machine_id), optionally HMAC-signed with a process-local secret. <!--#262f2db866a0e3b7-->
- `decode_progress` (function) — Decodes and (when a secret is given) verifies a progress token, returning its scalars or `None` so the caller falls back to a full snapshot on any malformed/tampered input. <!--#4e36bdfbed16f8af-->
- `bundle_signature` (function) — A helper that hashes a bundle's generation, record count, and machine id into a short 16-hex-char content-version signature used for cheap not-modified history checks. <!--#da3e85c82019405f-->
- `FlowSnapshot` (class) — A plain server-side record mirroring the daemon aggregator's per-flow shape (id, task, status, step progress, pending calls, history, waiting-for-lock and resumable flags), with from_payload/to_dict for daemon-protocol serialization so the server needn't import daemon dataclasses. <!--#70ef16bc3f25802c-->
  - `FlowSnapshot.from_payload` (method) — Classmethod constructing a FlowSnapshot from a daemon-supplied per-flow dict, coercing each field to its expected type and defaulting missing keys (falling back to project_root or 'unknown' for the flow id). <!--#ce402e5424df45a9-->
  - `FlowSnapshot.to_dict` (method) — Serializes the FlowSnapshot back to a plain dict of all its fields for JSON transport to REST/WebSocket clients. <!--#db43ea80cd9d0565-->
- `MachineRecord` (class) — A dataclass holding the server-side live (never-persisted) record of one connected SE3 machine — its identity, versions, resolved owner trust domain, online status, aggregated flows, and project roots. <!--#fb9671414dee3543-->
  - `MachineRecord.to_dict` (method) — Serializes the machine record to a plain dict for API/wire output, optionally including the full flow list (else just a flow count). <!--#30e44010eb4dd301-->
- `_owned` (function) — Predicate deciding whether a MachineRecord is visible to an owner-scoped query, treating `owner is None` as the unscoped/admin view and unbound machines as fail-closed. <!--#bf5a165d13bea0cf-->
- `HistoryWriteOutcome` (class) — Small result record returned by a history frame write, reporting separately whether the frame left the cache authoritative enough to resolve a pending REST pull waiter (`resolves_pull`) and whether it was a `full` snapshot rejected as untrustworthy and therefore unsafe to relay (`rejected_full`). <!--#5c7c213434c573b6-->
- `ServerState` (class) — The server's single asyncio-lock-guarded, purely in-memory store of all aggregated machine state — registered machines and their flows, the relayed history index/bundles with their cursors, progress-token signing and generation bookkeeping, recovery/full-pull throttling markers, and the mirrored per-project issue lists. <!--#38f3a765e0596c77-->
  - `ServerState.__init__` (method) — Initializes the empty machine map, history relay caches and recovery/full-pull throttling state, the generation counter and per-process progress-token secret, the issue mirror, and the shared asyncio lock. <!--#1b69a90f98aa7a26-->
  - `ServerState.register_machine` (method) — Registers or refreshes a machine on HELLO (marking it online and updating versions/protocol), scrubbing the prior owner's flows and cached history whenever the resolved owner of an existing forgeable machine_id changes. <!--#e026e4ed91d0d5c2-->
  - `ServerState._discard_machine_state` (method) — Lock-held helper dropping a machine's cached history index, history bundles, and issues on an owner change to prevent cross-owner leakage. <!--#9315b3c1af09361f-->
  - `ServerState.mark_offline` (method) — Marks a machine offline and stamps last_seen when its daemon disconnects. <!--#43d1590c93817888-->
  - `ServerState.touch` (method) — Refreshes a machine's last_seen timestamp on a heartbeat/PONG. <!--#ef0a38b4a686f648-->
  - `ServerState.update_status` (method) — Applies a daemon STATUS_UPDATE snapshot, fully replacing the machine's flows, project roots, and per-root issue mirror. <!--#adecb141e2c5fabc-->
  - `ServerState.get_machine_owner` (method) — Returns the owner id bound to a machine (or `None`), used by owner-scoped WebSocket push paths to gate UI clients. <!--#58c587dbd12e0fb6-->
  - `ServerState.get_machines` (method) — Returns owner-filtered summary dicts for all known machines without nested flows. <!--#a201d1372466ec52-->
  - `ServerState.get_machine` (method) — Returns the full record for one machine, reporting cross-owner machines as `None` (no existence leak). <!--#4c36428df7cb705f-->
  - `ServerState.machine_supports_detail_pull` (method) — Returns whether a known, owner-visible machine advertised a protocol version (revision 3+) that understands the on-demand detail-request leg, failing closed to the STATUS_UPDATE mirror path otherwise. <!--#ccf9b7bf42c95d6d-->
  - `ServerState.get_machines_full` (method) — Returns owner-filtered full machine dicts including nested flows, for the realtime frontend broadcast payload. <!--#5b36c9138f71224d-->
  - `ServerState.get_machine_flows` (method) — Returns a machine's flow list, or `None` for unknown/cross-owner machines. <!--#0c0e3b88a8a832c8-->
  - `ServerState.get_flow` (method) — Finds a flow by id across all (owner-scoped) machines, returning `(machine_id, flow_dict)` or `None`. <!--#ca2ca5af43bb1987-->
  - `ServerState.find_machine_for_flow` (method) — Returns just the machine id owning a given flow id, via get_flow. <!--#67d6bf5d911f2fc8-->
  - `ServerState.find_call_owner` (method) — Scans owner-scoped flows (optionally pinned to a project_root) for a pending call_id and returns the owning (machine_id, project_root) so the detail endpoint can route a full-prompt pull to the right daemon. <!--#3ce0a4e9f5f3ed47-->
  - `ServerState.get_pending_call` (method) — Returns a copy of the mirror dict for a pending call_id (scoped by owner/machine/project) so the pre-v3 fall-back can serve the untruncated prompt directly from STATUS_UPDATE instead of pulling. <!--#909ac7f684f55875-->
  - `ServerState.is_flow_resumable` (method) — Owner-scoped resumability gate returning `(machine_id, flow)` when the daemon's resumable flag (or legacy status fallback) holds and the flow is not terminally completed. <!--#f4314f239b674e05-->
  - `ServerState.is_flow_endable` (method) — Owner-scoped end gate returning `(machine_id, flow)` for any non-completed flow or a completed-but-orphaned worktree session still needing cleanup. <!--#c0edeab68b29eae2-->
  - `ServerState.update_history_index` (method) — Replaces the cached history-session index reported by a machine (full list, not a delta). <!--#4667089086e5275b-->
  - `ServerState.merge_history_index_delta` (method) — Applies a HISTORY_INDEX_DELTA (per-flow upserts and removals) onto the machine's authoritative in-memory history index, preserving insertion order so incremental and full-push paths converge. <!--#772a0cc5af455867-->
  - `ServerState.mark_full_pull` (method) — Stamps the monotonic time a cache-miss full history pull was dispatched for a flow, so repeated-miss storms for that flow can be throttled. <!--#3cc31ce5198b0157-->
  - `ServerState.full_pull_throttled` (method) — Reports whether a full history pull for a flow fired within the minimum-interval floor, telling the caller to prefer a cached snapshot over another multi-MB source pull. <!--#de4491e035e36ada-->
  - `ServerState.get_history_index` (method) — Returns the owner-scoped history index aggregated across machines, annotated with machine_id and sorted by updated_at descending. <!--#18d426e5d9a0826c-->
  - `ServerState.append_history` (method) — Convenience bool wrapper over `apply_history_frame` for callers that only need to know whether a pull waiter may be resolved from the frame; relaying callers must use the richer method instead. <!--#5717e3dc128b268e-->
  - `ServerState.apply_history_frame` (method) — The core history cache write: applies a `full` or `append` frame to a flow's cached bundle, refusing snapshots that would shrink or empty a flow's truthful history and appends that are unanchored, cross-machine, or discontinuous with the cached cursor (arming a self-heal full pull instead), and reports the result as a `HistoryWriteOutcome`. <!--#576469b05a4a32a8-->
  - `ServerState.take_recovery_pull` (method) — Decides whether to fire a single self-heal full pull for a flow stuck in requires-full, returning True at most once per stuck flow (re-arming only after the in-flight marker exceeds the monotonic-clock recovery TTL) so a discarded-append storm can't fan out redundant requests. <!--#66f09ccbaed41f1a-->
  - `ServerState.clear_recovery_pull` (method) — Drops a flow's in-flight recovery marker when the recovery request send failed, so a later append can re-arm a fresh recovery instead of being wedged. <!--#da66c6b409eb9fd5-->
  - `ServerState._detect_cursor_gap` (method) — Continuity check for an append frame: compares the frame's declared per-file coverage windows (`cursor_base` → `cursor`) against the cached water marks and returns the first file whose delta starts past the cached line — a lost-records hole — treating overlaps/rollbacks as benign and falling back to a record-count estimate only for version-skewed daemons that send no `cursor_base`. <!--#ff3499f4f8185737-->
  - `ServerState._next_generation` (method) — Lock-held monotonic counter handing out a fresh bundle generation id. <!--#610006147e1ecc92-->
  - `ServerState._ensure_generation` (method) — Returns a bundle's stable generation, back-filling and persisting a fresh one for old-format/zero-generation bundles so progress tokens stay durable. <!--#30e037fa41d8b591-->
  - `ServerState.get_history` (method) — Returns a defensive copy of a flow's cached history bundle (with ensured generation), or `None` on cache miss. <!--#fb2ab42ac81f6797-->
  - `ServerState.get_history_snapshot` (method) — Atomically reads and validates a cached history bundle under one lock, returning a not-modified/delta/full delivery with the sliced records, a fresh generation-pinned progress token, and a content signature (or None on a cache miss the caller resolves by pulling). <!--#e6add1acda8347e1-->
  - `ServerState.find_machine_for_history_flow` (method) — Resolves which owner-scoped machine owns a flow for an on-demand history pull, checking index, cached bundle, then live flows. <!--#bca10b5c804a637b-->
  - `ServerState._find_machine_for_history_flow_locked` (method) — Lock-held implementation of find_machine_for_history_flow with the owner-acceptance helper. <!--#39f3c7b9a40fd99b-->
  - `ServerState.get_history_flow_project_root` (method) — Resolves a flow's authoritative project_root (from history index then live flows) so an on-demand pull reads the correct root rather than the daemon's first-match guess. <!--#dafe09bc4f8c02f0-->
  - `ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow` (method) — Lock-acquiring predicate reporting whether a flow is a still-running-or-paused `--worktree` isolation session, used to decide when a `not_modified` cache reply should be reconciled against the daemon via a full re-pull. <!--#dfeab3be4082f4c1-->
  - `ServerState._is_active_worktree_flow_locked` (method) — The lock-free body of `is_active_worktree_flow`, so the history write path can apply the same worktree/active predicate while already holding `self._lock` without deadlocking. <!--#95eb0bc8830abc75-->
  - `ServerState.get_issues` (method) — Returns issues from the in-memory mirror filtered by owner, machine, project_root, open/closed status, source, and type. <!--#ac44934ad011ae08-->
  - `ServerState.get_issue_by_id` (method) — Finds a single issue by id within owner/machine/root scope, returning `(machine_id, project_root, issue)` or `None`. <!--#cba188f129587422-->
  - `ServerState.find_machine_for_project` (method) — Returns the owner-scoped machine owning a project_root, checking the issue mirror first then registered project_roots. <!--#7f5359f80a65f72b-->

### `src/se3/server/ws.py` (python) — The central server's WebSocket layer: it defines the daemon connection pool (ConnectionManager) that routes downlink messages to each machine while accounting wire bytes, plus a family of in-flight request registries (history pulls, index refreshes, issue commands, issue/call detail pulls) that park and coalesce REST waiters onto shared daemon round-trips, and helpers/trackers for broadcasting index rebuilds, requesting history/detail, and diffing interjection lifecycle events across status snapshots. <!--#7df7dd207888a170|6753d85071e33c2b-->
- `ConnectionManager` (class) — Registry that tracks each daemon's live server→daemon WebSocket by machine id and routes downlink messages to it, superseding stale sockets on reconnect and accounting sent bytes into wire metrics. <!--#88461f6c7e95ccd9-->
  - `ConnectionManager.__init__` (method) — Initializes the empty connection map, an asyncio lock, and the optional per-type WireMetrics used to attribute server→daemon bytes. <!--#58ad98340a58b2a5-->
  - `ConnectionManager.connect` (method) — Registers a websocket as the live connection for a machine, closing any superseded stale socket. <!--#c5c144b4702079b9-->
  - `ConnectionManager.disconnect` (method) — Removes a machine from the pool, only if the given socket still matches the registered one. <!--#58ba5caa6ac7783b-->
  - `ConnectionManager.is_connected` (method) — Reports whether a machine currently has a live connection. <!--#3704a66dd2030bd9-->
  - `ConnectionManager.record_send` (method) — Records the byte cost of WELCOME/PING frames written straight to the socket (bypassing send_to) so the per-type server→daemon metrics stay complete. <!--#58e2f04b77ae694c-->
  - `ConnectionManager.machine_ids` (method) — Returns a snapshot list of currently-connected machine ids. <!--#8a072e798cee7d62-->
  - `ConnectionManager.send_to` (method) — Sends a message to a daemon by machine id, recording bytes on success and returning False if the machine is not connected or the send fails. <!--#55f56a38bc8ceaad-->
  - `ConnectionManager.get_connection` (method) — Returns the currently registered socket for a machine under the lock. <!--#4fdc29e4e0e3773e-->
  - `ConnectionManager.is_current_connection` (method) — Reports whether a given websocket is still the registered connection for a machine. <!--#372d03c4bcef83de-->
  - `ConnectionManager.send_to_connection` (method) — Sends a message only through a specific validated socket, doing the identity check under the lock but releasing it before awaiting send so a stalled daemon can't block the whole manager. <!--#aba2dd5e52e9b8c2-->
- `_PullAbandoned` (class) — Internal exception signaling that a shared-pull leader failed before dispatching, so parked followers retry as a fresh leader. <!--#471918e71d2f3711-->
- `HistoryRequestRegistry` (class) — Tracks in-flight on-demand history pulls (keyed by flow/machine) so cache-miss REST handlers park futures and share one daemon pull. <!--#21a1b382b7c990ec-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.__init__` (method) — Initializes the per-key waiter lists and the in-flight pull-key set. <!--#8c9c543f4c98a904-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.register` (method) — Parks and returns a future for a flow id, optionally pinned to a machine. <!--#3e0b5d3d6442b58d-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.begin_pull` (method) — Registers a waiter and reports whether this caller is the leader that must send the daemon pull versus a follower that just awaits. <!--#1dd90155a26972ea-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.resolve` (method) — Resolves all waiters for a flow/machine with the data, returning whether any waiter existed (i.e. an on-demand pull was answered). <!--#b2eeadcb2c32dea4-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.discard` (method) — Drops a single waiter (e.g. on timeout) without resolving it, clearing the in-flight marker when the last waiter is gone. <!--#2f769c1df1ec47e8-->
  - `HistoryRequestRegistry.fail_pull` (method) — Wakes every follower of a key with _PullAbandoned and unconditionally clears the in-flight marker when the leader fails before dispatch. <!--#30701d48accab21d-->
- `IndexRefreshRegistry` (class) — Tracks in-flight history-index refreshes (keyed by machine) so GET /api/history can await each daemon's forced re-push. <!--#80fcc54c38dfd466-->
  - `IndexRefreshRegistry.__init__` (method) — Initializes the per-machine waiter dict. <!--#fba411afdbd02f01-->
  - `IndexRefreshRegistry.register` (method) — Parks and returns a future that resolves when the given machine re-pushes its index. <!--#302b0786491eb472-->
  - `IndexRefreshRegistry.resolve` (method) — Resolves every waiter parked for a machine (no-op when none). <!--#0c36de37f9b5eef3-->
  - `IndexRefreshRegistry.discard` (method) — Drops a single index-refresh waiter without resolving it. <!--#36aa54710f132bf9-->
- `IssueCommandRegistry` (class) — Tracks in-flight issue write commands (keyed by request_id) awaiting a daemon's MSG_ISSUE_RESULT reply. <!--#6a315b72f8d1966e-->
  - `IssueCommandRegistry.__init__` (method) — Initializes the per-request_id waiter dict. <!--#fba411afdbd02f01-->
  - `IssueCommandRegistry.register` (method) — Parks and returns a future that resolves when the given request_id's result lands. <!--#5bc82f55890f883b-->
  - `IssueCommandRegistry.resolve` (method) — Resolves every waiter parked for a request_id with the daemon's result data. <!--#f08143665a94daa3-->
  - `IssueCommandRegistry.discard` (method) — Drops a single issue-command waiter without resolving it. <!--#ae6c1a2ef504cad2-->
- `DetailRequestRegistry` (class) — In-memory registry that parks REST waiters for on-demand issue/call detail pulls and coalesces concurrent requests for the same physical target (kind+id+machine+project) onto one downlink DETAIL_REQUEST. <!--#b0c1a1d24b2821e5-->
  - `DetailRequestRegistry.__init__` (method) — Sets up the request_id→waiter-futures map and the per-physical-target in-flight map keyed by (kind, target_id, machine_id, project_root). <!--#7b712681750fb49f-->
  - `DetailRequestRegistry.begin` (method) — Parks a waiter future and reports whether the caller is the leader that must send the downlink request, joining followers onto the leader's in-flight request_id for the same physical target. <!--#e2563a2efc85c904-->
  - `DetailRequestRegistry.resolve` (method) — Resolves every waiter parked under a request_id with the daemon's reply data and clears that request's in-flight marker so a later open starts fresh. <!--#23f02531f63ca53b-->
  - `DetailRequestRegistry.discard` (method) — Removes a single (e.g. timed-out) waiter without resolving it, clearing the in-flight marker if that leaves the leader's pull with no remaining waiters. <!--#9c70d6c6adabd3ab-->
- `broadcast_index_refresh` (function) — Sends a history-index-rebuild request to every connected daemon and returns a {machine_id: future} map for the caller to await. <!--#0ff3d4f3fc8dddf4-->
- `request_history` (function) — Sends a MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST to the daemon owning a flow, optionally pinned to a machine or a specific still-current socket. <!--#25fc977fc0d0efa5-->
- `request_detail` (function) — Helper that sends a MSG_DETAIL_REQUEST for one issue/call's full text to a machine (correlated by request_id), returning False when that machine has no live connection. <!--#3e387047e78a6553-->
- `InterjectionEventTracker` (class) — Per-machine differ that compares interjection chips across STATUS_UPDATE snapshots to emit pending/consumed interjection lifecycle events exactly once. <!--#0c203a5637217100-->
  - `InterjectionEventTracker.__init__` (method) — Initializes the per-machine→flow→{call_id:prompt} seen-state map. <!--#30dd654c458d4ee8-->
  - `InterjectionEventTracker.reset_machine` (method) — Forgets a machine's tracked interjection state, e.g. on disconnect. <!--#228a98d249085fcc-->
  - `InterjectionEventTracker.diff_machine` (method) — Diffs a machine's snapshot against prior state to produce new pending/consumed interjection events and atomically replaces the stored state. <!--#0639105045c12747-->
- `_make_interjection_event` (function) — Builds a single interjection_event UI payload dict (no I/O). <!--#784734196502da32-->
- `UiHub` (class) — Owner-scoped fan-out hub for browser /ws/ui clients that tracks each socket's authenticated owner and broadcasts state pushes filtered to that owner's trust domain (None = unscoped/admin view). <!--#e39c916b577dc717-->
  - `UiHub.__init__` (method) — Initializes the websocket→owner client map, an asyncio lock, and the optional WireMetrics recording server→browser bytes under ui:<type> keys. <!--#b6f355c4f7da8531-->
  - `UiHub.register` (method) — Registers a UI websocket under the owner it authenticated as. <!--#0879cab8ba866508-->
  - `UiHub.unregister` (method) — Removes a UI websocket from the client map. <!--#ff838ffb7369e1a8-->
  - `UiHub.client_count` (method) — Returns the number of currently-connected frontend clients. <!--#b5ac032cea5428a5-->
  - `UiHub.record_send` (method) — Attributes the bytes of a direct (non-fan-out) /ws/ui send, such as the initial per-connection snapshot, into the ui:<type> metrics breakdown. <!--#4f44f45bbdd63ee6-->
  - `UiHub.distinct_owners` (method) — Returns the set of distinct owners currently connected (may include None for admin views). <!--#374af16ce9d49e25-->
  - `UiHub.broadcast` (method) — Sends a payload to every UI client unfiltered (retained for owner-agnostic frames). <!--#362bc72b9acb32d4-->
  - `UiHub.broadcast_scoped` (method) — Sends each connected owner the per-owner payload precomputed for it, skipping owners with no payload. <!--#62e1c2afeb67ebef-->
  - `UiHub.broadcast_owned` (method) — Sends a payload only to clients allowed to see a given owner's data (its owner plus the admin view), fail-closed for unowned data. <!--#fb273a5dd096ed5e-->
  - `UiHub._send_map` (method) — Internal helper that resolves each client's payload from an owner→payload map and fans out the resulting targets. <!--#d4298dda42992670-->
  - `UiHub._fan_out` (method) — Serializes and pushes each (client, payload) target to its socket, recording per-frame bytes and pruning any client whose send raised. <!--#5ecf7a4e386b1b5b-->
- `_push_state` (function) — Broadcasts the per-owner-filtered machine list to UI clients (best effort). <!--#c374fcd82209c536-->
- `_push_history_index` (function) — Broadcasts the per-owner-filtered history index to UI clients (best effort). <!--#bb9a52fa787fb446-->
- `_push_history_index_delta` (function) — Broadcasts an incremental history-index delta (only changed SessionMeta rows, machine-annotated) to just the reporting machine's owner plus the admin view, in a backward-compatible frame. <!--#19b7b2b6f0472d67-->
- `_push_history_data` (function) — Broadcasts a history-data delta for a flow only to its originating machine's owner (plus the admin view). <!--#251cc141ccb29934-->
- `_push_spawn_failed` (function) — Broadcasts a spawn-failure event to the reporting machine's owner UI clients so the frontend can flip a published task into a visible error. <!--#744ca8a4efd1dc0e-->
- `handle_ui_connection` (function) — Serves one browser /ws/ui connection: optionally fail-closes an unauthenticated client, sends an owner-filtered initial snapshot, registers the socket, then idles reading frames purely to detect disconnect. <!--#7f545f39eba26438-->
- `handle_daemon_connection` (function) — Serves one daemon WebSocket end to end — accepts, validates and optionally authenticates the HELLO, binds/registers the machine to its owner, answers WELCOME, then runs the receive+heartbeat loop until disconnect and cleans up on exit. <!--#89f84528654b1d56-->
- `_serve_loop` (function) — Runs a daemon connection's receive loop concurrently with a heartbeat/PING loop, tracking last-seen for timeout, and cancels both when either finishes. <!--#82d677e1f1032337-->
- `_handle_message` (function) — Central dispatcher for one inbound daemon WebSocket frame: switches on the `protocol.MSG_*` type to refresh machine liveness/status, merge full or delta history indexes, cache history records and resolve parked REST waiters (history, detail, index-refresh, issue-command registries), and fan the resulting updates out to `/ws/ui` browser clients via the `UiHub`. <!--#6bcedb8b52909b3e-->

## `src/se3/server/auth/` — The pluggable A-layer authentication package that resolves the current request owner for the multi-tenant server's human/UI side, providing the AuthProvider ABC and fail-closed ProviderChain (base), an in-memory hashed-session store and cookie-based session resolver (session), the default built-in username/password authenticator (local), a brute-force login rate limiter (ratelimit), disabled-by-default OIDC and reverse-proxy-header provider seams (oidc, proxy_header), and the config-driven registry that assembles the fail-closed provider chain and exposes the FastAPI require_owner dependency. <!--#6e244101855f68c0|003a260a1c4d9026-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/__init__.py` (python) — Package init for the pluggable A-layer authentication seam that resolves the current owner for the multi-tenant server's human/UI side, re-exporting the provider ABC, session store, local username/password provider, rate limiter, and registry that assembles the fail-closed provider chain and FastAPI require_owner dependency. <!--#5b334a33c957b94b|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/base.py` (python) — Defines the server auth A-layer vocabulary — the transport-independent OwnerIdentity result, the abstract AuthProvider 'resolve the current owner' interface, and a fail-closed ProviderChain that tries enabled providers in order and returns the first non-None owner resolution. <!--#b73ff7cf4addf079|cd9faafc057e0b60-->
- `OwnerIdentity` (class) — Frozen dataclass holding the resolved owner of a request: the stable internal owner_id used for authorization, plus display_name, the resolving provider, and an is_admin flag. <!--#e6f4d0b299c020c0-->
- `AuthProvider` (class) — Abstract base class for the unified 'resolve the current owner' interface, carrying a name discriminator and an enabled flag for registry/chain participation. <!--#32eaf7eb12361308-->
  - `AuthProvider.resolve_owner` (method) — Abstract method that resolves a request-like object to an OwnerIdentity or returns None (could-not-authenticate, never authorize-anonymous). <!--#519521172c8b189d-->
- `ProviderChain` (class) — Ordered composition of AuthProviders that drops disabled ones, returns the first non-None resolution, and is falsy when empty to enforce fail-closed. <!--#8c9764f1b32445c0-->
  - `ProviderChain.__init__` (method) — Builds the chain by filtering the given providers down to those whose enabled flag is truthy. <!--#111e6b192e809c5b-->
  - `ProviderChain.providers` (method) — Property returning a copy of the chain's enabled providers list. <!--#9fed3349e6dcd43c-->
  - `ProviderChain.resolve_owner` (method) — Iterates the enabled providers in order and returns the first non-None OwnerIdentity, else None. <!--#f6ba975245faf121-->
  - `ProviderChain.__bool__` (method) — Truthiness reflecting whether the chain has any enabled providers (used to enforce fail-closed serving). <!--#fc551b5bfab86264-->
  - `ProviderChain.__len__` (method) — Returns the number of enabled providers in the chain. <!--#a0fd978e084ff45a-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/local.py` (python) — Defines LocalAuthProvider, the default built-in username/password/session authenticator over the local store, whose login ceremony rate-limits, resolves the owner, verifies the password hash (with a dummy verify to equalize timing against unknown users), and mints a session on success while never logging secrets. <!--#cd69c77c32718f02|039a69b633851c14-->
- `LocalAuthProvider` (class) — Session-based auth provider that authenticates owners against the local store using username, password, and rate limiting. <!--#b5a7149cd171a8d3-->
  - `LocalAuthProvider.__init__` (method) — Constructs the provider with a store, session store, and an optional (else default) login rate limiter, deferring the dummy timing hash. <!--#10228702a0a41f9c-->
  - `LocalAuthProvider.rate_limiter` (method) — Property exposing the provider's login rate limiter. <!--#97b7c30b9d9fae0f-->
  - `LocalAuthProvider._dummy_verify` (method) — Best-effort dummy password verification that equalizes login timing on the unknown-user path to mitigate user enumeration. <!--#516f8841211cbaef-->
  - `LocalAuthProvider.login` (method) — Authenticates a username/password — rate-gating, resolving the owner, verifying the hash, and minting a session on success or recording a failure otherwise. <!--#6c686daae20099f1-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/oidc.py` (python) — A disabled-by-default OIDC authentication seam that keeps the auth layer's schema and call path open for future social login by defining the stable `issuer|sub` external-identity key and a fail-closed `OidcProvider`, while leaving the actual login/callback ceremony unimplemented (NotImplementedError) in v1. <!--#ed99ce6366d1dc58|6ed5aab56df6cf65-->
- `oidc_external_id` (function) — Composes the globally stable OIDC external identity as `"{issuer}|{sub}"`, the key used to bind an OIDC subject to an owner_id. <!--#4ce6c3586d1745a6-->
- `OidcProvider` (class) — A disabled-by-default OIDC auth provider that enables only when explicitly opted in and fully configured, otherwise failing closed and leaving the login ceremony unimplemented. <!--#32c9223628687a08-->
  - `OidcProvider.__init__` (method) — Validates the required OIDC config keys and sets `enabled` only when the operator opts in and all keys are present, logging a fail-closed warning on incomplete config. <!--#9f166fbf12760eee-->
  - `OidcProvider.resolve_owner` (method) — Returns None when disabled (never inspecting the request) and otherwise delegates to the standard session-cookie owner resolution. <!--#0b7f86218d50c7cd-->
  - `OidcProvider.begin_login` (method) — Seam for building the authorization-endpoint redirect URL with state/nonce; raises NotImplementedError in v1. <!--#d9ab4af1dc1c8197-->
  - `OidcProvider.complete_login` (method) — Seam for handling the OIDC callback (validate state/nonce, exchange code, link owner, mint session); raises NotImplementedError in v1. <!--#fa4c032f2483c13e-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/proxy_header.py` (python) — A fail-closed AuthProvider seam that resolves an owner identity from a reverse-proxy-injected header, staying disabled by default and refusing to trust the header unless the operator both enables it and affirms the proxy-trust precondition. <!--#5c4747182c6d7b05|c97844013e24d778-->
- `_read_header` (function) — Helper that safely extracts a named header value from a request's headers mapping, returning None when absent or on any access error. <!--#5f41b5f49adf1583-->
- `ProxyHeaderProvider` (class) — AuthProvider implementation that resolves an owner from a proxy-injected identity header, enabling only when the operator opts in and affirms trust. <!--#fbcc83a32474b846-->
  - `ProxyHeaderProvider.__init__` (method) — Reads config to set the header name and computes the fail-closed enabled flag, warning and staying disabled if enabled without an affirmed trust precondition. <!--#40b36c30c2f1b731-->
  - `ProxyHeaderProvider.header` (method) — Property exposing the configured (lowercased) identity header name. <!--#83cc214723e36afc-->
  - `ProxyHeaderProvider.resolve_owner` (method) — Resolves the request's header value to an OwnerIdentity via the store, returning None when disabled, header missing, or no owner is bound (no auto-creation). <!--#99444a685b125cf3-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/ratelimit.py` (python) — An in-memory, thread-safe login rate limiter that tracks per-key failed attempts in a sliding window and locks a key out for a configured duration once failures exceed a threshold, clearing the counter on success and raising LoginRateLimited (with a Retry-After delay) while locked. <!--#73e31186e06a45dc|f04b6c8845ceaf3e-->
- `RateLimitConfig` (class) — Dataclass holding the tunable thresholds — max failures, lockout duration, and sliding window — for the rate limiter. <!--#a6a5eb383f7136a0-->
- `_Entry` (class) — Private per-key state record holding the list of recent failure timestamps and the time until which the key is locked. <!--#10591451905b3f36-->
- `LoginRateLimited` (class) — Exception raised when a login key is currently locked out, carrying a retry_after delay suitable for an HTTP 429 Retry-After header. <!--#1dd2b3f40fd525d2-->
  - `LoginRateLimited.__init__` (method) — Constructs the exception with a human-readable message and stores the retry_after seconds. <!--#ba5a287e1e640a20-->
- `LoginRateLimiter` (class) — Thread-safe per-key failure counter that records attempts, trips a lockout once over threshold, and clears on success. <!--#dc80045151f25360-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.__init__` (method) — Initializes the limiter with a config, an injectable clock, an empty entry map, and a lock for thread safety. <!--#61fee3463d2384b5-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter._prune` (method) — Drops failure timestamps older than the sliding window from an entry. <!--#cb829de6f8f922c0-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.is_locked` (method) — Returns whether the given key is currently within its lockout period. <!--#1a4772931c2f9874-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.retry_after` (method) — Returns the seconds remaining on a key's lockout, or 0 if not locked. <!--#b9a0362606992fb2-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.check` (method) — Raises LoginRateLimited if the key is currently locked, otherwise returns silently. <!--#3c7783c70f3655b5-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.record_failure` (method) — Registers a failed attempt and trips the lockout once the failure count reaches the configured threshold. <!--#b1e2b4c4f685ed5f-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.record_success` (method) — Clears a key's entire failure history on a successful login. <!--#e931a75cb8fbf1f7-->
  - `LoginRateLimiter.reset` (method) — Drops all tracked keys, as a test helper or administrative clear. <!--#af382ab8e4ab2f2c-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/registry.py` (python) — Assembles the configuration-driven, fail-closed authentication provider chain (raising AuthNotConfigured when no usable provider remains) and builds the FastAPI `require_owner` dependency that resolves the current OwnerIdentity or rejects anonymous requests with HTTP 401. <!--#7b974058ccca3293|462425ce67bb7394-->
- `AuthNotConfigured` (class) — Exception raised when configuration yields no usable auth provider, signaling the server to refuse serving rather than fall back to an identity-unaware open control plane. <!--#18ef78762ac12051-->
- `_normalize_entry` (function) — Helper that normalizes a providers-list entry (bare type string or mapping with `type` plus options) into a `(type, options)` tuple. <!--#4006889c26eb61dc-->
- `build_provider_chain` (function) — Constructs the ordered `ProviderChain` from `server.auth` config, keeping only enabled providers and raising `AuthNotConfigured` (fail-closed) if the chain ends up empty. <!--#86279238c9bb36f0-->
- `_construct_provider` (function) — Factory that instantiates the appropriate provider (local, OIDC, or proxy-header) for a given type discriminator, returning None for unknown types. <!--#40a7f3b75d64da4f-->
- `make_require_owner` (function) — Builds the FastAPI `require_owner` dependency that resolves the current `OwnerIdentity` via the chain and raises HTTP 401 when none resolves, wiring up annotations so FastAPI injects the request. <!--#6b40cb227e95e093-->

### `src/se3/server/auth/session.py` (python) — Implements the UI session-auth layer: a thread-safe in-memory `SessionStore` of hashed, expiring session tokens (with secure `CookieConfig` cookie attributes and create/resolve/destroy/sweep operations) plus a `SessionAuthProvider` base class that reads the session cookie and resolves it to the current owner identity. <!--#6b660897af44e2cd|cf36262b4e3d8f0f-->
- `CookieConfig` (class) — Dataclass holding the secure-cookie attributes (name, HttpOnly, SameSite, Secure, Path, Max-Age) for the UI session cookie. <!--#c7b2a206e0272a4d-->
- `Session` (class) — Dataclass representing one live server-side session, storing the session id's hash, owner, and creation/expiry timestamps. <!--#88ed149b1e808cda-->
  - `Session.is_expired` (method) — Returns whether the session's absolute expiry time has been reached at the given clock value. <!--#3e82312554a4481a-->
- `read_cookie` (function) — Best-effort, fail-closed helper that reads a named cookie from a request-like object, returning None on missing/malformed input. <!--#61826ca40012c71a-->
- `SessionStore` (class) — Thread-safe, in-memory table of hashed, expiring sessions keyed by session-id hash, providing create/resolve/destroy/sweep operations. <!--#cb3f9ac1c88e95b1-->
  - `SessionStore.__init__` (method) — Initializes the store with a TTL, cookie config, injectable clock, empty session dict, and a lock. <!--#0b8b8aab7201d1e2-->
  - `SessionStore.cookie_config` (method) — Property exposing the store's CookieConfig. <!--#7a7d3c67f0add4a8-->
  - `SessionStore.create` (method) — Mints a new session for an owner, returning the plaintext session id (cookie value) plus the stored hash-only Session. <!--#1d7f5f94d8a13d82-->
  - `SessionStore.resolve` (method) — Resolves a presented session-id plaintext to a live Session via hash lookup, constant-time compare, and expiry check, evicting expired ones. <!--#569b377aa1f11fde-->
  - `SessionStore.destroy` (method) — Idempotently invalidates a single session by its plaintext id (logout). <!--#d991cc867c95d63f-->
  - `SessionStore.destroy_owner` (method) — Invalidates all sessions belonging to an owner (e.g. on account disable) and returns the count removed. <!--#1ca7efc34f2a4fdc-->
  - `SessionStore.sweep_expired` (method) — Prunes all expired sessions from the table and returns how many were removed. <!--#59bf4dc9b4eb8817-->
  - `SessionStore.__len__` (method) — Returns the current number of stored sessions under the lock. <!--#0852865572e6c842-->
- `SessionAuthProvider` (class) — AuthProvider base class that resolves the current owner from the session cookie, shared by all providers whose login establishes a server-side session. <!--#492550690251601d-->
  - `SessionAuthProvider.__init__` (method) — Initializes the provider with the owner store and the SessionStore. <!--#3b6497b6377e6176-->
  - `SessionAuthProvider.sessions` (method) — Property exposing the provider's SessionStore. <!--#4282f203f8e12aba-->
  - `SessionAuthProvider.store` (method) — Property exposing the provider's owner store. <!--#2a6b2d7f5dc053b4-->
  - `SessionAuthProvider.resolve_owner` (method) — Reads the session cookie, resolves it to a session and owner, and returns an OwnerIdentity (failing closed and dropping the session if the owner is gone). <!--#a647ecb75f2dd934-->
  - `SessionAuthProvider.logout` (method) — Idempotently destroys the session referenced by the request's cookie. <!--#41bf329b337e43e8-->

## `src/se3/server/static/` — The browser-side asset bundle for the SE3 WebUI control plane — an index.html shell (topbar, login gate, machines/flows layout), the app.js single-page runtime that drives i18n, WebSocket/polling updates, list rendering and the running-flow chat with human-in-the-loop intervention, a dark-theme style.css covering every view down to a mobile breakpoint, and an i18n/ directory of per-locale translation catalogues. <!--#548291353c30de2c|85d537f24b85a342-->

### `src/se3/server/static/app.js` (text) — The single-file vanilla-JS frontend for the SE3 web dashboard SPA: it holds the global `state` object, a localStorage-backed I18N runtime with server-fetched locale manifests, a reconnecting WebSocket client that applies pushed machine/history/interjection frames, diff-aware signature-gated renderers for the machine list, flow list, issue panels and flow sidebar, and the full-screen running-flow chat view with its epoch-guarded conversation loader, scroll-anchor preservation, progression self-heal grace timer, and intervention chip / docked reply-box console for answering pending calls. <!--#8afbe8c14da242ee|d6992526bb4d7da9-->
- `chunk:1` (chunk) [degraded:chunk] — File header and the opening of the global `state` object, documenting the SPA's purpose (realtime dashboard + full-screen flow chat view) and the auth/identity, machine/flow-selection, and running-flow conversation progress/signature/epoch/follow-bottom state fields. <!--#7985ffdf5c623fc5-->
- `chunk:2` (chunk) [degraded:chunk] — Continuation of the `state` object: pending-Send settle bookkeeping, interjection lifecycle tracking (phases, local synthetic interjections, consumed afterimages), reply-context expand/scroll/full-prompt UI caches, diff-aware render-signature cache, and issue-management filter/state fields. <!--#11cc7111bcb620d9-->

### `src/se3/server/static/index.html` (text) — The single-page HTML shell for the SE3 WebUI control plane, declaring the localized topbar (version badge, live connection status, language selector, hamburger overflow menu with auth-only/admin-only nav buttons), the login gate with password and break-glass admin token forms, and the main machines/flows layout that app.js hydrates at runtime. <!--#c2d7b1097493be46|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

## `src/se3/server/static/i18n/` — Directory holding the WebUI's front-end translation bundles — one flat JSON catalogue per locale (en-US, zh-CN) mapping dot-namespaced UI keys (nav, login, machines, flows, history, issues, modals, common) to localized labels, placeholders and messages, loaded at runtime by the browser i18n layer. <!--#a9fb096db317f602|28c83650b99af4c6-->

### `src/se3/server/static/i18n/zh-CN.json` (json) — Simplified-Chinese translation catalog for the SE3 WebUI, mapping flat dot-namespaced UI string keys (nav, login, machines, flows, history, issues, modals, dialogs, etc.) to their zh-CN display text, as the locale counterpart to en-US.json. <!--#2005b513d4de7337|5772dbad3116f6a4-->
