  - `TestDetectConfirmationPrompt.test_options_parsed_from_enumerated_line` (method) — Asserts numbered choices in an enumerated prompt line are parsed into the returned options list. <!--#ec624a6d740380e6-->
- `TestInteractionCalls` (class) — Test class covering the interaction_calls file-based protocol: writing cli_confirm call files, context placement of flow_id/step_id, and reading responses. <!--#412c1c6cf870d146-->
  - `TestInteractionCalls.test_write_creates_cli_confirm_call_file` (method) — Asserts write_interaction_call creates a JSON call file under se3/calls with the expected kind, prompt, options, and flow_id fields. <!--#dc3d905fc49e8fac-->
  - `TestInteractionCalls.test_handler_writes_flow_id_in_context` (method) — Asserts make_cli_confirm_handler stores flow_id/step_id/awaiting inside the call's context (not as top-level keys) so the daemon's per-flow filter can scope calls. <!--#e278efff2f800345-->
  - `TestInteractionCalls.test_response_unanswered_returns_none` (method) — Asserts read_interaction_response returns None when no response sibling file has been written yet. <!--#7f95310d05a7713e-->
  - `TestInteractionCalls.test_response_plain_sibling` (method) — Asserts read_interaction_response returns the text of a plain .response sibling file. <!--#faf0faf45cfbaeee-->
  - `TestInteractionCalls.test_response_json_envelope` (method) — Asserts read_interaction_response extracts the response value from a .response.json envelope file. <!--#56ff34f441a3d892-->
- `_run_child` (function) — Test helper that runs an inline Python child script through ClaudeCodeRunner._run_single_with_monitor with a given on_confirm handler. <!--#9698841f52f7fe04-->
- `TestOnConfirmWiring` (class) — Test class verifying on_confirm is wired through the monitor: prompts are answered via stdin, missing responses don't hang, unrecognized output is a no-op, and run_with_monitor accepts the parameter. <!--#567aa8dd15abe631-->
  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_confirm_prompt_answered_via_stdin` (method) — Asserts a child's confirm prompt triggers a call file that, once answered by a responder thread, feeds the response back to the child via stdin. <!--#1d4918b0a84d10aa-->
  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_child_exits_before_response_does_not_hang` (method) — Asserts that when a child prints a confirm prompt then exits without a response ever arriving, the monitor finishes promptly instead of blocking. <!--#0d43fa546dac2d14-->
  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_unrecognized_output_is_noop` (method) — Asserts JSON and ordinary prose output never invoke the on_confirm handler and the run completes normally. <!--#294723f4eaf0facf-->
  - `TestOnConfirmWiring.test_run_with_monitor_passes_on_confirm` (method) — Asserts the public run_with_monitor entry point accepts and threads through the on_confirm keyword argument without raising. <!--#ea1fb8f532c0348d-->

### `tests/test_code_index.py` (python) — Test suite for the code-index subsystem, exercising gitignore-respecting file enumeration, deterministic AST/structural symbol extraction with per-symbol fingerprints, and the incremental bottom-up build_index lifecycle (first-build summarises all, unchanged rebuilds skip the LLM, only changed symbols re-summarise, human corrections and checkpointed partials survive, deletions prune and additions summarise) using a RecordingSummarizer test-double instead of a real LLM. <!--#700a1a6160680d39|e4e3f933ba56d660-->
- `_git` (function) — Helper that runs a git subcommand in a given root directory, failing the test on nonzero exit. <!--#a44a1342750ce397-->
- `_init_git_project` (function) — Helper that initializes a git repo in a directory with a test user identity. <!--#6aabffa4b0cbf3dc-->
- `_commit_all` (function) — Helper that stages and commits all files in a test repo with an optional message. <!--#244569aab0134277-->
- `RecordingSummarizer` (class) — A test-double summariser that records each batch of target ids and returns deterministic `S:<name>` summaries without ever calling the LLM, with helpers (`all`, `last`, `call_count`, `reset`) to assert what work a build performed. <!--#b2000ca60427e31b-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.__init__` (method) — Initializes the recorder's list of per-call batches. <!--#2eb12aaa30d04499-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.__call__` (method) — Records the batch's target ids and returns a deterministic summary per target. <!--#69dbd4374dad21fb-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.all` (method) — Property returning the union of all target ids across every recorded batch. <!--#c9050c58a5dd1c51-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.last` (method) — Property returning the ids from the most recent batch (empty if none). <!--#c2e6d1003cf9f412-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.call_count` (method) — Property returning how many batches the summariser has been invoked with. <!--#da34ef5d0cc65b1d-->
  - `RecordingSummarizer.reset` (method) — Clears the recorded batches (but not the on-disk md) so a test can isolate the work of a subsequent incremental build. <!--#1a52be09125e131c-->
- `project` (function) — Pytest fixture building a git-initialized sample project with source, README, gitignored files, and an se3-exclusion .gitignore. <!--#7bbbf049229b799a-->
- `TestFileEnum` (class) — Tests for file enumeration: gitignore/se3 exclusion, untracked pickup, explicit excludes, exclude matching, and binary detection. <!--#3f9745dd6015d644-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_enumerate_respects_gitignore_and_excludes_se3` (method) — Asserts enumeration includes tracked source but excludes gitignored files and the se3/ runtime directory. <!--#b19634138c370050-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_new_untracked_file_picked_up` (method) — Asserts a brand-new uncommitted, non-ignored file is enumerated via git --others. <!--#347b72b0ab6ec767-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_explicit_exclude_list` (method) — Asserts an explicitly passed exclude path is omitted while other files remain. <!--#fd34608a273ac211-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_matches_exclude_dir_and_basename` (method) — Asserts matches_exclude handles glob basenames and directory-name patterns with/without trailing slash. <!--#e84d1255bd7877c3-->
  - `TestFileEnum.test_is_binary` (method) — Asserts is_binary flags null-byte blobs as binary while text and empty files are not. <!--#f7ff6773910afa02-->
- `TestExtraction` (class) — Tests for deterministic structural/AST symbol extraction across Python, Markdown, YAML, and JSON. <!--#f4abb939fe6ee0af-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_python_drills_to_function_method` (method) — Asserts Python extraction yields top-level functions, classes, and methods but not nested inner functions. <!--#f70bde78ac49b386-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_markdown_headings` (method) — Asserts Markdown extraction yields headings with correct depth levels. <!--#9654d6c0a895e72e-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_yaml_top_keys` (method) — Asserts YAML extraction yields only top-level keys. <!--#12c5004656279e68-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_json_top_keys` (method) — Asserts JSON extraction yields only top-level keys. <!--#37c939c5af9329a7-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_structured_keys_carry_value_content` (method) — Asserts JSON/YAML top-level key symbols carry their nested value content for the summariser, not just the key. <!--#2a5f6f66a19a9830-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_make_target_summarizes_json_key_from_value` (method) — Asserts _make_target feeds a JSON key's value content to the summariser even when its line range is zero. <!--#f0c6a123355c1dfb-->
  - `TestExtraction.test_symbol_fingerprint_changes_with_content` (method) — Asserts a symbol's sha256 fingerprint changes when its body content changes. <!--#e14d1e4323c9ee2c-->
- `TestBuild` (class) — Test suite verifying the incremental build_index lifecycle: first-build summarises everything, unchanged rebuilds skip the LLM, only changed symbols are re-summarised, human md corrections survive, deleted files are pruned and new ones added, --force re-summarises all, summaries are synthesised bottom-up from children, and a mid-build crash leaves a resumable partial md. <!--#42efd8fed55117a9-->
  - `TestBuild.test_first_build_summarizes_all` (method) — Asserts a first build writes the authoritative md and summarises every file node and symbol, with a complete symbol map. <!--#bd85cd75a3c97668-->
  - `TestBuild.test_unchanged_rebuild_skips_llm` (method) — Asserts an unchanged rebuild produces no targets and does not re-invoke the summariser. <!--#5982a0bf9875c125-->
  - `TestBuild.test_changed_symbol_only_resummarized` (method) — Asserts a body-only edit re-summarises ONLY the edited symbol, since files/dirs gate on their symbol-roster list-fp (unchanged), leaving untouched siblings reused. <!--#5f050dd08968911b-->
  - `TestBuild.test_human_correction_preserved` (method) — Asserts a human-edited summary in the authoritative md survives a subsequent rebuild. <!--#45312508a4c3c2a0-->
  - `TestBuild.test_deleted_file_pruned_new_added` (method) — Asserts a deleted file is pruned from the index and a newly added module (with its symbols) is summarised. <!--#86523e7dd2a7c086-->
  - `TestBuild.test_force_resummarizes_everything` (method) — Asserts `force=True` ignores fingerprints and re-summarises every node. <!--#ee4d534a8d89d440-->
  - `TestBuild.test_summary_is_bottom_up` (method) — Asserts each node is summarised from its children's summaries — a file from its symbols' summaries (not raw source) and a directory from its child files' summaries — by capturing the content fed to the summariser. <!--#fcd5f8d30f57aec2-->
  - `TestBuild.test_checkpoint_flushes_partial_md_for_resume` (method) — Asserts a crash mid-build flushes a partial md with real fingerprints so already-summarised nodes are reused (not re-summarised) when the build resumes with a working summariser. <!--#b9b4a0ccd40fecc3-->
  - `TestBuild.test_checkpoint_flush_preserves_unchanged_file_fingerprints` (method) — Asserts a checkpoint flush preserves both fingerprints of an unchanged file not yet reached before the crash, so an interrupted build never blanks it and forces a needless re-summarisation. <!--#82a17fc3e15d60c9-->
  - `TestBuild.test_binary_file_is_file_level_only` (method) — Asserts a binary file is indexed file-level only (kind `binary`, no symbols, a 'binary' summary) and is never sent to the LLM. <!--#038d71b5868cd8f6-->
  - `TestBuild.test_load_or_build_alias` (method) — Asserts load_or_build builds and returns a populated index like build_index. <!--#1cb8b3fcc38e6c60-->
- `TestListFp` (class) — Test suite for the list-fingerprint reuse semantics: body edits touch only the symbol, roster changes (add/rename/re-kind) touch the file but not ancestor dirs, reorders touch nothing, dir membership changes touch only that dir, symbol-less files fall back to content-fp, --force cascades everything, and legacy single-fp md migrates for free. <!--#a230e3645d4aa301-->
  - `TestListFp.test_body_only_change_resummarises_symbol_only` (method) — Acceptance (a): a body-only edit re-summarises only the edited symbol while its file and all ancestor dirs reuse their cached summaries. <!--#d38332c56a3e13a5-->
  - `TestListFp.test_new_symbol_resummarises_symbol_and_file_not_dir` (method) — Acceptance (b): adding a symbol re-summarises that symbol and its file (roster grew) but not the parent dir (dir roster unchanged). <!--#364e99ebacf433b6-->
  - `TestListFp.test_renamed_symbol_resummarises_file_not_dir` (method) — Acceptance (b): renaming a symbol changes the file roster so the file and renamed symbol are re-summarised, but the parent dir is left untouched. <!--#b9c0b8820332d908-->
  - `TestListFp.test_kind_change_same_name_resummarises_file` (method) — Acceptance (b) kind component: changing a symbol's kind while keeping its name flips the roster's (kind,name) entry so the file is re-summarised, locking in the kind half of the list-fp while ancestors reuse. <!--#863a259a97a483e9-->
  - `TestListFp.test_reorder_symbols_no_resummary` (method) — Asserts the file list-fp is order-insensitive: reordering unchanged symbols leaves the sorted (kind,name) roster identical, so the file is not re-summarised. <!--#7a442e60e5fef6fb-->
  - `TestListFp.test_dir_membership_change_resummarises_dir_not_ancestors` (method) — Acceptance (c): adding a file to a subdir re-summarises only that subdir while ancestor dirs (unchanged direct rosters) reuse. <!--#8892d8b43ac45c46-->
  - `TestListFp.test_dir_child_removal_resummarises_dir_not_ancestors` (method) — Acceptance (c): removing a direct child re-summarises only that dir, with ancestors reusing their cached summaries. <!--#2e756c050505c2e9-->
  - `TestListFp.test_symbolless_file_content_edit_resummarises_file` (method) — Asserts a symbol-less file (whose constant empty list-fp would freeze it) falls back to the content-fp so a body rewrite re-summarises the file node without cascading to its parent dir. <!--#ab7ae377cb1104bf-->
  - `TestListFp.test_force_cascades_whole_content` (method) — Acceptance (d): --force ignores list-fps and re-summarises every node (symbols, files, all dirs) — the whole-content cascade. <!--#833cdfa38c84ef6f-->
  - `TestListFp.test_lazy_migration_reuses_old_md_zero_llm` (method) — Acceptance (e): a legacy single-fp md is reused for free (zero LLM) on the first rebuild, carrying old summaries forward while mechanically backfilling list-fps into the rewritten md. <!--#beefd5d4321255bc-->
- `TestDegrade` (class) — Tests for degrade-mode handling: the three-condition gate, large structureless chunking, and the oversized-structured size-cap guard. <!--#bf4f5bfdbd02d7a7-->
  - `TestDegrade._cfg` (method) — Helper returning a CodeIndexConfig with small degrade/chunk thresholds for testing. <!--#c8e5f33b8fbd6232-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_gate_requires_all_three` (method) — Asserts is_degrade_eligible only triggers when the file is large AND structureless under the configured thresholds. <!--#63f3e02c31203b39-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_large_structureless_file_chunks_with_marker` (method) — Asserts a large structureless file is chunked into degraded symbols and rendered with the degraded marker. <!--#2b74dcef5ab6f24d-->
  - `TestDegrade.test_oversized_structured_file_drops_to_file_level` (method) — Asserts an oversized but structured module is dropped to a single file-level entry rather than enumerated or chunked. <!--#1d8fcdfeec24c916-->
- `TestSummaryFlatten` (class) — Tests that multi-line summaries collapse to a single line and survive the md round-trip. <!--#b2bde80acac06f04-->
  - `TestSummaryFlatten.test_flatten_collapses_newlines` (method) — Asserts _flatten_summary collapses newlines and surrounding whitespace into single spaces. <!--#ab6d2246457f511d-->
  - `TestSummaryFlatten.test_newline_summary_survives_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts a multi-line LLM summary becomes one md line and is fully recoverable when parsed back. <!--#5a7a705238559cd1-->
- `TestRender` (class) — Test suite for the rendering/round-trip surface: the adaptive root view lists files and dir summaries (not symbols), dir summaries survive the md round-trip and reuse independently per directory, path drill-in shows symbols or member files, and the md is self-sufficient (no json sidecar) with embedded node fingerprints. <!--#2d6b8e5df29ed89b-->
  - `TestRender.test_adaptive_lists_files_not_symbols` (method) — Asserts the adaptive root view lists file paths but omits function-level symbol bullets. <!--#3a9f305d5f06945b-->
  - `TestRender.test_adaptive_shows_directory_summaries` (method) — Asserts directory nodes carry a one-line summary in both the index and the rendered adaptive view. <!--#8866e3dbd8fb098f-->
  - `TestRender.test_dir_summary_survives_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts directory summaries are recovered when loading the index from md for display. <!--#ee68cec64066e110-->
  - `TestRender.test_unchanged_sibling_dir_summary_reused` (method) — Asserts directory reuse is independent: adding a root-level file re-summarises only the root dir while an untouched sibling dir reuses its cached summary. <!--#74db031d2bd31040-->
  - `TestRender.test_dir_summary_not_refreshed_on_member_content_change` (method) — Asserts a pure content edit inside a file does not re-summarise ancestor directories in normal mode (dir list-fp unchanged), while --force restores the content-fp cascade. <!--#9cdc786c3b7e6d2a-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_file_shows_symbols` (method) — Asserts rendering a file path drills in to show its symbols. <!--#f9f2651ef457e2b5-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_directory_lists_files` (method) — Asserts rendering a directory path lists its files but not symbols. <!--#103aa80577e34bba-->
  - `TestRender.test_render_path_unknown` (method) — Asserts rendering an unknown path returns a no-entry message. <!--#4189b5fab8c22573-->
  - `TestRender.test_load_for_display_reads_md_round_trip` (method) — Asserts load_for_display reconstructs files, symbols, and summaries from the md. <!--#a6777337f0918b65-->
  - `TestRender.test_md_is_self_sufficient_for_incremental_rebuild` (method) — Asserts the committed md alone (no json sidecar) drives incremental rebuilds, doing zero LLM work on an unchanged tree and still rendering on its own. <!--#0b846c6a84748720-->
  - `TestRender.test_md_embeds_node_fingerprints` (method) — Asserts every rendered file/dir line carries a 16-hex content-fp (plus optional list-fp) comment that is stripped from the parsed summary, with list-fps present on file nodes but never on symbol bullets. <!--#61a973974e58fdfc-->
- `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip` (class) — Test suite for the trailing fingerprint-comment format: parsing/emitting the content-fp plus optional list-fp for file/dir lines, staying byte-compatible with the legacy single-fp form, and round-tripping both fps through render→parse without leaking list-fps onto symbol or unsummarised nodes. <!--#9a78389cb4fd1b33-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_legacy_single_fp` (method) — Asserts _split_fp parses a legacy single-fp comment into the bare line, its content-fp, and a None list-fp. <!--#0a284f89a1837f08-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_double_fp` (method) — Asserts _split_fp parses a double-fp comment into the bare line plus both the content-fp and list-fp. <!--#ac47db626361c765-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_split_fp_no_comment` (method) — Asserts _split_fp on a line with no fp comment returns the line unchanged and both fingerprints as None. <!--#6fa04f77e6cf5f79-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_fp_comment_round_trip` (method) — Asserts _fp_comment emits the legacy shape for a content-fp alone and the double shape when a list-fp is given, with an empty list-fp falling back to the legacy single-fp shape. <!--#243d087196d48359-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_render_parse_round_trip` (method) — Asserts render_full→_parse_md restores both fingerprints for every summarised file/dir node while symbol nodes carry only a content-fp and never a list-fp. <!--#e08ee95555fe3faa-->
  - `TestDoubleFpRoundTrip.test_unsummarised_node_embeds_no_fp` (method) — Asserts a node with no summary embeds neither fingerprint, keeping a partial md a safe resume point (treated as stale next build). <!--#dc911f1aee89a427-->
- `TestCodeIndexCLI` (class) — Test class exercising the `se3 code-index` CLI end-to-end against a project built with a fake (non-LLM) summariser, verifying the literal/adaptive root views, path-based drill-down, `show`/`index`/`rebuild --force`/`inspect` behaviors, unbuilt-project error hints, and that bare invocation renders the adaptive map instead of Typer's missing-command error. <!--#292cee0822288f61-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.built_project` (method) — Fixture that builds the code-index md with a fake summariser and points `get_project_root` at the project so CLI commands resolve to it. <!--#7321282503a01e9e-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_no_arg_renders_literal_root_level` (method) — Asserts `index` with no path shows the literal root level (collapsed top dirs + root files) and not one level deeper. <!--#edc365a4d57e8902-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_bare_invocation_renders_adaptive_map` (method) — Asserts bare `code-index` renders the adaptive root map (expanding code roots) instead of Typer's 'Missing command' error. <!--#6ddcb755282417b4-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_bare_invocation_unbuilt_errors_without_missing_command` (method) — Asserts bare invocation on an unbuilt project exits 1 with a rebuild hint, not a Typer 'Missing command' error. <!--#ac7cc4197dcec319-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_with_path_drills_into_file` (method) — Asserts `code-index index <file>` drills into the file and shows its symbols. <!--#4f69a162e138f230-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_with_directory_lists_files` (method) — Asserts `code-index index <dir>` lists the directory's files but not symbols. <!--#4f5c778c008153a0-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_show_pulls_function_level` (method) — Asserts `code-index show <file>` surfaces function/method-level symbols. <!--#7230267ab2ce3244-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_index_unbuilt_errors` (method) — Asserts `code-index index` on an unbuilt project exits 1 with a rebuild hint. <!--#7aea579c8081593f-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_rebuild_force_full_rebuild` (method) — Verifies that `code-index rebuild --force` performs a full re-summarisation (using a monkeypatched fake summariser so no LLM is hit), reports "full rebuild", re-processes all symbols, and leaves the authoritative code-index md on disk. <!--#d0b605fc3d17ea3f-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_inspect_reports_stats` (method) — Asserts `code-index inspect` reports file and symbol counts. <!--#33f9ddf5a766d99e-->
  - `TestCodeIndexCLI.test_help_mentions_md_authoritative_product` (method) — Asserts the CLI help names se3/code-index.md as the authoritative product. <!--#f0dfd18b15028925-->
- `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety` (class) — Test suite asserting the incremental rebuild serializes across processes via an advisory lock, writes atomically through unique temp files, and degrades gracefully when fcntl is unavailable. <!--#d88bd69f4ce7928d-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_atomic_write_uses_unique_temp_no_fixed_leftover` (method) — Asserts the atomic md write leaves no fixed-name or stray `*.tmp` scratch files behind. <!--#7261ab11746a1c58-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_build_lock_serializes_concurrent_builds` (method) — Asserts two concurrent threaded builds both complete and produce a valid, parseable map under the advisory lock. <!--#92c9adacab9014cb-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_build_proceeds_unlocked_when_fcntl_unavailable` (method) — Asserts the build still runs best-effort when fcntl locking is unavailable. <!--#c7ce193e0880ea44-->
  - `TestConcurrentRebuildSafety.test_lock_path_lives_under_gitignored_cache` (method) — Asserts the build lock file is named `code-index.lock` and lives under the gitignored `se3/cache` directory. <!--#b1f579f6ea274ac3-->

### `tests/test_codex_runner.py` (python) — Unit tests for the CodexRunner module, verifying CodexEventConverter's mapping of codex `exec --json` events (agent_message, command_execution, file_change, etc.) into Claude NDJSON, plus CodexRunner's argument building, infra-error detection, subprocess lifecycle via mocks, and LLMCaller registration. <!--#8e564ce4cd9a5997|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_commit_step.py` (python) — Unit tests for the COMMIT step handler (commit_handler), covering graceful recovery from versionless/unparseable version files, verbatim writing of the LLM-supplied suggested_version (bypassing bump_type recomputation), and FAILED-with-guided-error behavior when suggested_version is missing or blank. <!--#0d6c6a092120d96f|646b03b8544ffc07-->
- `temp_dir` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a fresh temporary directory Path that serves as the project root for each test. <!--#aa41b08e2a7ac2e1-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal FlowInstance whose change_path parent equals the given temp_dir, with a configurable task_type. <!--#df77e370fec9d9e9-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal COMMIT Step pre-populated with task_description, suggested_version, and bump_type inputs. <!--#40c0069baf1d4540-->
- `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile` (class) — Test class asserting commit_handler recovers (initializes/bumps) rather than crashing when a version file exists without a parseable version. <!--#ff7cbba6471c0e98-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_initializes_version_when_read_raises_value_error` (method) — Test that a versionless pyproject.toml causing read_version to raise ValueError leads commit_handler to initialize and bump rather than fail. <!--#735314a035d6c0d4-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_version_is_readable_after_recovery` (method) — Test that after recovering from a versionless file, the pyproject.toml holds a readable (non-None) version. <!--#b52e3d8fbb10b471-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_init_py_without_version_does_not_crash` (method) — Test that a Python project with a versionless __init__.py completes the commit step without raising ValueError. <!--#5d1da2675ad6f147-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerVersionlessFile.test_normal_version_file_still_works` (method) — Test that a pyproject.toml with a valid version still completes and records a bumped version output. <!--#7032d1533739de87-->
- `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven` (class) — Test class asserting commit_handler writes the LLM-supplied suggested_version verbatim, bypassing bump_type recomputation. <!--#49eb1fc69e8c9b46-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven.test_suggested_version_written_verbatim_to_pyproject` (method) — Test that suggested_version='9.4.2' is written exactly to pyproject.toml even when bump_type would compute a different value. <!--#29c9c05dfa1ed3b8-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerSuggestedVersionDriven.test_suggested_version_supports_major_jump` (method) — Test that suggested_version can skip versions (e.g., 1.2.3 → 3.0.0) when the LLM dictates it. <!--#9fe2c664b45459f7-->
- `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion` (class) — Test class asserting commit_handler returns FAILED with a guided error message when suggested_version is absent or blank. <!--#fc0af8cc0c77c918-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion.test_missing_suggested_version_raises_with_current_version` (method) — Test that an absent suggested_version yields FAILED with an error referencing suggested_version, current version state, and human-intervention guidance. <!--#87954cbc7b1d410c-->
  - `TestCommitHandlerMissingSuggestedVersion.test_empty_string_suggested_version_raises` (method) — Test that a whitespace-only suggested_version is treated as missing and produces a FAILED result mentioning suggested_version. <!--#69f6d568a6bc882c-->

### `tests/test_config.py` (python) — Unit test suite for se3.config's WorkflowConfig and related helpers, exhaustively verifying from_dict/load parsing, default fallbacks, string/bool/float coercion, and ConfigError validation for the max_fix_iterations, self_check_passes_required, self_check_convergence_enabled, adjudicate_period, and baseline_fix_max_attempts settings. <!--#b61e25661d6ac263|5c88d10c75ad4aa4-->
- `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict` (class) — Test suite for WorkflowConfig.from_dict, verifying default fallbacks, custom overrides, string/bool coercion, and validation errors for the max_fix_iterations, self_check_passes_required, self_check_convergence_enabled, and adjudicate_period workflow settings. <!--#80debf1cdc60a3f5-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_empty_dict_returns_defaults` (method) — Asserts an empty dict yields all default config values. <!--#f2ed21774898e0f8-->

  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_convergence_enabled_string_true` (method) — Asserts the string 'true' coerces to boolean True. <!--#08ae92b294db922e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_convergence_enabled_string_false` (method) — Asserts the string 'false' coerces to boolean False. <!--#2aadf16e22dca0bc-->

  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_zero_raises` (method) — Asserts self_check_passes_required of 0 raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#4b93eb514cd94333-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_negative_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative self_check_passes_required raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#6b51b557010e4e4b-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_zero_string_raises` (method) — Asserts the string '0' for self_check_passes_required raises ConfigError ('must be >= 1'). <!--#4f89af59c2ac1d76-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_float_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts float self_check_passes_required values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#15fdd6b2fe525fa5-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_passes_required_bool_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts boolean self_check_passes_required values warn and fall back to the default instead of coercing to int. <!--#e79094dbfe5e558e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_all_fields_custom` (method) — Asserts all three workflow fields are read correctly when custom values are supplied together. <!--#f00ec665dbe9a20e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_invalid_max_fix_iterations_falls_back_to_default` (method) — Asserts a non-integer max_fix_iterations falls back to the default. <!--#3dad8d50f53cb303-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_default_value_is_100` (method) — Asserts DEFAULT_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS and the field default are both 100. <!--#bcb1193b0c9929db-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_zero_sentinel` (method) — Asserts max_fix_iterations of 0 is preserved as the 'unlimited' sentinel. <!--#e98ef8da6de8af0b-->

  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_string_zero_preserved` (method) — Asserts the string '0' for max_fix_iterations coerces to the sentinel int 0. <!--#05b0bd12de2822c5-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_negative_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative max_fix_iterations raises ConfigError ('must be >= 0') rather than acting as the sentinel. <!--#6c0a33384d93e6fc-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_negative_string_raises` (method) — Asserts a string-shaped negative max_fix_iterations raises ConfigError ('must be >= 0'). <!--#562caffaf9d8cc9e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_max_fix_iterations_bool_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts boolean max_fix_iterations values warn and fall back to the default. <!--#51945d355efd2e1e-->
  - `TestWorkflowConfigFromDict.test_adjudicate_period_default_is_10` (method) — Asserts adjudicate_period defaults to 10 via the constant, the default constructor, and from_dict({}). <!--#95e3bb60a5796557-->

### `tests/test_confirm_answer_interpretation.py` (python) — Test module locking in how free-text CONFIRM-gate replies (English and Chinese approval/rejection words, plus ambiguous text like '1') are interpreted into (approved, feedback) and how the structured daemon response envelope drives the CONFIRM step state machine end-to-end. <!--#cacc9cbea47de70d|16085516fae4e547-->

- `test_unrecognized_text_is_conservative_revision` (function) — Parametrized test asserting unrecognized text is never silently approved but becomes a revision request (approved=False) carrying the original stripped text as feedback. <!--#94b887475ea0679a-->
- `test_empty_answer_defaults_to_not_approved` (function) — Asserts an empty answer defaults to approved=False with no feedback. <!--#e191b4aff296d79c-->
- `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd` (class) — End-to-end test class verifying that the daemon's `{"response": {approved, feedback}}` envelope (or nested free-text) is unwrapped by `_check_confirm_response` and correctly drives the CONFIRM step's state machine. <!--#176407ac2dac9ecf-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.setup_method` (method) — Fixture that builds a temp project with a PAUSED FlowInstance whose CONFIRM step reviews a completed PLAN step. <!--#3b16bc532bedc326-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.teardown_method` (method) — Fixture that removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#9a000d928b0a886c-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd._write_call_and_response` (method) — Helper that writes a confirm call file and its `<stem>.response.json` daemon response with the answer nested under a `response` key. <!--#01d8bad082da0728-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_dict_approved_drives_completed` (method) — Asserts a nested `{approved: True}` response drives the CONFIRM step to COMPLETED with matching review outputs and null revision feedback. <!--#3cd529ec030459c4-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_dict_rejected_drives_revision` (method) — Asserts a nested `{approved: False, feedback: "fix X"}` response drives the step to REVISION_NEEDED and propagates the feedback into review_result and revision_feedback. <!--#0efaf3bb1a2c8047-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_free_text_chinese_approval_drives_completed` (method) — Asserts a nested plain-string Chinese approval word ("同意") is recognized and drives the step to COMPLETED with approved=True. <!--#dc6ad6e184def0dd-->
  - `TestStructuredPayloadEndToEnd.test_inner_free_text_one_drives_revision_with_original_text` (method) — Asserts the ambiguous free-text "1" is not silently approved but drives REVISION_NEEDED with the original text preserved as revision feedback. <!--#e457d1bc0ef0e139-->

### `tests/test_confirm_call_payload.py` (python) — Test module covering the confirm-gate call payload — it builds minimal feature flows with plain or adjudicate confirm steps and asserts the written call file's kind/prompt/review-target fields, the baseline-vs-ruling diff anchor across adjudication rounds, robust degradation of malformed or absent `covered_surfaces`, the CLI gate's printing of each swept surface with its justification, and that the enriched file remains consumable by run.py's approval/rejection response handling. <!--#9ad0b6a45a57bdab|be17601f7b6553d2-->

- `_add_adjudicate_step` (function) — Test builder that appends a completed ADJUDICATE step to a flow with the given description/rationale, optionally omitting `covered_surfaces` entirely so legacy pre-sweep state files stay covered. <!--#10e7547ec4e896d9-->

- `test_plain_confirm_payload_has_kind_and_prompt` (function) — Asserts a plain (non-adjudicate) confirm call file carries kind='confirm', the legacy `type` discriminant, a non-empty prompt, review-target context, and none of the adjudicate-only fields. <!--#00306982906e4243-->
- `test_plain_confirm_payload_matches_by_step` (function) — Asserts the confirm call file still includes the 'step' key that the resume/consumer path matches on. <!--#11405ad155e6ac10-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_first_round_baseline_falls_back_to_original` (function) — Asserts that for a first-round adjudicate confirm the baseline falls back to the original task description while the post-ruling description/rationale come from the ruling. <!--#564dc97c803cc8c2-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_multi_round_baseline_is_prior_ruling` (function) — Asserts that in a two-round adjudication the baseline is the prior round's ruling (the reviewed round excluded) and the description is the current round's, locking the diff-anchor direction. <!--#d82060db096e01b2-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_prompt_mentions_ruling` (function) — Asserts the generated prompt for an adjudicate confirm mentions adjudication. <!--#f53b18c0325c48bf-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_carries_covered_surfaces` (function) — Asserts an adjudicate confirm call file passes the ruling's `covered_surfaces` (surface + justification) through verbatim to the human gate. <!--#0dc7b5efd1be6987-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_degrades_malformed_covered_surfaces` (function) — Parametrized test asserting malformed or legacy `covered_surfaces` values degrade to an empty list rather than breaking the confirm payload. <!--#57eac6a847f19c72-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_covered_surfaces_absent_from_outputs` (function) — Asserts an adjudicate ruling that never wrote `covered_surfaces` still yields an empty list in the payload instead of a missing key. <!--#aabfddcbd1b6be16-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_payload_drops_only_the_bad_entry` (function) — Asserts per-entry validation of `covered_surfaces` — an invalid entry is dropped while valid siblings survive. <!--#1f6fb5e8879ac216-->
- `test_adjudicate_confirm_prompt_mentions_covered_surfaces` (function) — Asserts `build_confirm_prompt` mentions coverage for the adjudicate step type but not for a plain plan confirm. <!--#22a597f6e8bca1d3-->
- `_drive_cli_confirm` (function) — Test helper that monkeypatches interjection draining and the interactive choice prompt so `run._handle_confirm_pause` can be driven to approve or reject non-interactively. <!--#90f3c126db4cda35-->
- `test_cli_confirm_prints_each_surface_and_justification` (function) — Asserts the CLI confirm gate prints every covered surface together with its justification, since a bare surface list would hide a wrong sweep from the approver. <!--#0d46fe4773b03a75-->
- `test_cli_confirm_reports_when_nothing_was_swept` (function) — Asserts the CLI confirm gate handles an empty `covered_surfaces` list by printing a 'nothing swept in' message instead of crashing. <!--#d63639abc023b847-->
- `test_cli_non_adjudicate_confirm_prints_no_surfaces_section` (function) — Asserts the CLI confirm gate omits the covered-surfaces section entirely for a non-adjudicate (plan) confirm. <!--#ba2d7819b11f0eba-->
- `test_enriched_call_file_still_consumable_by_check_confirm_response` (function) — Asserts the enriched call file still works with run.py:_check_confirm_response, driving COMPLETED from a structured approval wrapped in the daemon response envelope. <!--#b8cca2e43aff98e8-->
- `test_enriched_call_file_structured_rejection_routes_to_revision` (function) — Asserts a structured rejection response routes the confirm step to REVISION_NEEDED and preserves the feedback in review_result. <!--#48b6745b177403b3-->

### `tests/test_confirm_noninteractive.py` (python) — Test suite pinning the daemon-spawned (non-interactive, --output-format json) CONFIRM-pause fix, verifying the noninteractive confirm helper fail-safes the flow to PAUSED and persists engine.json's top-level status so the daemon can re-spawn it, while guarding the interactive TTY path (exit 130 on user-exit, approval writes a .response) from regressing. <!--#e629c92e1d099833|2b5e878908278f1d-->

- `test_helper_missing_call_file_still_pauses_failsafe` (function) — Asserts that with no call_file in outputs the helper fail-safes to PAUSED (and persists) while logging a warning. <!--#85508607601f6d9d-->
- `test_helper_call_file_path_but_not_on_disk_warns` (function) — Asserts that when the recorded call_file path is missing on disk the helper still warns and lands the flow in PAUSED. <!--#5a1cc6d9af44792b-->
- `_make_real_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a genuine FlowInstance with PLAN/CONFIRM/IMPLEMENT steps parked at a PAUSED CONFIRM step for end-to-end persistence tests. <!--#fa7f37841e68b44b-->
- `test_helper_persists_engine_json_top_level_status_paused` (function) — Asserts the helper writes engine.json with top-level status == PAUSED so the daemon's resume logic can re-spawn the flow. <!--#441b4edebe01163a-->
- `test_interactive_confirm_pause_user_exit_returns_none` (function) — Guardrail test that in non-json mode choosing "Exit (pause flow)" routes through _handle_confirm_pause and returns None (the run loop's 130-exit signal). <!--#e1a182d0c3849c2e-->
- `test_interactive_confirm_pause_approve_writes_response` (function) — Guardrail test that an interactive "Approve and continue" choice returns True and writes a .response sibling file marking approved=true. <!--#0ec5fd88389e8a2f-->
- `_FakeStateMachine` (class) — Minimal StateMachine stand-in whose run_step returns a preset result, letting the run loop reach the CONFIRM-PAUSED dispatch without a real state machine, git commit, or LLM call. <!--#ad900038f3d69701-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.__init__` (method) — Stores the canned step result and initializes the run_step call counter. <!--#70b4bfd7939f68c2-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.register_handler` (method) — No-op stub for handler registration. <!--#dca32cce72312cfd-->
  - `_FakeStateMachine.init_flow` (method) — No-op stub for flow initialization. <!--#7fb48acd14ccd8f3-->

### `tests/test_console_real_daemon_e2e.py` (python) — Isolated end-to-end acceptance test that stands up a real se3-server and se3 daemon from the current worktree on a private temp dir and dedicated loopback port (with strict guards against touching the user's real daemon), then proves the web-console rendering paradigm works on real daemon-produced history records over HTTP, the production app.js/node renderer, and headless Chromium, and that a CLI `se3 run --discover` pause can be answered from the web console to advance the same live process. <!--#8c082bca4d036982|0b6b9e6dee2a71d2-->
- `_server_deps_available` (function) — Capability probe returning True only when the optional server extra (fastapi/uvicorn/websockets) is importable, used to skip the whole module otherwise. <!--#7101c53861230d2b-->
- `_node_available` (function) — Capability probe returning whether the `node` binary is on PATH (for the app.js node-render sub-case). <!--#bae13743c6fd1b27-->
- `_free_port` (function) — Allocates and returns an ephemeral free 127.0.0.1 TCP port so the harness never collides with the user's real daemon. <!--#b7c34f218ce22bed-->
- `_http_get` (function) — Tiny helper that issues an HTTP GET and returns the parsed JSON body. <!--#5bdc3b21b2123641-->
- `_http_post` (function) — Tiny helper that POSTs a JSON payload and returns the parsed JSON response. <!--#1be85a426842a5f8-->
- `_poll` (function) — Generic retry helper that repeatedly calls a function until it returns a truthy value or the attempt budget is exhausted. <!--#ace3ca934d426f44-->
- `_IsolatedConsole` (class) — Harness class that owns the fully isolated instance — temp dirs, free port, seeded admin/auth, and the worktree-launched se3-server and se3 daemon subprocesses — with lifecycle and isolation-guard methods. <!--#23b359e0a64bd3d4-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.__init__` (method) — Constructs the isolated instance state: temp tree, daemon/project dirs, free port, base URL, log paths, sqlite store path, and auth placeholders. <!--#5901e9cfd3a58651-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._env` (method) — Builds the subprocess environment that pins PYTHONPATH to the worktree src and redirects SE3_DAEMON_DIR/HOME into the temp tree to guarantee isolation. <!--#32fbdc659182b915-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.assert_isolation_guards` (method) — Asserts every invariant that keeps the harness away from the user's real daemon (temp daemon dir, non-forbidden port, no stable-instance host/marker, loopback-only). <!--#7cf9e7c7ce2535e5-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._seed_admin_and_key` (method) — Seeds one admin owner with a password and an issued daemon key into the server sqlite store before the server subprocess opens it. <!--#f024c5782dbb3712-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._install_cookie_opener` (method) — Installs a urllib opener with a cookie jar so every HTTP call automatically carries the owner session cookie. <!--#6e0847d18b06bdb7-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._login` (method) — Logs the REST/browser client in as the seeded admin and captures the resulting `se3_session` cookie value. <!--#835418c232c683eb-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.start` (method) — Brings the whole isolated stack up in order: se3 init, seed admin/key, launch and health-check the server, log in, then launch the daemon (with external flow discovery disabled) and wait for it to connect. <!--#13c5ea3503b89612-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole._machine_online` (method) — Polls `/api/machines` and returns True once this harness's machine_id appears as online. <!--#b6a4f68c5d6728da-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.stop` (method) — Tears down both subprocesses (terminate then kill) and closes the log file handles. <!--#7965f2d2bbf6aaf4-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.logs` (method) — Returns the tail of the server and daemon log files for failure diagnostics. <!--#74fe8a28fd12ba6b-->
  - `_IsolatedConsole.flow_history` (method) — Fetches `/api/history/{flow_id}` and returns its list of records. <!--#e73ce55f7d7c6542-->
- `console` (function) — Pytest fixture that starts an `_IsolatedConsole`, yields it to the test, and guarantees clean teardown (subprocesses stopped, temp tree removed). <!--#fb9d06e084afa325-->
- `_write_real_history_flow` (function) — Writes a real-shaped multi-step history flow (discovery, step_completed event, group-suffixed implement, underscore version_analyze) whose messages deliberately omit `step_type`, leaving the daemon to derive it from file names. <!--#14feb0a657d8338b-->
- `test_harness_is_isolated_and_connected` (function) — Task 1 test asserting the instance is isolated (temp dir + dedicated port, no real-daemon bleed-through) and the worktree daemon/server are connected. <!--#32c1e5204237077c-->
- `test_real_daemon_injects_paradigm_step_type` (function) — Task 2 HTTP-layer test proving the real daemon injects the authoritative file-name-derived `step_type` onto each record while the inner message keeps its real (no-`step_type`) shape. <!--#9e6ec6e4ea397a6c-->
- `test_render_paradigm_via_appjs_on_real_records` (function) — Task 2 rendering test that feeds the real records through the production app.js renderer via a node helper and asserts paradigm step headers and a structured discovery card. <!--#6b843971d495bbf1-->
- `test_render_paradigm_in_headless_browser` (function) — Critical Task 2 browser acceptance test that loads the console in real headless Chromium, renders the real history records through production renderConversation, and asserts the DOM paradigm (failing loudly rather than skipping when Playwright/Chromium is unavailable). <!--#6beba69ff323d3c3-->
- `_write_fake_agent` (function) — Writes a deterministic fake Claude CLI agent that logs each invocation and returns a confirmation response for DISCOVERY prompts (pausing at the gate) and a no-op otherwise. <!--#3a39aa21c6042ed4-->
- `test_cli_discovery_pause_answered_from_web` (function) — Task 3 test that runs `se3 run --discover` under a PTY until it pauses, confirms the web console sees the pending discovery_confirm chip, answers it via `/respond`, and verifies the same live process advances and the stale chip clears. <!--#191296f035c9f63a-->

  - `TestSummarizeCompletionGate.test_completion_section_gate_only_when_verified_false` (method) — Asserts `_build_completion_section` emits gating text only when verified is False, else empty. <!--#0793a9bc1f8865f5-->

### `tests/test_daemon.py` (python) — Unit and integration tests for the SE3 daemon package — covering DaemonSupervisor registration/discovery/reaping/liveness, the `_cmdline_is_se3_run` / `_scan_external` predicates that distinguish genuine `se3 run` processes from inline `python -c` stubs, se3-command resolution, and the DaemonSpawner's argv construction, event parsing, and process lifecycle. <!--#87d841323943b166|8f85cac9eff4349d-->
- `_spawn_sleeper` (function) — Helper that starts a long-lived child sleep process for liveness/reaping tests. <!--#9f707aff1ef992dd-->
- `_make_engine_json` (function) — Helper that writes a minimal engine.json flow-state file under a fake project root. <!--#09ee4549be528c4f-->
- `_make_resumable_snapshot` (function) — Helper that writes a per-flow resumable snapshot under se3/state/resumable/. <!--#729fe115e994b596-->
- `_FakeClient` (class) — Minimal stand-in for DaemonClient exposing connected/last_error attributes. <!--#46848e89149937c9-->
  - `_FakeClient.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake client with given connected flag and last_error. <!--#4deadea26b6f64b5-->
- `TestSupervisor` (class) — Test class for DaemonSupervisor registration, discovery, reaping, liveness, and concurrency. <!--#ef5c28dcbde01cdf-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_register_and_get` (method) — Verifies register returns a record retrievable by pid with correct fields and count. <!--#a67e9126cba05c15-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_register_idempotent` (method) — Verifies re-registering the same pid updates fields without increasing count. <!--#e227d8b554d1347f-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_discover_and_reap_dead_process` (method) — Verifies a dead process is discovered then reaped, clearing it from the supervisor. <!--#2da4f921db7e0e79-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_exit_callback_fires_on_reap` (method) — Verifies an on_exit callback fires with the pid when a process is reaped. <!--#ff89adde164ac1f7-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_is_alive` (method) — Verifies is_alive reports true for the current process and false for an invalid pid. <!--#324adc33dfb0d39a-->
  - `TestSupervisor.test_concurrent_registration` (method) — Verifies concurrent registrations from multiple threads are all recorded without loss. <!--#6df556ae1fe213cf-->
- `_wait_until_psutil_observes` (function) — Test helper that blocks until psutil reports the given pid with a populated cmdline, ensuring `_scan_external` regression assertions scan an actually-observable process rather than passing vacuously. <!--#80edf2d300619c7e-->
- `_write_fake_se3` (function) — Test helper that writes an executable `se3`-named shebang script running a given body, reproducing the real shebang-rewritten console-script cmdline shape (se3 at argv[1]) for psutil to observe. <!--#1b2e881221742fc4-->
- `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run` (class) — Unit-test class asserting that `_cmdline_is_se3_run` matches only genuine `se3 run` launch shapes (console-script, shebang, module forms, with -c/--change) and rejects inline `python -c` stubs and non-immediate `run` subcommands. <!--#dede7480aa5e649e-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_inline_code_form_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts `python -c <code> se3 run` is rejected because se3/run are the inline script's argv, not an se3 subcommand (the ghost-session false positive). <!--#8d860a58d06824f2-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_direct_console_script_argv0` (method) — Asserts the direct console-script forms `se3 run --worktree` and `/venv/bin/se3 run` (se3 at argv[0]) match. <!--#5a0569a3c34856c9-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_shebang_rewritten_console_script_argv1` (method) — Asserts the shebang-rewritten shape `python3 /venv/bin/se3 run` (se3 at argv[1], psutil's real observation) matches. <!--#a7a0b142921f7106-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form` (method) — Asserts the module form `python -m se3 run` matches. <!--#c55cededece09adf-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_console_script_with_change_option` (method) — Asserts console-script `se3 run -c my-change ...` still matches, ensuring the CLI's own -c/--change option is not mistaken for an interpreter inline-code -c. <!--#278b56d3e4949801-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form_with_change_option` (method) — Asserts the module form `python -m se3 run -c my-change` matches, treating the trailing -c as the CLI option rather than interpreter inline code. <!--#59822652ba0bf299-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_inline_code_carrying_module_tokens_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts `python -c <code> -m se3 run` is rejected because the interpreter-mode -c disqualifies the stray module-form tokens in the script's argv. <!--#f517a836550e1cb3-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_se3_run_as_script_arguments_only` (method) — Asserts `python script.py se3 run` is rejected since se3/run appear only as script arguments with no -m se3 and no se3 program token. <!--#da91be689e785699-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_other_se3_subcommand_with_trailing_run_is_not_se3_run` (method) — Asserts `se3 migrate run` (across console-script, shebang, and module shapes) is rejected because `run` must be the immediate subcommand, not a nested one. <!--#ddeb2b005af70f90-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_empty_cmdline` (method) — Asserts an empty cmdline list returns False. <!--#e4b9f0686cf32343-->
  - `TestCmdlineIsSe3Run.test_module_form_without_run` (method) — Asserts `python -m se3` without a trailing `run` subcommand returns False. <!--#ca974ef32391e0a0-->
- `TestScanExternalDiscovery` (class) — Test class verifying `_scan_external`'s tightened cmdline predicate and scan-ignore marker: inline `python -c` stubs are rejected, genuine console-script se3 processes are registered, and default supervisors honour the SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE marker. <!--#0731bd670654b7c0-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_inline_code_se3_run_not_registered` (method) — Asserts that a `python -c ... se3 run` inline-code process, though observed by psutil, is rejected by the cmdline predicate and never registered as a flow. <!--#bc6855b45832740d-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_console_script_se3_run_registered` (method) — Asserts that a genuine console-script se3 stub (opted back into scanning) is discovered and registered as a flow once psutil observes its shebang-rewritten cmdline. <!--#92c469f6d31aa00f-->
  - `TestScanExternalDiscovery.test_scan_ignored_stub_not_registered_by_default_supervisor` (method) — Asserts a default `DaemonSupervisor()` honours the SE3_EXTERNAL_SCAN_IGNORE marker and skips registering a marked stub, guarding the `_proc_opted_out_of_scan` skip branch against regressions. <!--#8c4f04311406173f-->
- `TestResolveSe3Command` (class) — Test class for _resolve_se3_command's same-prefix-first resolution of the se3 argv prefix. <!--#3c0b953a21298ac3-->
  - `TestResolveSe3Command.test_prefers_sys_executable_prefix` (method) — Verifies the console script next to sys.executable is preferred over an unrelated PATH match. <!--#f8c55b4b81fee821-->
  - `TestResolveSe3Command.test_falls_back_to_module_form` (method) — Verifies fallback to [python, -m, se3] when no sibling se3 script exists. <!--#72366890fdc16088-->
- `fake_se3` (function) — Pytest fixture replacing the se3 command with a fake NDJSON-emitting script. <!--#9b8accbde61020dd-->
- `TestSpawner` (class) — Test class for DaemonSpawner argv construction, event parsing, termination, and reaping. <!--#6dda699c9b2a7b4a-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_starts_child` (method) — Verifies spawn launches a child with a valid pid and JSON output-format args. <!--#5a6b943bd6acf725-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_appends_discover_flag` (method) — Verifies spawn appends --discover when discover=True. <!--#49fbf23ab1212c81-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_omits_discover_flag_by_default` (method) — Verifies spawn omits --discover by default. <!--#ff960bb0bc38ae9d-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_appends_worktree_flag` (method) — Verifies spawn appends --worktree when worktree=True. <!--#2c2c153a9867f293-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_omits_worktree_flag_by_default` (method) — Verifies spawn omits --worktree by default. <!--#1cb4d5a659485f0b-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_appends_worktree` (method) — Verifies a from-issue spawn includes both --from-issue and --worktree flags. <!--#ddf39e96950885d6-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_builds_from_issue_argv` (method) — Verifies from-issue spawn builds --from-issue argv and excludes the task description and --type. <!--#76cf42595cf1f679-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_from_issue_appends_discover` (method) — Verifies a from-issue spawn includes both --from-issue and --discover flags. <!--#285baa8a9ee53073-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_iter_events_parses_ndjson` (method) — Verifies iter_events parses the child's NDJSON output into step/flow events. <!--#f191a845008c5479-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_registers_with_supervisor` (method) — Verifies a spawned child is registered with the supervisor and cleared on reap. <!--#f6684f8f9efdf1b5-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_terminate_sends_sigterm` (method) — Verifies terminate sends SIGTERM and stops a running child. <!--#d732720acabc44ba-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_spawn_high_volume_output_does_not_deadlock` (method) — Regression test that a child emitting >64KB of output finishes without pipe-buffer deadlock by logging to files. <!--#32c3418ef523636a-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_orphans_and_reap` (method) — Verifies a finished child stays tracked until reaped, then leaves no orphans. <!--#e3da9707158349c7-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_resume_builds_resume_argv` (method) — Verifies resume builds argv with --resume, --flow-id, the flow id, and JSON output. <!--#257e95e14cf61007-->
  - `TestSpawner.test_resume_registers_with_supervisor` (method) — Verifies a resumed flow's process is registered with the supervisor. <!--#84d48f635eb079b0-->
- `TestEnsureSe3Project` (class) — Test class for the pre-spawn auto-init hook ensure_se3_project used by the web New Task form. <!--#81830b5450fa652f-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_skips_init_when_already_se3_project` (method) — Verifies init is skipped (no subprocess) when se3/charter.md already exists. <!--#0219529e8e075e51-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_runs_init_on_empty_directory` (method) — Verifies an empty directory triggers an `se3 init -p <root>` subprocess. <!--#ca26ec87db7374fd-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_returns_error_on_nonzero_exit` (method) — Verifies a non-zero init exit code surfaces as an error string without raising. <!--#221109b29c4a6f35-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_returns_error_when_marker_missing_after_init` (method) — Verifies init exiting 0 but leaving no marker file is treated as a failure. <!--#a54aa8f08798dc50-->
  - `TestEnsureSe3Project.test_empty_project_root_returns_error` (method) — Verifies an empty project_root argument returns an error without initializing. <!--#1e7177e189d933fc-->
- `TestAggregator` (class) — Test class for DaemonAggregator snapshot building, pending-call detection, change tracking, and root management. <!--#23eea7ee1f604e4f-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_snapshot_reads_engine_json` (method) — Verifies a snapshot reads engine.json into a flow with correct status, step, and progress. <!--#40eb272d9da8f63a-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_snapshot_empty_root` (method) — Verifies a root with no engine.json yields an empty flows list. <!--#704569e8a4390eb5-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_pending_calls_detected` (method) — Verifies pending call JSON files under se3/calls are surfaced in the snapshot. <!--#2f99c0715858d65c-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_has_changes_detects_mtime` (method) — Verifies has_changes returns true on first observation and after engine.json mtime changes. <!--#d33d310781d8db48-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_set_project_roots` (method) — Verifies set_project_roots and remove_project_root manage the resolved roots list. <!--#e3a6c19722fe0a1f-->
  - `TestAggregator.test_snapshot_serializable` (method) — Verifies a snapshot round-trips through JSON via to_dict without error. <!--#a1ff1397c3f92585-->
- `TestDaemonLifecycle` (class) — A test class covering the Daemon's lifecycle: status/pidfile guards, spawn requests that register project roots, and both automatic (`_resume_paused_flow`) and explicit (`request_resume`) resumption of paused/failed/interrupted flows, including snapshot fallback when engine.json is overwritten by a later run. <!--#7586a8de58549007-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_status_when_not_running` (method) — Verifies daemon_status reports running=False when no daemon is active. <!--#dce6aefe97949a69-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_pidfile_guard` (method) — Verifies _write_pidfile raises DaemonAlreadyRunning when a pidfile names a live process. <!--#aefc928abe836d36-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_spawn_registers_project_root` (method) — Verifies request_spawn registers the target project root with the aggregator. <!--#497a292da56133be-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_paused_flow_spawns_resume` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow spawns a --resume process for a paused flow and registers its root. <!--#e06dd0efafff9675-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_skips_non_paused_flow` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow does nothing for a running (non-paused) flow. <!--#2ce3ae28c0c32cc4-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_noop_without_engine_json` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow is a no-op when no engine.json exists. <!--#cf9d4e43ae77cfdf-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_resume_skips_when_live_process_exists` (method) — Verifies _resume_paused_flow skips resuming when a live process already exists for the root. <!--#d3b7ba602d163560-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_paused_flow` (method) — Verifies request_resume resumes a PAUSED flow and registers its project root. <!--#f3a28dfebc6b88bb-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_failed_flow` (method) — Verifies request_resume resumes a FAILED flow. <!--#8a6000acfb565208-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_completed_flow` (method) — Verifies request_resume raises ValueError for a COMPLETED flow. <!--#69fb4cf44eb7c69b-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_resumes_interrupted_running_flow` (method) — Verifies an interrupted flow persisted as RUNNING with no live process is still resumable. <!--#1a9d2154227d25bc-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_loads_snapshot_when_engine_overwritten` (method) — Verifies request_resume falls back to a per-flow snapshot when engine.json was overwritten by a later flow. <!--#ba80653806fbbe69-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_completed_snapshot` (method) — Verifies a COMPLETED snapshot flow is rejected as non-resumable. <!--#49088d9252930dcc-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_unknown_flow` (method) — Verifies request_resume raises 'not found' when the flow exists nowhere. <!--#7107a88e1679e95b-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_missing_state` (method) — Verifies request_resume raises 'not found' when neither engine.json nor a snapshot exists. <!--#e200798f1d14b5c6-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_live_process` (method) — Verifies request_resume raises 'live process' when a live process exists for the flow. <!--#24f5aab30487fe23-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_request_resume_rejects_when_other_flow_live_in_root` (method) — Verifies request_resume refuses when a different flow is live in the same project root (matching by root). <!--#c137dc04e8a74ef9-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_handle_respond_writes_response_and_resumes` (method) — Verifies _handle_respond_request writes a call response file and spawns a --resume process. <!--#61e50ecc7fb61ef3-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_poll_once_writes_status` (method) — Verifies _poll_once writes a status file containing the flows snapshot. <!--#74d2e5b18af59a7a-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_poll_once_offloads_snapshot_build` (method) — Verifies the heavy snapshot build runs off the event loop so a concurrent coroutine keeps progressing. <!--#64defe56e5fb610e-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_poll_once_offloads_flow_discovery` (method) — Verifies that the daemon's poll loop offloads blocking external-flow discovery (which synchronously parses engine.json) via `asyncio.to_thread`, proven by a concurrent heartbeat coroutine that keeps ticking while a blocking `discover_flows` runs. <!--#0bbcbb67f535e14e-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_poll_once_offloads_root_registration` (method) — Verifies that registering a newly discovered flow's project root (which persists and parses project_roots.json) is offloaded off the event loop, proven by a concurrent heartbeat that keeps advancing while a blocking `add_project_root` runs. <!--#18311c7b246f047f-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_write_status_without_client` (method) — Verifies status fields mark local-only when no server client is configured. <!--#953d99fbc33c8053-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_write_status_with_connected_client` (method) — Verifies a connected client surfaces connected=True and server_configured=True in the status file. <!--#4d7dd5fdfb946191-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_write_status_with_failed_client` (method) — Verifies a disconnected client surfaces connected=False with its last_error. <!--#0382869646733a47-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_daemon_status_exposes_connection_fields` (method) — Verifies daemon_status surfaces connected/last_error/server_configured from the status file. <!--#9e3e4549f4a73af9-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_daemon_status_connection_defaults_when_absent` (method) — Verifies daemon_status returns safe connection defaults when those fields are absent. <!--#11b14c43c020b314-->
  - `TestDaemonLifecycle.test_background_start_stop` (method) — End-to-end test that starts a detached daemon, confirms it runs, and stops it. <!--#cc6b67f061008ff5-->
- `TestDaemonLogging` (class) — Test class for daemon logging configuration and timestamped handler installation. <!--#ea8273f6f7cf09a4-->

### `tests/test_daemon_client.py` (python) — Unit/integration tests for the daemon-side WebSocket `DaemonClient`, covering URL normalization, exception-formatting and last-error diagnostics, message dispatch (PING/PONG, SPAWN_FLOW with resume/worktree/ensure variants, RESPOND_CALL, ISSUE_COMMAND create/edit/close/reopen with project-root validation and snapshot caching), and response-file writing. <!--#0167760cd29ddfa9|9eeb43c49aebd509-->
- `test_normalize_ws_url` (function) — Parametrized test asserting `_normalize_ws_url` rewrites a wide range of host/scheme/port/path inputs into canonical `ws(s)://host:port/path` URLs. <!--#acbe4a077a1afbd7-->
- `test_normalize_ws_url_default_port_is_shared_constant` (function) — Verifies the non-TLS default fill-in port comes from `protocol.DEFAULT_SERVER_PORT`. <!--#f3e668ea353b02e3-->
- `test_normalize_ws_url_tls_default_port_is_shared_constant` (function) — Verifies the wss default fill-in port comes from `protocol.DEFAULT_SERVER_TLS_PORT` (443) and the plain default is 8080. <!--#ac08caabdd1d7bec-->
- `test_format_exc_falls_back_to_type_name_when_str_is_empty` (function) — Asserts `_format_exc` returns the exception type name when `str(exc)` is empty (e.g. asyncio.TimeoutError), avoiding empty-parens diagnostics. <!--#949b439686c34478-->
- `test_format_exc_includes_message_when_present` (function) — Asserts `_format_exc` renders `Type: message` when the exception has a non-empty string. <!--#0e31aa9beef5259b-->
- `test_format_exc_is_always_nonempty_and_readable` (function) — Asserts `_format_exc` always yields a non-empty, readable reason (never the bare 'not connected') across several exception types. <!--#3b553d184588e77d-->
- `test_run_records_nonempty_last_error_on_connection_failure` (function) — Integration test that a failed dial to a dead port leaves a non-empty, readable `client.last_error`. <!--#d84cf1bd50b24818-->
- `test_welcome_rejection_records_reason_in_last_error` (function) — Asserts a WELCOME(accepted=false) auth rejection writes the rejection reason into `last_error`. <!--#9e87feb252970b78-->
- `test_default_respond_handler_writes_file` (function) — Asserts `_default_respond_handler` writes a `<call_id>.response.json` file under `se3/calls` with the expected payload fields. <!--#258ca0329b1c9fcb-->

### `tests/test_daemon_cursor_resume.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the G3 fix ensuring the daemon retains a terminal (e.g. FAILED) flow's history cursor across a final flush and fail→resume so resume continues with an append delta rather than a full re-read, while still pruning drained-and-archived flows. <!--#f557ef735a1c8ce1|12875848d82db8b5-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Helper that constructs a DaemonClient wired to a given history provider and stub snapshot provider for testing. <!--#f19f94c6130c7b3c-->

  - `_FakeWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket's list capturing sent (decoded) messages. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_FakeWS.send` (method) — Decodes the outgoing payload and appends it to the captured sent-messages list. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->

  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.__init__` (method) — Initializes the scripted provider's reads list, live-flow set, and seen-cursors log. <!--#9576faf525691821-->

  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.active_flow_signature` (method) — Returns an empty signature dict (no-op stub for the provider interface). <!--#d5e6eba440e59874-->
  - `_ScriptedHistoryProvider.live_flow_ids` (method) — Returns a copy of the scripted set of live (resumable) flow ids. <!--#23771304885724d8-->

- `test_terminal_flush_retains_cursor_for_live_flow` (function) — Asserts a FAILED flow still in engine.json keeps its cursor through the final flush and the subsequent record-less round. <!--#0a532ed50662e298-->
- `test_resume_continues_with_append_not_full_reread` (function) — Asserts that after resume the retained cursor is passed to the read, yielding an append delta carrying only the new record rather than a full re-read. <!--#ef4df2f2e57fb2ec-->
- `test_drained_archived_flow_cursor_is_pruned` (function) — Asserts a drained terminal flow no longer in engine.json is pruned from the cursor map while the live flow's cursor is retained. <!--#0dca867b14b922af-->
- `test_provider_without_live_flow_ids_falls_back_to_prune` (function) — Asserts a legacy provider lacking live_flow_ids retains the old prune-on-drain behavior (empty resumable set). <!--#fa516d7bd6da98c5-->

- `test_live_flow_ids_bounded_to_one_per_root` (function) — Asserts each project root contributes at most its single current engine.json flow to live_flow_ids. <!--#0b05c7ceca5703fe-->
- `test_live_flow_ids_empty_without_engine_json` (function) — Asserts a root with no engine.json contributes no live flow ids (no spurious retention). <!--#5d79297fd4fb9840-->

### `tests/test_daemon_event_loop_spin.py` (python) — Regression tests ensuring the daemon avoids event-loop spin by TTL-caching expensive index builds and historical-root walks, verifying build_index/read_active_flows caching, invalidation, stale-flow detection, and bounded disk enumeration across poll/push loop ticks. <!--#b2c41b142647838f|953e5d61cd695620-->

- `test_build_index_rebuilds_after_ttl` (function) — Asserts that build_index re-walks disk once the TTL window has elapsed. <!--#4e773de08d569fa6-->
- `test_build_index_cache_invalidation` (function) — Asserts that invalidate_index_cache forces the next build_index to rebuild from disk. <!--#175d5db850ac9f35-->
