### `tests/test_se3_module_system.py` (python) — Standalone test script that verifies the SE3 module system's `se3 init` command by running it in a temporary directory and asserting the expected .claude/CLAUDE.md/SE3.md files are created with correct checksums and placeholder substitution, complete with subprocess helper and a manual pass/fail runner. <!--#c943c3119483f070|825df9f3f361bcd4-->
- `run_command` (function) — Helper that runs a shell command via subprocess and returns its (stdout, stderr, returncode) tuple. <!--#94ffb83c947b0865-->
- `test_initialization` (function) — Test that runs `se3 init` in a temp dir and asserts the .claude directory, CLAUDE.md, and SE3.md are created with proper checksum metadata and substituted placeholders. <!--#a7738a951d389134-->
- `main` (function) — Manual test runner that executes the initialization test, tallies pass/fail counts, prints a summary, and returns overall success. <!--#8eab7242377c129d-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter17.py` (python) — Regression tests locking in the four issue #243/#244 self-check fixes: the disk_json_cache parse cache is LRU-bounded and evicts stale-path entries, orphaned cold steps partitions are pruned while live/snapshot-referenced ones are preserved, ENGINE_JSON_SCHEMA fully describes the emitted new-format header, and load_archived_flow_by_id selects the newest archive by mtime across both naming schemes. <!--#55ad72067328f9c5|717b1c2a1bf1db36-->
- `_clean_cache` (function) — Autouse pytest fixture that clears the disk_json_cache module-level cache before and after each test for isolation. <!--#30e926bcec897f26-->
- `test_cache_evicts_deleted_path_entry` (function) — Verifies read_json_cached returns None and drops the stale cache entry when the backing file no longer stats after deletion. <!--#6dae7c31c248fb57-->
- `test_cache_is_lru_bounded` (function) — Asserts the parse cache never exceeds its configured max-entries cap when many distinct files are read. <!--#baf000bb4666d84e-->
- `test_cache_lru_keeps_recently_used` (function) — Confirms LRU eviction discards the least-recently-used entry while preserving a freshly re-touched one on insertion past the cap. <!--#e6234b9959509b60-->
- `_paused_flow_with_cold` (function) — Helper that creates and saves a PAUSED flow with a large step output (forcing a cold steps partition) and returns it. <!--#268d250dd4b6473c-->
- `test_end_session_prunes_orphaned_partition` (function) — Checks that clear_state keeps a snapshot-referenced cold partition but clear_resumable_snapshot reclaims it once orphaned, with archive fidelity retained. <!--#de64fac26cfb3ace-->
- `test_new_run_prunes_prior_completed_partition` (function) — Verifies a fresh run overwriting engine.json reclaims a prior COMPLETED flow's now-unreferenced partition while keeping the new flow's partition. <!--#3f7ae283b2f5c577-->
- `test_prune_preserves_live_partition` (function) — Asserts _prune_cold_partition_if_orphan does not delete a partition still referenced by the live engine.json flow. <!--#bd8d5c8134566d44-->
- `test_engine_schema_covers_emitted_header` (function) — Ensures every top-level and state key the serializer emits (including worktree and iteration/token fields) is described by ENGINE_JSON_SCHEMA. <!--#0413a0dec15fbe4f-->
- `test_load_archived_prefers_newest_by_mtime` (function) — Confirms load_archived_flow_by_id selects the newest archive by mtime across the timestamped and slug naming schemes, not by lexical sort. <!--#7e2c65fd78b39be6-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter18.py` (python) — Regression tests for the iteration-18 self-check fixes (issues #243/#244) that lock in cold-storage persistence robustness — transient cold-read failures degrade steps to empty without destroying intact cold files, damaged/null/non-dict headers and contexts degrade tolerantly instead of raising across eager and lazy load paths, the size-guarded snapshot-header scanner recovers head/tail identity from oversized files without seam-spanning garbage, colliding archives atomically stamp their suffixed cold_partition, and resumed new-format flows hydrate predecessor cold outputs through to COMPLETED. <!--#7c2f6afef771a1c3|02b852ca48135863-->
- `_clean_cache` (function) — A pytest fixture that clears the module-level engine cache both before and after each test. <!--#30e926bcec897f26-->
- `test_apply_cold_failed_read_leaves_step_unloaded` (function) — Asserts that applying a None (failed) cold read degrades a step's in-memory IO to empty but leaves it marked not-loaded so a later persist re-emits the cold_ref verbatim. <!--#ca957907a04e957e-->
- `test_apply_cold_successful_read_marks_loaded` (function) — Asserts that applying a successful cold-read payload populates the step's inputs/outputs and marks it as loaded. <!--#6c9dc68933cd1680-->
- `test_transient_cold_read_does_not_destroy_intact_file` (function) — End-to-end test that a transient cold-read failure during hydration does not let the next save overwrite the intact cold file with empties, with data still recoverable once the error clears. <!--#98a733a302ae2c6f-->
- `test_null_cold_context_degrades_on_both_loaders` (function) — Verifies that a cold context file holding explicit JSON nulls degrades gracefully to empty context/fix_history across both eager and lazy load paths instead of raising TypeError. <!--#2a76b061503e7e64-->
- `test_load_flow_tolerant_never_raises_on_nondict_steps` (function) — Asserts that a corrupt header whose 'steps' is a string is tolerated by load_flow_tolerant, returning warnings without raising AttributeError. <!--#7f685d249118b266-->
- `test_load_flow_tolerant_never_raises_on_nondict_step_entry` (function) — Asserts that a header whose individual step entry is a non-dict is tolerated by load_flow_tolerant without raising. <!--#6a33f3faa2382972-->
- `test_save_flow_survives_corrupt_prior_header` (function) — Verifies that a non-dict 'state' in the prior on-disk header degrades cold-hash computation gracefully so the next persist still succeeds and round-trips. <!--#ab24262e687935ab-->
- `_write_oversized` (function) — Test helper that writes a multi-MiB indent=2 JSON snapshot with identity keys in the head, a giant nested state block, and a tail is_worktree_mode to exercise the seam-scanning header reader. <!--#10803600d286c20f-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_degraded_head_and_tail` (function) — Asserts the snapshot-header reader recovers head keys and the tail is_worktree_mode from an oversized file without fully parsing the giant state block or misreading a nested copy. <!--#026d39eb491fe363-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_missing_flow_id_returns_none` (function) — Asserts the snapshot-header reader returns None for an oversized file that lacks a flow_id. <!--#c2892538093758a0-->
- `test_read_snapshot_header_under_guard_parses_whole` (function) — Asserts that a small under-guard file is fully parsed by the snapshot-header reader, preserving its 'state'. <!--#a69a342665611c41-->
- `test_engine_scanner_no_seam_spanning_garbage` (function) — Verifies the engine header reader recovers identity from an oversized file with a huge task_description without producing seam-spanning garbage across the head/tail window. <!--#f03d48cc39da5450-->
- `test_daemon_scanner_no_seam_spanning_garbage` (function) — Verifies the daemon's read_engine_header recovers identity and is_worktree_mode from an oversized file without seam-spanning garbage in the truncated description. <!--#a695db364010dc08-->
- `test_clear_state_collision_stamps_partition_before_publish` (function) — End-to-end test that archiving into a colliding cold partition routes to a suffixed partition and stamps cold_partition into the published header atomically so archived cold_refs resolve to the correct data. <!--#dc2ad44471e3e9c7-->
- `test_resume_new_format_feeds_prior_cold_outputs_to_completion` (function) — Full resume integration test proving keyed-access hydration feeds a resumed step its predecessor's cold-file-resident outputs (not empties) and runs the flow to COMPLETED. <!--#22d9bd7a6fedea64-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter22.py` (python) — Regression test module locking in the iteration-22 self-check fixes for issue #243/#244 part A — covering hot/cold persistence robustness (a failed lazy read of externalized `_context.json` degrades to empty without being persisted over the intact cold file, mixed str/int key payloads hash without raising via `_canonical_json`, and successful cold loads still round-trip edits) plus daemon concurrency safety (`pending_calls_signature` snapshotting project roots and `_handle_end_session` dispatching its blocking handler off the websocket event loop via `asyncio.to_thread`). <!--#f5c8f1ab88f29f67|3d4eff2f728ccda3-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a PAUSED feature FlowInstance seeded with N completed IMPLEMENT steps carrying large duplicated payloads in step inputs, context, and a fix-iteration entry, for exercising hot/cold persistence splitting. <!--#c7e9a912f82a18da-->
- `_cold_context_path` (function) — Test helper returning the on-disk path to a flow's cold `_context.json` file under `se3/state/steps/<flow_id>/`. <!--#7e099bb97d714c04-->
- `test_failed_context_read_is_not_persisted_over_intact_file` (function) — Verifies that a transient cold-context read failure degrades to an empty context without marking it loaded, so a subsequent save re-emits the context_ref and never overwrites the (restored) intact cold file with `{}`. <!--#a4caf7c9ab4c26cc-->
- `test_loaded_context_still_round_trips` (function) — Verifies that a successfully loaded cold context is flagged `cold_context_loaded` True and that genuine edits persist back to the cold `_context.json` file. <!--#ad3528ab4d1a88ed-->
- `test_canonical_json_handles_mixed_key_types` (function) — Checks that `_canonical_json` falls back to stringifying keys for mixed-type-key dicts (instead of raising TypeError) and that `_content_hash` stays deterministic across equal inputs. <!--#2be1aa149438f77f-->
- `test_save_flow_with_mixed_key_step_payload` (function) — Verifies that saving a flow whose step outputs contain mixed int/str dict keys does not raise in content-hashing/splitting and round-trips correctly (int keys coerced to strings by JSON). <!--#0432ac37a65ccf51-->
- `test_pending_calls_signature_snapshots_roots` (function) — Verifies that `DaemonAggregator.pending_calls_signature` iterates a list() snapshot of project roots, immune to concurrent root registration ('set changed size during iteration'), and returns a dict without raising. <!--#95cb86ff2cd7fd25-->
- `test_end_session_handler_dispatched_off_loop` (function) — Verifies that `DaemonClient._handle_end_session` dispatches a blocking synchronous handler via `asyncio.to_thread` on a worker thread (not the event-loop thread), forwarding the flow_id/project_root/reason args. <!--#1777f33ffbf28b92-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter23.py` (python) — Regression tests for the iteration-23 self-check fixes (issue #244 phase-B3-i) that lock in two per-step cold-body data-loss guards—ensuring a re-executed step's freshly produced body persists rather than being wiped by later keyed access, and that both the lazy and eager (load_flow/load_flow_tolerant) reconstruct paths mark a failed cold-read step not-loaded and re-emit its cold_ref instead of clobbering the intact on-disk cold file with an empty body. <!--#3bee5c06ac066c8b|d7bf4c798f7e4d09-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a PAUSED feature FlowInstance populated with N completed IMPLEMENT steps each carrying distinct input/output bodies, with selected steps and current-step pointer initialized. <!--#bc516734977da4ea-->
- `_cold_step_path` (function) — Test helper returning the on-disk cold JSON file path for a given flow/step under the tmp_path se3/state/steps directory. <!--#2abff27326e65e5f-->
- `test_reexecuted_step_body_is_persisted_after_corrupt_cold_read` (function) — Verifies that a lazily-loaded step whose cold file is corrupt, once re-executed (cold_loaded flipped True with a fresh body), is not wiped by a later keyed access and is persisted/reloaded intact by save_flow. <!--#7c7919745bdc5398-->
- `test_pure_read_failure_does_not_clobber_lazy_cold_file` (function) — Verifies that a never-re-executed step whose cold read transiently failed keeps cold_loaded False and re-emits its cold_ref, so re-persisting does not overwrite the recovered intact cold file with an empty body. <!--#754cac471378f4c9-->
- `test_eager_load_failed_step_read_is_not_persisted_over_intact_file` (function) — Verifies the eager reconstruct path (load_flow / load_flow_tolerant) marks a failed-read step not-loaded and preserves its cold_ref—while a sibling successful read stays loaded—so a later save re-emits the reference instead of clobbering the intact on-disk cold file with {}. <!--#b1815ea43edf354c-->

### `tests/test_selfcheck_fixes_iter31.py` (python) — Regression test suite locking in fix-iteration-31 self-check fixes: strict positive resolution (or typed raise, never silent worktree fallback) of the main checkout for worktree merge-side steps, mode-independent own-replay detection in the commit version-race guard, and symmetric clearing of the merge-lock waiting flag when a blocking acquire faults. <!--#64f45034387809b9|bb5a4c2f71f65998-->
- `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness` (class) — Test class verifying that probe_main_repo_root strictly distinguishes a genuine non-worktree (returns None) from actual git failures (git missing, non-zero exit, unparseable output, or underivable main worktree, all of which must raise MainRepoProbeError), while the lenient _resolve_main_repo_root wrapper still swallows failures to None. <!--#fc2274e015306e5b-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_non_worktree_returns_none` (method) — Asserts that when the probe succeeds and git-common-dir equals git-dir (a plain repo), it correctly reports None rather than a worktree main root. <!--#1135b33c1164ab27-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_git_missing_raises` (method) — Asserts that a FileNotFoundError from a missing git binary surfaces as MainRepoProbeError instead of being mistaken for a non-worktree. <!--#31bc709e6aacf775-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_nonzero_exit_raises` (method) — Asserts that a non-zero git exit (e.g. not a git repository) raises MainRepoProbeError. <!--#d39c7a1b6e967e5b-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_unparseable_output_raises` (method) — Asserts that git output with more than two lines (an embedded-newline path) is treated as an unparseable failure that raises rather than a non-worktree. <!--#b31f15d656b0b3ba-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_worktree_but_toplevel_fails_raises` (method) — Asserts that when a worktree is detected but deriving its main working tree fails, the probe raises rather than falling back to the worktree. <!--#6e276954010d6a79-->
  - `TestProbeMainRepoRootStrictness.test_resolve_wrapper_still_swallows_to_none` (method) — Asserts backward compatibility: the lenient _resolve_main_repo_root wrapper returns None on git failure so config-path lookup callers are unaffected. <!--#3ffb5818fdcd6869-->
- `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict` (class) — Test class verifying StateMachine's strict merge-checkout resolution: probe failures raise MergeCheckoutResolutionError, legitimate None/worktree cases resolve correctly, flow creation tolerates transient faults without stashing a bad worktree fallback, and merge-side steps acquire the merge lock and rebind to the main checkout even when a step's cwd override is lost. <!--#5afdddb747b3a06e-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_probe_failure_raises_typed_error` (method) — Asserts a MainRepoProbeError from the probe is re-raised as a typed MergeCheckoutResolutionError from _resolve_main_checkout_root. <!--#4b5749bc4a4bad8e-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_non_worktree_resolves_to_project_root` (method) — Asserts a legitimate None probe result (project_root itself is the main checkout) resolves to the project root with no error. <!--#5202f7b292268cd7-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_worktree_resolves_to_main` (method) — Asserts that when the probe returns a main-repo path, resolution yields that main checkout. <!--#f871f93250751b0f-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_creation_tolerates_unresolvable_checkout_but_execution_is_strict` (method) — Asserts flow creation survives a transient probe fault without stashing the worktree, so a later merge step re-resolves strictly and raises while a non-merge step still gets no cwd override. <!--#d019758a2381efc4-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_stashed_checkout_used_verbatim_without_reprobe` (method) — Asserts that a positively-resolved and stashed merge_checkout_root is used verbatim by the merge step without re-probing. <!--#c48662e4a6d24b76-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_merge_step_without_cwd_still_acquires_lock` (method) — Asserts that a merge step whose persisted cwd override was lost still rebinds to the strictly-resolved main checkout and acquires/releases the merge lock, preventing a race with concurrent merges on master. <!--#7cf54da0be001e40-->
  - `TestMergeCheckoutResolutionStrict.test_non_merge_step_without_cwd_takes_no_lock` (method) — Asserts an ordinary non-merge step with no cwd override yields unchanged, leaving project_root untouched and never constructing a MergeLock. <!--#7351006a1fe7d728-->
- `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard` (class) — Test class verifying _guard_version_race treats a durable committed-version marker matching disk as this flow's own replay (returning the target verbatim without re-analysis), but falls through to the drift re-analysis path when the marker doesn't match on-disk drift. <!--#5e61e859b8e9608d-->
  - `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard._flow_with_analyze` (method) — Helper building a non-worktree FlowInstance with a completed VERSION_ANALYZE step carrying the given baseline and suggested versions. <!--#1523de14a5c51caf-->
  - `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard.test_record_then_guard_treats_as_replay` (method) — Asserts that when disk drift matches the version this flow recorded committing, the guard returns that target verbatim as an own-replay without re-analysis or any git/version file. <!--#3c0a875fa3f4e1d1-->
  - `TestScriptModeOwnReplayGuard.test_marker_mismatch_is_not_a_replay` (method) — Asserts that a marker for a different version than what's on disk (a concurrent flow's bump) is not treated as replay, forcing re-analysis against the new disk baseline. <!--#afbefa1dfb13f4e9-->
- `TestAcquireMergeStepLockWaitingCleanup` (class) — Test class verifying that if the blocking merge-lock acquire faults mid-wait (OSError or KeyboardInterrupt), the persisted waiting_for_lock flag is symmetrically cleared and re-persisted before the exception propagates, so a dead process can't leave a stale '等待主分支锁' badge. <!--#3d0243c278c7aeca-->
  - `TestAcquireMergeStepLockWaitingCleanup._busy_then_raise_lock` (method) — Helper returning a fake lock whose non-blocking probe raises MergeLockBusy (forcing the wait path) and whose blocking acquire then raises the supplied exception. <!--#6d131d8a6a0628d5-->
  - `TestAcquireMergeStepLockWaitingCleanup.test_blocking_acquire_failure_clears_waiting_flag` (method) — Parametrized test asserting that for both OSError and KeyboardInterrupt during the blocking acquire, waiting_for_lock is cleared in memory and in the reloaded persisted flow after the exception raises. <!--#05b9219d2ca24507-->

### `tests/test_server_auth_e2e.py` (python) — End-to-end pytest suite for the server's authentication and authorization stack, exercising local login/logout with session cookies, failure rate-limiting, break-glass admin tokens, admin-only user provisioning, fail-closed behavior when no provider is configured, credential-never-logged guarantees, full daemon/owner isolation chains, and ServerConfig-to-create_app kwargs translation. <!--#3b7ac7d12fcd4e3f|7cc46e556fe4f5e3-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a TestClient plus its app, built from the test-configured `authed_app` with a seeded admin. <!--#7c0dc10f1bb22800-->
- `test_login_sets_session_cookie_and_me` (function) — Asserts a successful admin login returns admin/local identity, sets an HttpOnly SameSite session cookie, and that `/api/auth/me` then reports the seeded owner. <!--#429d2917d7cfc342-->
- `test_me_requires_authentication` (function) — Asserts `/api/auth/me` returns 401 without a session rather than serving an anonymous identity. <!--#f17ecad4461c2ecb-->
- `test_login_bad_password_is_401` (function) — Asserts a wrong password yields 401 and hands out no session cookie. <!--#b8a4f6e0a0b60bbc-->
- `test_login_unknown_user_is_401` (function) — Asserts logging in as an unknown username yields 401. <!--#cb118bcfd4cb74ed-->
- `test_logout_destroys_session` (function) — Asserts logout returns 200 and that the destroyed session causes subsequent authed calls to fail closed (401). <!--#45aa19e53b5ec9e9-->
- `test_logout_is_idempotent_without_session` (function) — Asserts logout succeeds (200) even with no active session. <!--#baaadd884bcea07c-->
- `test_login_rate_limit_locks_out` (function) — Asserts that exceeding the configured failure threshold trips a lockout returning 429 with a Retry-After header, refusing even the correct password while locked. <!--#3f56a41187aea194-->
- `_put_breakglass` (function) — Test helper that mints a break-glass token via crypto, stores its hash on the app's store, and returns the plaintext. <!--#f5de3ab0c1ee2640-->
- `test_breakglass_mints_admin_session` (function) — Asserts consuming a valid break-glass token mints an admin session that `/api/auth/me` confirms as admin. <!--#1669301e31acec05-->
- `test_breakglass_is_single_admin_subject` (function) — Asserts two break-glass consumptions resolve to the same stable admin owner_id rather than per-token impersonated owners. <!--#563156b29b30146c-->
- `test_breakglass_token_is_one_time` (function) — Asserts a break-glass token works once (200) and cannot be replayed (401). <!--#be21dd5f7485053a-->
- `test_breakglass_invalid_token_is_401` (function) — Asserts an unrecognized break-glass token is rejected with 401. <!--#526c1b0580c2178e-->
- `test_breakglass_empty_token_is_422` (function) — Asserts a blank/whitespace break-glass token fails request validation with 422. <!--#5bf03125ddc7b112-->
- `test_fail_closed_when_no_provider_configured` (function) — Asserts that disabling local with no other provider enabled makes app construction raise `AuthNotConfigured` (fail-closed). <!--#809d5531882c8c01-->
- `test_unauthenticated_reads_are_401` (function) — Asserts core read endpoints (machines/history/flows) all return 401 without authentication. <!--#7803bb114c6421c6-->
- `test_default_session_cookie_is_secure` (function) — Asserts a default (non-test) app issues a Secure, HttpOnly session cookie on login. <!--#3673aa08c5eae3df-->
- `_seed_local_user` (function) — Test helper that directly seeds a local user (owner + local identity binding + hashed password) into the store and returns the owner_id. <!--#5674d0e84e0a685e-->
- `test_admin_creates_user_who_can_then_login` (function) — Asserts an authenticated admin can create a user via `/api/users` and that the new owner/binding/password let that user subsequently log in. <!--#af055871a5f71f76-->
- `test_admin_can_create_another_admin` (function) — Asserts an admin can create another admin user, persisted with `is_admin` true. <!--#6a31868bd3e8f6fa-->
- `test_non_admin_cannot_create_user` (function) — Asserts a non-admin's user-creation request is rejected with 403 and creates no owner. <!--#ec3b96972e1f0295-->
- `test_create_user_requires_authentication` (function) — Asserts unauthenticated `/api/users` creation is 401, confirming no public self-registration. <!--#2530b2d19d6fbf30-->
- `test_create_duplicate_user_is_409` (function) — Asserts creating a user with an existing username returns 409 and leaves no orphan owner. <!--#5d61355c461832cc-->
- `test_create_user_validates_empty_fields` (function) — Asserts blank username or empty password in user creation fails validation with 422. <!--#b031661c7d278ae3-->
- `test_no_public_registration_endpoint` (function) — Asserts the candidate registration/signup routes never succeed at account creation, returning only 404/405. <!--#820051f1a0c38e99-->
- `test_credentials_never_logged` (function) — Asserts that across login (success/failure) and break-glass consumption, no password, token, or session id appears in captured logs. <!--#7d239fb2d1fe3559-->
- `_shared_app` (function) — Test helper building a multi-tenant app over a shared real in-memory sqlite Store with an insecure-cookie SessionStore. <!--#a00c47ece2972bc6-->
- `_await_visible` (function) — Test helper that polls `/api/machines` until a given machine_id becomes visible, asserting failure if it never does. <!--#9944e50d59e37abd-->
- `test_full_chain_bootstrap_owner_key_daemon_dispatch` (function) — Integration test of the full chain — bootstrap break-glass, admin-provisions owners, daemon-key mint, daemon /ws HELLO auth and binding, per-owner machine isolation, and that cross-owner flow dispatch reads as 404. <!--#bc4abc771a1c3c91-->
- `test_full_chain_fail_closed_without_identity` (function) — Integration test asserting that with no valid identity, REST calls 401, a keyless daemon HELLO is rejected, and the rejected daemon registers nothing an admin can later see. <!--#60cd84706f0059a5-->
- `test_create_app_kwargs_from_server_config_translates_auth` (function) — Asserts `_create_app_kwargs_from_server_config` maps a structured ServerConfig (db_path, providers, session, local lockout, proxy-header) onto the kwargs `create_app` consumes. <!--#13066b294b4f2c70-->
- `test_create_app_kwargs_default_config_builds_local_chain` (function) — Asserts the default ServerConfig translated through the helper yields a usable local-only auth chain with no fail-closed regression. <!--#9fce11258c3a0a52-->

### `tests/test_server_auth_local.py` (python) — Unit tests for the pluggable server auth layer (G3), covering the AuthProvider/ProviderChain composition, the session store with hashed-at-rest ids and cookie resolution, the default multi-owner LocalAuthProvider with password login and rate-limit/lockout, the fail-closed registry assembly plus the require_owner HTTP-401 dependency, and the OIDC and proxy-header optional provider seams that stay disabled and fail-closed unless explicitly configured and trusted. <!--#605e193fb91244f6|6e337661ef918eb3-->
- `_Clock` (class) — Test helper: a controllable callable clock for deterministic session-expiry and lockout timing. <!--#bffbb1d268103f32-->
  - `_Clock.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake clock at a given start time. <!--#de1b0d6d49aed96a-->
  - `_Clock.__call__` (method) — Returns the current fake time when the clock is called. <!--#b70434b188893dc7-->
  - `_Clock.advance` (method) — Advances the fake clock by a given delta to simulate elapsed time. <!--#5fd367150cbec9dc-->
- `FakeRequest` (class) — Test helper: a minimal request-like object exposing `.cookies` and `.headers`. <!--#5678abe02b24c7cf-->
  - `FakeRequest.__init__` (method) — Stores the supplied cookies and headers as plain dicts. <!--#7be7aad04a3483a6-->
- `store` (function) — Pytest fixture providing a fresh on-disk persistence Store backed by a tmp_path database. <!--#aecd8298b6711b7d-->
- `two_owners` (function) — Pytest fixture creating two local owners (admin Alice and Bob) with linked identities and passwords, returning their (id, password) tuples. <!--#5b5c5a6fca9b82d5-->
- `sessions` (function) — Pytest fixture providing a fresh in-memory SessionStore. <!--#57954c2ac9d5fca5-->
- `_StubProvider` (class) — Test double AuthProvider returning a fixed identity, used to exercise ProviderChain ordering and enable/disable behavior. <!--#bb3caa6015120ed8-->
  - `_StubProvider.__init__` (method) — Stores the stub provider's name, enabled flag, and canned identity. <!--#cbc15d972ac18942-->
  - `_StubProvider.resolve_owner` (method) — Returns the provider's pre-set identity regardless of the request. <!--#8fe38a89342c8d42-->
- `test_provider_chain_returns_first_resolution` (function) — Asserts ProviderChain returns the identity from the first provider that resolves one, skipping earlier non-resolving providers. <!--#dee059d91ed060e7-->
- `test_provider_chain_drops_disabled_and_is_falsy_when_empty` (function) — Asserts disabled providers are dropped from the chain, leaving it empty, falsy, and resolving to no identity. <!--#86a895221b35a552-->
- `test_session_create_resolve_and_hash_at_rest` (function) — Asserts session creation yields a high-entropy `ses_`-prefixed id stored only as a hash, while resolve round-trips back to the owner. <!--#0175a3ca074557e7-->
- `test_session_expiry_is_enforced` (function) — Asserts an expired session no longer resolves and is evicted from the store. <!--#d10d0fbab5476e38-->
- `test_session_resolve_rejects_unknown_and_empty` (function) — Asserts resolve returns None for None, empty, and unrecognized session ids. <!--#64f93bb17c9cb299-->
- `test_session_destroy_and_destroy_owner` (function) — Asserts single-session destroy is idempotent and destroy_owner removes all of an owner's sessions. <!--#4f219501f52c41db-->
- `test_session_auth_provider_resolves_from_cookie` (function) — Asserts SessionAuthProvider resolves an owner identity from the session cookie and fails closed (no identity) when the cookie is absent. <!--#0ca236ae084233b1-->
- `test_cookie_config_secure_defaults` (function) — Asserts CookieConfig defaults to http_only, secure, and same_site=lax. <!--#0515b8b62fc50b2c-->
- `test_local_login_authenticates_multiple_owners` (function) — Asserts LocalAuthProvider authenticates two distinct owners (preserving admin flags) with separate sessions and round-trips each back via resolve_owner. <!--#e56b5b43946b5bde-->
- `test_local_login_rejects_bad_password_and_unknown_user` (function) — Asserts login returns None for both a wrong password and an unknown username. <!--#7f69ba9d2143b55d-->
- `test_local_login_rate_limit_locks_then_success_resets` (function) — Asserts repeated failures trip a lockout (raising LoginRateLimited) and that a successful login after the window resets the failure counter. <!--#1c73d8e95bbd7ec3-->
- `test_local_credentials_and_session_never_logged` (function) — Asserts passwords and session ids never appear in captured log output during login. <!--#9a3c8ea5ff6032eb-->
- `test_rate_limiter_window_forgets_old_failures` (function) — Asserts the rate limiter forgets failures that age out of its sliding window so they don't count toward lockout. <!--#b43af58d3b8e98ae-->
- `test_registry_default_is_local` (function) — Asserts build_provider_chain with no config yields a chain containing only the local provider. <!--#0916ac6b22dc3d75-->
- `test_registry_fail_closed_when_no_usable_provider` (function) — Asserts the registry raises AuthNotConfigured when local is disabled or only an unconfigured OIDC seam remains. <!--#4278b7c199470c42-->
- `test_registry_can_switch_providers` (function) — Asserts enabling the proxy-header provider with affirmed trust adds it to the chain alongside local. <!--#ac09f7bd46aeedfc-->
- `test_require_owner_401_without_identity_and_passes_with` (function) — Asserts the make_require_owner dependency raises HTTP 401 without an identity and returns the resolved owner with a valid session cookie. <!--#841bca84216cc87c-->
- `test_oidc_disabled_by_default_and_external_id_shape` (function) — Asserts OidcProvider stays disabled when unconfigured or partially configured, verifies the issuer|sub external-id format, and that begin_login is not yet implemented. <!--#ce6d3e81d9dc8062-->
- `test_proxy_header_refuses_untrusted_header` (function) — Asserts the proxy-header provider ignores the header unless explicitly enabled with trust_proxy affirmed (fail-closed). <!--#5829d1cb5c319d5d-->
- `test_proxy_header_trusted_resolves_binding` (function) — Asserts a trusted proxy-header provider resolves a bound header value to its owner but returns None for an unbound value (no implicit account creation). <!--#ef1f94397d086cae-->

### `tests/test_server_authz.py` (python) — Test suite for the se3 server's owner-scoped authorization, exercising daemon-channel HELLO key→owner resolution, owner-isolated ServerState machine/flow/history queries, UiHub/`_push_*` per-owner WebSocket routing, and fail-closed REST read/write endpoints via lightweight fake WebSockets and an end-to-end two-owner app fixture. <!--#fc9d44249ec01ecd|daa556cd37e9e27a-->
- `_Disconnect` (class) — Exception used by the fake sockets to signal no more queued frames (a client disconnect). <!--#0b594fd2b546acad-->
- `_FakeDaemonWS` (class) — Fake server-side daemon WebSocket driven by a queued frame list, recording sent/accepted/closed state. <!--#82a24bded2f0b1e5-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake daemon socket with queued incoming frames and empty send/accept/close tracking. <!--#b49c06f46d060114-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.accept` (method) — Marks the fake daemon socket as accepted. <!--#5469a86e64b0aac3-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.receive_text` (method) — Pops the next queued frame or raises _Disconnect when none remain. <!--#2531fa1e77e264fb-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.send_text` (method) — Appends a sent frame to the captured-sent list. <!--#a38f8dbb8eeac4a8-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.close` (method) — Marks the fake daemon socket as closed. <!--#d37c335b4328d9f4-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.welcomes` (method) — Decodes and returns the WELCOME messages the server sent down this socket. <!--#69b4333785134335-->
- `_FakeUiWS` (class) — Fake web-frontend WebSocket that captures sent payloads as decoded JSON and records close codes. <!--#39fb4b88bd4b7269-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake UI socket with optional queued frames and empty capture state. <!--#c1102799066ad38b-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.accept` (method) — Marks the fake UI socket as accepted. <!--#5469a86e64b0aac3-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.receive_text` (method) — Pops the next queued frame or raises _Disconnect when none remain. <!--#2531fa1e77e264fb-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.send_text` (method) — Appends a sent payload (parsed from JSON) to the captured-sent list. <!--#3e8b5ce5b3c95b3c-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.close` (method) — Marks the fake UI socket as closed and records the close code. <!--#685f43ad573f68aa-->
- `_make_identity_with_key` (function) — Helper that builds an in-memory IdentityService with one owner and an issued daemon key, returning the identity, owner id, and key plaintext. <!--#b0540819cc5f12d6-->
- `test_machine_record_owner_id_in_to_dict` (function) — Asserts MachineRecord carries owner_id and surfaces it (or None) through to_dict in all variants. <!--#c1bfb8a304dc23cf-->
- `test_register_machine_records_owner_id` (function) — Verifies register_machine binds and re-asserts a machine's owner and that get_machine_owner reflects it. <!--#c0a8c0bb1374d661-->
- `test_owner_takeover_on_machine_id_collision_discards_prior_state` (function) — Verifies that an owner change on a reused machine_id scrubs the prior owner's flows and cached history so no cross-owner data leaks. <!--#88d41467cc87bb51-->
- `test_owner_reconnect_same_owner_retains_flows` (function) — Verifies a same-owner reconnect keeps aggregated flows and history (the scrub fires only on owner change). <!--#757fd74b70e3132c-->
- `test_owner_scoped_machine_queries_isolate_owners` (function) — Verifies the owner-scoped ServerState machine/flow queries isolate each owner while unscoped reads see everything. <!--#4df3a9fb06563ad5-->
- `test_unbound_machine_invisible_to_scoped_view` (function) — Verifies an owner-less machine is fail-closed out of scoped views but still visible to the unscoped/admin view. <!--#4ebdba6acb2474f8-->
- `test_owner_scoped_history_index_and_lookup` (function) — Verifies the history index and history-flow lookups are owner-scoped while unscoped aggregates all owners. <!--#6652c0b62c81c137-->
- `test_daemon_hello_valid_key_binds_owner_and_accepts` (function) — Verifies a valid-key daemon HELLO is accepted, binds the machine to the resolved owner in state and identity, and never echoes the key. <!--#a1decfe98f421f58-->
- `test_daemon_hello_invalid_or_missing_key_rejected_fail_closed` (function) — Parametrized test that an invalid/missing daemon key is rejected fail-closed with no registration, binding, or leaked subsequent frame. <!--#a8eae1284dc92e50-->
- `test_daemon_hello_no_identity_is_unauthenticated_passthrough` (function) — Verifies that with no identity service the daemon channel is accepted unauthenticated with owner None. <!--#5d9bc30606467a61-->

### `tests/test_server_crypto.py` (python) — Unit tests for se3.server.crypto verifying its security primitives: slow salted password hashing/verification, high-entropy token generation and hashing, constant-time comparison, and secret redaction/fingerprinting helpers. <!--#f2b06f05ec6d0fe9|40059af7775ac059-->
- `test_hash_password_is_slow_salted_not_plaintext` (function) — Asserts hash_password never returns plaintext and always produces a recognized slow-hash format (argon2 or bcrypt). <!--#d3afd5778c29c5fc-->
- `test_hash_password_salted_unique_per_call` (function) — Asserts hashing the same password twice yields different hashes, proving per-call salting. <!--#73a16f573c53d386-->
- `test_verify_password_roundtrip` (function) — Checks verify_password returns True for the correct password and False for a wrong one against a generated hash. <!--#28670a6263b47894-->
- `test_verify_password_handles_long_and_unicode` (function) — Verifies password hashing/verification works correctly for long, multibyte unicode passwords exceeding 72 bytes. <!--#a137e3634ee844cf-->
- `test_verify_password_rejects_malformed_hash` (function) — Asserts verify_password safely returns False for empty, non-hash, and unknown-format hash strings. <!--#b1ae3910b192843b-->
- `test_generate_token_high_entropy_and_unique` (function) — Checks generate_token produces unique, high-entropy, prefixed plaintext tokens with distinct storage hashes. <!--#1ddc19e7a7976cc4-->
- `test_generate_token_no_prefix` (function) — Verifies generate_token without a prefix yields a non-empty plaintext (no leading underscore) whose hash matches token_hash. <!--#deaa040aa6bf41d4-->
- `test_token_hash_matches_and_verifies` (function) — Asserts token_hash is consistent and verify_token_hash accepts the correct plaintext while rejecting altered or empty input. <!--#ed04667e95071338-->
- `test_token_plaintext_not_derivable_from_hash` (function) — Confirms the stored token hash never contains the secret and is a 64-char sha256 hex digest. <!--#ee343b97c8b67187-->
- `test_const_eq_str_and_bytes` (function) — Tests const_eq for correct equality results across str/bytes mixes and length/content mismatches. <!--#4dc0d7f600d03df0-->
- `test_const_eq_bad_types_return_false` (function) — Asserts const_eq returns False for None and non-string/bytes types rather than raising. <!--#d951d353cc548368-->
- `test_redact_reveals_nothing` (function) — Verifies redact returns '<redacted>' hiding the secret and '<empty>' for empty or None input. <!--#ecd3a4a98a994dc1-->
- `test_token_fingerprint_is_short_and_non_reversible` (function) — Checks token_fingerprint yields a deterministic, non-reversible 12-char value, with '<empty>' for empty input. <!--#c66f84c97b785734-->

### `tests/test_server_g4_relay.py` (python) — Test suite for the G4 server relay covering ServerState history-index delta merge and differential broadcast, the history bundle content signature and not-modified snapshot logic, the full-pull throttle, keepalive liveness without re-broadcast, DetailRequestRegistry coalescing, on-demand issue/call detail REST endpoints, GZip/WS compression, and server wire-byte metrics — driving the daemon receive-loop dispatcher with a recording hub to assert broadcasts deterministically. <!--#e9c767c72fae54c9|ff9838a7461b8524-->
- `test_merge_history_index_delta_upsert_add_remove` (function) — Verifies ServerState.merge_history_index_delta applies a delta by upserting changed flows, adding new ones, and removing listed flow_ids from the in-memory history index. <!--#bec26c1ccfe71a1a-->
- `test_merge_history_index_delta_ignores_rows_without_flow_id` (function) — Asserts that history-index delta rows lacking a flow_id are silently dropped while valid rows are still merged. <!--#7fa77088934117c9-->
- `test_merge_delta_matches_full_reindex` (function) — Confirms that applying a change as an incremental delta yields the same index set as re-pushing the full index. <!--#170efb516937bc72-->
- `test_snapshot_exposes_signature_and_changes_with_records` (function) — Checks that a history snapshot carries a non-empty signature string and that appending new records changes that signature. <!--#434ea6b7babdeb11-->
- `test_snapshot_not_modified_when_signature_matches_and_no_new_records` (function) — Verifies that echoing both the progress token and matching signature with no new records yields a 'not_modified' delivery with empty records. <!--#d1be82cbad00e736-->
- `test_snapshot_delta_when_new_records_even_with_signature` (function) — Ensures that when new records exist a snapshot returns a 'delta' with the tail records rather than 'not_modified', even if a signature is supplied. <!--#411dac7fe15ab98f-->
- `test_snapshot_legacy_client_without_signature_keeps_empty_delta` (function) — Confirms a client echoing only a token (no signature) still gets the old records-empty 'delta', keeping the not_modified fast path opt-in and backward compatible. <!--#157595ba561be479-->
- `test_snapshot_stale_signature_still_not_not_modified` (function) — Asserts a wrong/stale signature (with valid token at offset==total) falls back to an empty 'delta' instead of 'not_modified'. <!--#e662b7106fc9c9c9-->
- `test_bundle_signature_is_cheap_and_stable` (function) — Tests that bundle_signature is deterministic yet distinct across changes in record count, generation, and machine id. <!--#3ac4feb2ba6151c6-->
- `test_full_pull_throttle_window` (function) — Verifies ServerState's full-pull throttle marks a flow as recently pulled and respects the min_interval window (throttled unless the window is zero). <!--#9f1e684701fa3856-->
- `test_find_call_owner_scans_pending_calls` (function) — Checks that find_call_owner locates the owning (machine, project_root) of a pending call_id and returns None for unknown ids. <!--#fa8b3816110222d9-->
- `test_find_call_owner_disambiguates_by_project_root` (function) — Ensures find_call_owner pins a duplicated local call_id to the correct machine/project via project_root and returns None for an unmatched root. <!--#5016373fa37b19f0-->
- `RecordingHub` (class) — A minimal UiHub stand-in that records every scoped and owned broadcast so tests can assert on browser fan-out behavior. <!--#6661421851f19d63-->
  - `RecordingHub.__init__` (method) — Initializes the stub with a client count and empty lists capturing scoped and owned broadcasts. <!--#4026e1ba6580af2b-->
  - `RecordingHub.client_count` (method) — Property returning the configured number of connected UI clients. <!--#854f4922a8380908-->
  - `RecordingHub.distinct_owners` (method) — Returns the set of distinct owners, always {None} for this stub. <!--#b1dfd7732fb9e9b5-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_scoped` (method) — Records an owner-scoped broadcast payload into the scoped list. <!--#24ae51509d068209-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_owned` (method) — Records an owner-targeted broadcast payload and owner into the owned list. <!--#e03c98c48ffe7f09-->
- `test_keepalive_touches_liveness_without_broadcast` (function) — Verifies handling a keepalive frame refreshes a machine's last_seen liveness but triggers no browser fan-out. <!--#4b240bf11a8fd3f0-->
- `test_history_index_delta_merges_and_broadcasts_delta` (function) — Confirms an incoming history-index-delta frame is merged into the full index and relayed to /ws/ui as a machine-stamped delta frame rather than a full re-fan. <!--#3ed6ec0a298df223-->
- `test_detail_data_resolves_registry_waiter` (function) — Checks that a DETAIL_DATA message resolves the DetailRequestRegistry future so the awaiting caller receives the full detail body. <!--#88b8ff43d75d8e3a-->
- `test_detail_registry_followers_share_one_pull` (function) — Verifies that a second request for the same (kind,id,machine,root) target becomes a follower parked under the leader, so one reply wakes both waiters. <!--#50e9ac71125d28fd-->
- `test_detail_registry_scopes_coalescing_to_machine_and_root` (function) — Ensures detail-pull coalescing keys on the full (kind,id,machine,root) tuple so identical local ids on different machines/projects each lead their own pull, preventing cross-owner leaks. <!--#e1ecc99e8db73722-->

- `_drain_index_requests` (function) — Helper that reads daemon frames, skipping history-index-request frames, until one of the wanted type is received. <!--#a86b5a6038a4e1c7-->
- `test_gzip_middleware_registered` (function) — Asserts the built app has GZipMiddleware registered in its middleware stack. <!--#4be3ea510761a53f-->

- `test_run_falls_back_when_uvicorn_lacks_deflate_kwarg` (function) — Confirms run() retries without ws_per_message_deflate when an older uvicorn rejects the kwarg, rather than crashing. <!--#90495718bbee3ac7-->
- `test_history_bundle_large_json_served_intact` (function) — End-to-end REST test that a large full history bundle survives the GZip middleware with all records and a signature intact. <!--#0b48993990167f90-->
- `test_history_not_modified_via_rest` (function) — Exercises the REST /api/history/{flow} endpoint to confirm re-requesting with matching after-token and sig returns a 'not_modified' empty response. <!--#6cb06abf02d185fe-->
- `test_issue_detail_endpoint_pulls_full_text` (function) — Integration test that GET /api/issues/{id}/detail routes a DETAIL_REQUEST to the owning daemon and returns the full untruncated issue body from the reply. <!--#c5b024c59d81bb52-->
- `test_call_detail_endpoint_resolves_owner_and_pulls` (function) — Integration test that GET /api/calls/{id}/detail resolves the call's owner, issues a DETAIL_REQUEST, and returns the full prompt body from the daemon reply. <!--#8f41aad8c7a606d6-->
- `test_call_detail_no_daemon_404` (function) — Asserts that requesting call detail for an unknown call id with no daemon returns HTTP 404. <!--#ef2aac4f77f337b6-->

- `test_issue_detail_pre_v3_daemon_serves_mirror` (function) — Verifies that for a pre-v3 daemon, an over-clip issue detail request short-circuits to the STATUS_UPDATE mirror body with a fast 200 instead of parking a doomed pull. <!--#86ea1182e95fc45b-->

### `tests/test_server_history.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the server-side history relay, exercising ServerState's per-machine history index aggregation/sorting, full-then-append record merging with cursor tracking, the requires-authoritative-full guard against non-full first frames, cache-population return signals, and WebSocket/REST pull paths (cache hit/miss and timeout). <!--#63ad8d51994b88f0|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/test_server_history_authoritative_root.py` (python) — Pytest/async test module for the WebUI server's history layer, pinning three behaviours: `get_history_flow_project_root` resolves a flow's authoritative `project_root` from the history index (owner-scoped, index preferred over the live flow set, None when unknown), `ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow` classifies only running/paused `se3/worktrees/` flows as active reconcile candidates, and the #287 add-only history floor that refuses empty or shorter `full` frames (marking them `rejected_full`) for active worktree flows while still allowing growth, same-length replacement, cross-machine takeover, and non-worktree/completed shrinks. <!--#cc95e7192574fed0|7add1136e2576c1a-->

- `test_project_root_not_first_match_but_authoritative_for_flow` (function) — Verifies that with multiple machines/roots registered, lookup returns the root owned by the specific flow rather than the first-enumerated root. <!--#44fb8070e412ad85-->
- `test_project_root_falls_back_to_live_flow_set` (function) — Checks that a flow present only in the live status flow set (not yet indexed) still resolves its project_root. <!--#01b21f6be11e965d-->
- `test_project_root_index_preferred_over_live_flow` (function) — Confirms the history index's project_root wins over a conflicting value in the live flow set. <!--#7ee4d1be330d9c49-->
- `test_project_root_unknown_flow_returns_none` (function) — Asserts an unknown flow id resolves to None. <!--#9688762f6f4c7a4d-->
- `test_project_root_empty_when_not_recorded` (function) — Asserts a flow indexed without a project_root degrades to None (legacy empty behaviour). <!--#ffc525c9a24fc841-->
- `test_project_root_owner_scoped_out_returns_none` (function) — Verifies owner scoping so a flow on one owner's machine is invisible to another owner's lookup. <!--#20bb9c9f9cf5418b-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture building an authenticated FastAPI TestClient (with a shortened history-index refresh timeout) and yielding the logged-in client plus app. <!--#558bf1ef1528e9b3-->
- `_receive_until` (function) — Test helper that drains daemon websocket frames, answering history-index requests, until a frame of the expected message type arrives. <!--#eea3795574e8743e-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_true_for_running_worktree` (function) — Verifies that ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow returns True for a running flow whose project_root sits under se3/worktrees/. <!--#02cca349ca3c0c3a-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_true_for_paused_worktree` (function) — Verifies that a paused worktree flow (e.g. discovery waiting on a human reply) still counts as active so the self-heal gate fires during the pending-reply window. <!--#b50e497a3ec26620-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_when_completed` (function) — Verifies that a completed worktree flow is no longer considered active, so no reconcile pull is triggered for it. <!--#c6fa5c4d53145de7-->

- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_for_paused_non_worktree` (function) — Asserts that `ServerState.is_active_worktree_flow` returns False for a `paused` flow whose `project_root` is an ordinary repo path, pinning the gate to worktree-AND-(running|paused) so the reconcile path cannot open for every pending-reply flow in the fleet. <!--#4b20378b8951cb75-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_false_for_unknown_flow` (function) — Verifies that is_active_worktree_flow returns False for a flow id the server has never seen. <!--#e60043139d31df55-->
- `test_is_active_worktree_flow_owner_scoped` (function) — Verifies that the active-worktree check is owner-scoped: one owner's active worktree flow is invisible when queried under a different owner. <!--#0cf89d498a06e565-->
- `test_identical_full_repull_keeps_generation` (function) — Verifies that an identical full history re-pull keeps the bundle generation stable (so in-sync clients aren't forced to re-fetch) while a grown re-pull rolls a fresh generation. <!--#4331a2bd2b1b3d2e-->
- `_round` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal discovery history record dict for a given ordinal. <!--#c1080140cdba2448-->
- `_register_flow` (function) — Async test helper that pushes a STATUS_UPDATE registering one flow on machine `m1` with the given status and `project_root`, so the state layer can classify it as (non-)worktree/active. <!--#c28b5c262504e728-->
- `_paused_worktree_flow` (function) — Async test helper that registers a flow as `paused` under a `se3/worktrees/` path — the exact shape that engages the add-only history floor. <!--#9830061ff381dc9e-->
- `test_empty_full_does_not_wipe_existing_bundle` (function) — Regression test for #287: an empty `full` frame from the same machine must leave an existing non-empty bundle and its generation untouched while still reporting as applied so pull waiters are released. <!--#4e26d7d164323ba2-->
- `test_empty_full_never_wipes_existing_bundle_whatever_the_flow` (function) — Parametrized test asserting the empty-`full` refusal is unconditional across flow registrations (including unregistered flows), and that the frame is marked `rejected_full` so the `/ws/ui` fan-out does not relay it. <!--#13c24b2f93482965-->
- `test_shorter_non_empty_full_does_not_shrink_existing_bundle` (function) — Asserts the add-only floor also blocks a non-empty but strictly shorter `full` frame for a paused worktree flow, preserving the later rounds and the generation. <!--#31e606229014de42-->
- `test_same_length_full_replace_is_applied` (function) — Asserts the floor is about record COUNT, not content — an equal-length `full` that rewrites records in place still replaces the bundle. <!--#76e0487b9fd97197-->
- `test_shrinking_full_still_replaces_bundle_for_a_non_worktree_flow` (function) — Asserts a shrinking `full` frame for an ordinary (non-worktree) flow still replaces the bundle, rolls the generation, and is not flagged `rejected_full`, preserving pre-#287 retry behaviour. <!--#d46ea965f4b68d5e-->
- `test_shrinking_full_still_replaces_bundle_for_a_completed_worktree_flow` (function) — Asserts the shrink floor tracks the reconcile gate's status half — a terminal (`completed`) worktree flow's shorter `full` frame still replaces the bundle normally. <!--#ec9d74562f70beba-->
- `test_non_empty_full_still_replaces_and_rolls_generation` (function) — Asserts the guard does not blunt a genuine self-heal reconcile — a `full` frame carrying MORE records replaces the bundle and rolls the generation so clients re-fetch. <!--#c93180308510a66a-->
- `test_cross_machine_full_still_establishes_new_bundle` (function) — Asserts the no-rollback guard is scoped to the same machine — a `full` frame from a different `machine_id` takes over the bundle wholesale even if shorter. <!--#ddbbba59d3c7c517-->
- `test_first_empty_full_still_creates_empty_bundle` (function) — Asserts an empty `full` frame with no cached bundle still writes through to create an authoritative empty bundle that later `append` frames can extend. <!--#bc2e7cc2d4508f34-->
- `_sync_live_flow` (function) — Test helper that polls the REST flow endpoint until a STATUS_UPDATE-reported flow becomes visible, failing if it never appears. <!--#340efbc6432c6d07-->
- `_report_running_flow` (function) — Test helper that sends a STATUS_UPDATE over the daemon websocket reporting a single running flow at the given project root. <!--#f144495ec85626c0-->
- `_first_full_pull` (function) — Test helper that issues the cache-miss history GET in a background thread, answers the daemon's HISTORY_REQUEST with the given records, and returns the response JSON. <!--#863884d15d001709-->
- `test_running_worktree_selfheal_reconciles_missing_round` (function) — End-to-end test that a running worktree flow whose server cache froze at round 1 self-heals on the next poll by re-pulling the daemon, delivering the missing round 2 with per-file step identities preserved. <!--#ca10d83dff24510f-->
- `test_running_worktree_selfheal_respects_throttle` (function) — Verifies that within the full-pull throttle window an in-sync poll answers not_modified from cache instead of re-pulling the daemon, preventing one pull per self-heal tick. <!--#ccd1433f490df7a8-->
- `test_non_worktree_flow_never_reconciles` (function) — Verifies that the self-heal reconcile is worktree-only: an ordinary running flow's in-sync poll is served from cache even with the throttle disabled. <!--#8521a2b264a1582e-->
- `test_cache_miss_pull_sends_authoritative_project_root` (function) — End-to-end test that a GET /api/history/{flow_id} cache miss instructs the daemon to read the flow's authoritative worktree project_root. <!--#37df395c81ec5014-->
- `test_cache_miss_pull_empty_root_when_unrecorded` (function) — End-to-end test that a cache-miss pull for a flow with no recorded root sends an empty project_root, preserving legacy non-worktree behaviour. <!--#a44d5bf8091f3331-->

### `tests/test_server_history_live_append_broadcast.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the MSG_HISTORY_DATA broadcast-suppression rule (#193), driving the real server through UiHub, HistoryRequestRegistry, and DaemonHistoryReader to prove that live `append` deltas always reach subscribed UI clients (even when they resolve a REST pull waiter) while only `full` cache-miss replies are suppressed, and that self-heal recovery pulls arm, dedupe, and expire correctly against golden e2e fixtures. <!--#45cf1b63ad70a414|886e14b53df3a594-->
- `_UiWS` (class) — Minimal UI WebSocket stand-in that captures decoded frames sent to it and can filter them by history type and flow id. <!--#7ad41ce10c30c033-->
  - `_UiWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the stand-in's `sent` list that accumulates received frames. <!--#d14bbb740fc91394-->
  - `_UiWS.send_text` (method) — Decodes the JSON frame it is sent and appends it to the captured `sent` list. <!--#015e8192c9e42ee8-->
  - `_UiWS.history_frames` (method) — Returns the captured `history_data` frames, optionally filtered to a given flow id. <!--#bf1df282dc320385-->
- `_setup` (function) — Async fixture helper building a `ServerState` with one registered machine plus a `UiHub`, subscribed UI client, and `HistoryRequestRegistry`. <!--#6882b69cc105b9ba-->
- `_history_msg` (function) — Builds a `make_history_data` protocol message for the given flow, mode, records, and optional cursor. <!--#b3cef8632536f01e-->
- `test_full_pull_reply_resolving_waiter_is_not_broadcast` (function) — Asserts a `mode: full` frame that resolves a parked pull waiter resolves the future but is not re-broadcast to the UI socket. <!--#6cc7bb0aac263919-->
- `test_unsolicited_full_without_waiter_is_broadcast` (function) — Asserts a live `mode: full` replacement that resolves no waiter is still streamed to the UI client. <!--#54244e9ae4a93f12-->
- `test_append_resolving_waiter_is_still_broadcast` (function) — Core regression test that a `mode: append` racing a REST pull both resolves the waiter and is broadcast to the live view. <!--#29206f5e73a92ff0-->
- `test_live_append_without_waiter_is_broadcast` (function) — Asserts an ordinary active-flow append with no pull waiter streams unchanged to the UI. <!--#3f8e5618de5329a0-->
- `test_consecutive_appends_after_respond_keep_broadcasting` (function) — Asserts three successive post-respond appends (one resolving a stray waiter) all reach the live view in order. <!--#e54ef12d305b0c8e-->
- `test_append_broadcast_is_owner_scoped` (function) — Asserts a broadcast append reaches only the owning UI client and not a different owner's subscriber. <!--#54ae99d16f1a98e8-->
- `test_appends_after_bundle_keep_applied_and_stable_generation` (function) — Asserts successive appends on an existing bundle apply, keep the generation stable, and that the full REST snapshot contains every appended record. <!--#de9309fa27a97daa-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that writes a list of records as JSON lines to a file, creating parent dirs. <!--#382769e0f0931aaa-->
- `_append_jsonl` (function) — Test helper that appends a list of records as JSON lines to an existing file. <!--#3e163ee803b3f93e-->
- `_write_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes an `engine.json` state file with a flow id and status. <!--#ad7cd047d3327879-->
- `_hist` (function) — Test helper returning the on-disk history directory path for a given flow id. <!--#315a508136847fa4-->
- `_chat` (function) — Test helper building a chat record dict with role, content, and timestamp. <!--#653f232ec7903ab1-->
- `_started` (function) — Test helper building a `step_started` event record dict. <!--#3d42e46002c7b57f-->
- `_status` (function) — Test helper building a `step_status` event record dict with a given status. <!--#920eaa840d4289bb-->
- `_completed` (function) — Test helper building a `step_completed` event record dict with nested step data. <!--#7f324cfde56a8bb3-->
- `_failed` (function) — Test helper building a `step_failed` event record dict carrying an error message. <!--#ee10107398495af0-->
- `_transition_mutations` (function) — Returns an ordered list of filesystem mutation callbacks scripting a discovery flow that runs confirm rounds, completes, and transitions into analyze. <!--#55bf5514dc8de44b-->
- `_retry_mutations` (function) — Returns an ordered list of mutation callbacks scripting an update_spec step that fails, is retried, and re-runs to success. <!--#5fff23fdcc62de77-->
- `_drive_scenario` (function) — Drives the real `DaemonHistoryReader` through a mutation script into the real server broadcast, returning the UI frames and authoritative snapshot records. <!--#0c357244a78339e9-->
- `_generate_all` (function) — Runs both the transition and retry scenarios under a temp path and returns their combined frame/snapshot results. <!--#111188bdb850f608-->
- `_flat_records` (function) — Flattens a list of frames into a single concatenated list of their records. <!--#3e590f849a35ae9e-->
- `test_transition_broadcast_equals_full_snapshot_no_loss_no_dup` (function) — Asserts the concatenated transition broadcast (initial full then appends) exactly equals the authoritative snapshot with no lost or duplicated records. <!--#84b2c402e8d835e0-->
- `test_transition_analyze_arrives_as_live_delta_not_swallowed` (function) — Asserts the post-transition analyze records arrive in live append frames with the correct step_type, proving the transition batch is not swallowed. <!--#6e02fde2a1a538dc-->
- `test_retry_broadcast_equals_full_snapshot_no_loss_no_dup` (function) — Asserts the retry scenario's broadcast equals the full snapshot and that the success turn and similar-looking retry draft both stream as live deltas. <!--#829eec0b4656e356-->
- `test_e2e_frames_match_committed_golden_fixture` (function) — Asserts the generated daemon→server e2e frames match the committed golden fixture, regenerating it when `SE3_REGEN_GOLDEN` is set. <!--#c4428a64183fd608-->
- `test_take_recovery_pull_fires_once_per_stuck_flow` (function) — Asserts that a first-sighting discarded append arms exactly one recovery pull per stuck flow, dedupes a second consult while in flight, and never arms a pull for a healthy flow. <!--#e2fd46ad87964b15-->
- `test_recovery_marker_cleared_when_full_frame_heals_bundle` (function) — Verifies that when the recovery's full reply repopulates the bundle it clears both the requires_full flag and the in-flight recovery marker for the flow. <!--#f4db1280d3f28652-->
- `test_clear_recovery_pull_re_arms_after_failed_send` (function) — Checks that explicitly clearing the recovery marker after a failed send releases it so a later append can re-arm a fresh recovery instead of wedging. <!--#ca9d0dbf117bd73c-->
- `test_recovery_marker_expires_when_reply_never_arrives` (function) — Confirms the timestamped recovery marker, once aged past its TTL on the monotonic clock, is treated as lost so a later discarded append re-arms a fresh pull. <!--#3c8889fbec2dea79-->
- `_RecordingDaemonWS` (class) — Fake daemon WebSocket that records each MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST recovery frame the server sends so tests can assert how many self-heal pulls fired. <!--#70ace732c5c37d47-->
  - `_RecordingDaemonWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake daemon socket with an empty list to accumulate captured request payloads. <!--#b21109e749814b4e-->
  - `_RecordingDaemonWS.send_text` (method) — Decodes an outgoing frame and records its payload only when it is a MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST. <!--#8ad3458d71f88f9a-->
- `test_first_sighting_append_dispatches_one_recovery_pull_then_heals` (function) — End-to-end test that a first-sighting append dispatches exactly one recovery pull, dedupes a second, and after the daemon's full reply heals the bundle so a later append applies and broadcasts to the live view without a re-enter. <!--#b789423bae269be1-->
- `test_recovery_pull_skipped_when_no_daemon_connection` (function) — Ensures that without a connection manager the handler degrades gracefully—flagging the flow requires_full without crashing or consuming the marker, so a later manager-backed retry can still heal it. <!--#934c08df37a56d57-->
- `_drive_server_restart_midflow` (function) — Helper that drives the real DaemonHistoryReader through a server-restart-mid-flow scenario (server-down phase advancing the cursor, then a restart with empty cache), answering each self-heal pull with the authoritative full snapshot, and returns the collected UI frames, snapshot, and recovery-pull count. <!--#9f4cf64dbd162caa-->
- `test_restart_at_discovery_analyze_boundary_self_heals_no_reenter` (function) — Integration test that a server restart across the discovery→analyze boundary self-heals with exactly one recovery pull, the full frame reaching the live view and subsequent appends converging on the authoritative snapshot with no loss, dup, or re-enter. <!--#17ded3a06a8ec941-->
- `test_healthy_boundary_never_triggers_recovery_pull` (function) — Regression test that a healthy boundary with no restart establishes the bundle from a full frame first, dispatches zero recovery pulls, and streams appends that equal the authoritative snapshot. <!--#8366b69d2df4bfa5-->

### `tests/test_server_interjection.py` (python) — Test module covering the FastAPI mid-flow interjection/respond endpoints (dispatch, 404 unknown flow, 422 empty text, 503 offline machine, resolving non-call pending calls) and `se3 run`'s TTY-vs-non-TTY failure handler that externalises retry_decision call files. <!--#8aa27a619634de80|92f4585162ccb414-->
