- `_write_engine` (function) — Fixture helper that writes a minimal engine.json state file (with flow id and worktree-mode flag) for a given root. <!--#fe1627fd8b5d2a0c-->
- `test_resolve_worktree_attributes_to_main_root` (function) — Asserts a worktree path resolves to its main project root and is recognized as a worktree copy. <!--#5798971e2fe73bd7-->
- `test_resolve_returns_none_for_plain_project` (function) — Asserts a plain (non-worktree) project root resolves to None and is not flagged as a worktree copy. <!--#a9dc2883c766b611-->
- `test_resolve_nested_worktree_stops_at_immediate_parent` (function) — Asserts a nested worktree resolves to its immediate parent root rather than the outermost root. <!--#751307a08c585539-->
- `test_resolve_skips_non_worktree_structure` (function) — Asserts paths not shaped like <main>/se3/worktrees/<name> (and empty paths) are left alone, returning None. <!--#16d0796ca952484e-->
- `_FakeProc` (class) — Test double mimicking a psutil process exposing an info dict of pid, cmdline, and cwd. <!--#c135469455097652-->
  - `_FakeProc.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake process's info dict from the given pid, cmdline, and cwd. <!--#4d2d00d10224fba1-->
- `_FakePsutil` (class) — Test double standing in for the psutil module, exposing process iteration and exception types over a fixed process list. <!--#0bc71c7ed92659d6-->
  - `_FakePsutil.__init__` (method) — Stores the fixed list of fake processes to be returned by process_iter. <!--#683a9b76f6799f49-->
  - `_FakePsutil.Process` (method) — Returns a stub current-process object with a fixed pid, mirroring psutil.Process(). <!--#daeacaeeee612078-->
  - `_FakePsutil.process_iter` (method) — Returns the stored list of fake processes, mirroring psutil.process_iter. <!--#014eb04ee2710413-->
- `test_scan_external_registers_main_root_for_worktree_proc` (function) — Asserts the supervisor's external scan attributes a worktree-running se3 process to the main root, not the worktree path. <!--#2401425fde00305e-->
- `test_collect_issues_skips_worktree_copy` (function) — Asserts the aggregator collects issues from the main root but returns none for a worktree copy. <!--#0c5917003435a3ce-->
- `test_snapshot_does_not_double_count_worktree_issues` (function) — Asserts a worktree run surfaces as a flow card yet its cloned issues are counted once and its copy dir is not a standalone project. <!--#d0ba1a971d4d15a0-->
- `test_worktree_root_excluded_from_project_roots` (function) — Asserts the snapshot's dropdown-facing project_roots lists the main root but never the worktree copy. <!--#afc5a221a5571342-->
- `test_entry_point_seam_keeps_worktree_out_of_active_and_registry` (function) — Asserts driving a worktree path through the live Daemon's aggregator keeps it out of both the active set and the persisted registry. <!--#5b0067546e7a983d-->
- `test_append_project_root_defence_normalizes_worktree` (function) — Asserts the disk-write backstop folds an appended worktree path to its main root in the registry. <!--#9f2db23a139d97cd-->
- `test_startup_sanitize_cleans_polluted_registry_to_main_only` (function) — Asserts the one-time startup sanitize rewrites a worktree-polluted registry to contain only the main root. <!--#78f44ac31b0a9d78-->
- `test_startup_sanitize_clean_registry_not_rewritten` (function) — Asserts a registry with no worktree pollution is left byte-for-byte untouched (mtime unchanged) by sanitize. <!--#5910e04cdcb9d3da-->

### `tests/test_worktree_registry_seam.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying that the shared project-root aggregator seam normalizes worktree isolation paths back to their main root across all registration entry points (add/append/sanitize), persists the folded root to the on-disk registry, sanitizes pre-existing worktree pollution on daemon startup (tolerating missing/corrupt/clean files), and keeps worktrees observable via run-roots yet absent from the displayed project-root set. <!--#bff3f32849cb1219|1ab79b2838871912-->
- `_make_project` (function) — Fixture helper that creates a minimal se3 project root (with an se3/state dir) and returns its path. <!--#748ca3e66dd0a518-->
- `_make_worktree` (function) — Fixture helper that creates a worktree isolation copy under <main>/se3/worktrees/<name> and returns its path. <!--#1eaebfdea715cd81-->
- `test_add_project_root_normalizes_active_set` (function) — Asserts add_project_root folds a worktree path to its main root in the aggregator's in-memory active set. <!--#e0d531fe6adeddb1-->
- `test_add_project_root_normalizes_registry_persist` (function) — Asserts the registry_persist callback fired by add_project_root receives the main root, not the worktree copy. <!--#92fb6638c9ed8f2a-->
- `test_add_project_root_plain_path_unchanged` (function) — Asserts a non-worktree path passes through add_project_root verbatim into both the active set and the persist callback. <!--#b98966a160a6a5af-->
- `test_all_entry_points_normalize_through_seam` (function) — Asserts that driving a worktree path through the shared aggregator seam normalizes both the in-memory set and the on-disk registry, covering all five registration entry points. <!--#c277da825f3abaa1-->
- `test_append_project_root_normalizes_worktree` (function) — Asserts the disk write point _append_project_root folds a worktree path back to its main root before persisting. <!--#b7aead7edb298071-->
- `test_sanitize_removes_worktree_entry` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots cleans and rewrites a registry already polluted with a worktree-copy entry. <!--#5228f62244a4d53c-->
- `test_sanitize_no_change_leaves_file_untouched` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots leaves an already-clean registry file unwritten (mtime unchanged). <!--#db62dc439fced750-->
- `test_sanitize_missing_file_is_noop` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots is a fault-tolerant no-op when the registry file does not exist. <!--#7ff3f36d1a7bfdcb-->
- `test_sanitize_corrupt_file_is_noop` (function) — Asserts a corrupt registry file reads as empty and is left untouched by _sanitize_project_roots. <!--#12444e2d6cb24515-->
- `test_daemon_init_sanitizes_on_startup` (function) — Asserts Daemon construction runs the one-time registry sanitize, purging pre-existing worktree entries on startup. <!--#9f2ccf15bacf0701-->
- `test_worktree_observable_but_not_registered` (function) — Asserts a worktree remains visible via the run-roots observable channel yet never appears in the displayed project-root set after normalization. <!--#bd2cc3d2fbf7d1db-->

### `tests/test_worktree_seam_regression.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the worktree observability seam, asserting that an eagerly-saved worktree-mode flow's engine.json is readable and its live multi-round discovery reaches the frontend (via a Python mirror of the WebUI reconcile logic) while the worktree never leaks into the registry, active set, or project-root dropdown. <!--#2574ce0a18c8bf38|b677453f8e66c234-->
- `_eager_save_worktree_flow` (function) — Test helper that mimics the run command's eager save by creating a pending worktree-mode flow and immediately persisting its engine.json at status INIT. <!--#1c56a9651dab0d1a-->
- `test_eager_save_persists_is_worktree_mode_at_init` (function) — Asserts the eager save writes an engine.json carrying is_worktree_mode and worktree_path at status INIT before any discovery LLM call. <!--#76c38c312ac1b1b0-->
- `test_worktree_observable_at_discovery_startup_window` (function) — Verifies the eager-saved worktree is admitted to the observable root set at INIT yet stays out of the dropdown-facing project root list. <!--#bcb044e5517e7ad0-->
- `test_discovery_first_reply_read_live_at_init` (function) — Checks that a complete-but-unterminated discovery first reply reads live and is indexed as active from the INIT engine.json, then keeps appending incrementally on cursor reads. <!--#b756ce7b72c32b66-->
- `test_dag_isolation_worktree_stays_excluded` (function) — Guards that a DAG implement-isolation worktree (no top-level is_worktree_mode record) remains excluded from the observable set despite sharing the worktrees parent. <!--#2d6b1ed0233c6fd1-->
- `test_seam_observable_and_readable_yet_never_registered` (function) — Single bidirectional-guard test asserting both seam invariants at once — the worktree is observable/readable (Bug1) yet never enters the active set, registry, or project list (Bug2). <!--#e5f3fa7072c4b369-->
- `_disc_msg` (function) — Builds a minimal discovery chat message dict with the given role and content. <!--#0921d926f4665974-->
- `_FrontendConsole` (class) — Faithful Python mirror of the app.js WebUI history reconcile logic, applying daemon push frames (full snapshots with discovery dedupe, idempotent append merges) to simulate what the chat would render. <!--#bb9f6c7a148b69fe-->
  - `_FrontendConsole.__init__` (method) — Initializes the console with an empty list of held (rendered) records. <!--#8eef94d1ac7269b2-->
  - `_FrontendConsole._ordinal` (method) — Extracts a record's integer ordinal from the record itself or its nested message, returning None if absent. <!--#4b1a3ef8f604450d-->
  - `_FrontendConsole._legacy_key` (method) — Computes the content-based fallback identity key (step_id, role, content length, content prefix) mirroring app.js legacyKeyFromNorm. <!--#b3be1a71cd61e99d-->
  - `_FrontendConsole._record_key` (method) — Returns a record's stable identity as stepId#ordinal when both are present, else falls back to the legacy content key. <!--#652e8aa2170aa046-->
  - `_FrontendConsole._dedupe_snapshot_discovery` (method) — Content-aware dedupe of a full snapshot that drops byte-identical discovery-record clones while keeping distinct-content records sharing a key. <!--#983aab4558dde552-->
  - `_FrontendConsole._reconcile_append` (method) — Idempotently merges an append batch into held records, converging same-key records to newest content in place and never creating duplicate bubbles. <!--#9608bc6c8742b98f-->
  - `_FrontendConsole.apply` (method) — Applies one daemon push frame as the WebUI would: a full snapshot replaces held records after dedupe, an append is reconciled in. <!--#a8f30db97d703946-->
  - `_FrontendConsole.contents` (method) — Returns the message content strings of all held records, i.e. what the chat would show. <!--#b6fe36bc7af50d3b-->
  - `_FrontendConsole.keys` (method) — Returns the stable record key for each held record, used to assert identity uniqueness. <!--#48ae915d408f5a64-->
- `_make_reader` (function) — Constructs a DaemonHistoryReader whose project-roots provider yields the given root paths. <!--#a53d3c7a25b35ec7-->
- `_wt_flow_dir` (function) — Creates and returns the se3/history/<flow_id> directory under the given root. <!--#49db03061fd22256-->
- `_make_worktree` (function) — Creates and returns a fake worktree directory under the main root's se3/worktrees. <!--#b329f4718dc5d89d-->
- `_write_jsonl` (function) — Writes the given records as a fresh JSONL file, creating parent directories as needed. <!--#f321072562a278a4-->
- `_append_jsonl` (function) — Appends the given records as JSONL lines to an existing file. <!--#826510bf1d7d8393-->
- `test_e2e_worktree_multiround_discovery_all_rounds_reach_frontend` (function) — #278 end-to-end regression test chaining real reader → real server relay → frontend reconcile to assert every round of a live multi-round worktree discovery (including the final verdict) reaches the frontend chat without drops or duplicates and matches the server's authoritative bundle. <!--#8611047cfa66114d-->
- `test_e2e_worktree_discovery_cross_source_rounds_all_render` (function) — #278 end-to-end test for the split-root topology where a primary discovery file and a .from-<branch> sidecar each start at ordinal 0, asserting distinct step_ids keep their keys from colliding so both sources render fully instead of the sidecar being dropped as a duplicate. <!--#7e522cae26a74618-->

### `tests/test_ws_rejected_full_not_broadcast.py` (python) — Regression tests for #287 pinning that a `full` history frame rejected by `ServerState.apply_history_frame` (a shrinking same-machine snapshot for an active worktree flow) is flagged via `rejected_full` and suppressed by the `/ws/ui` handler, while legitimate growing frames and non-worktree flows still broadcast to the UI as before. <!--#afcd31e06996f05f|abc9e638c0397610-->
- `RecordingHub` (class) — A minimal stand-in for the WebSocket `UiHub` that records every `broadcast_owned`/`broadcast_scoped` call so tests can assert exactly what (if anything) was fanned out to browser consoles. <!--#303a661440235cd9-->
  - `RecordingHub.__init__` (method) — Initialises the fake hub with a fixed client count and empty `owned`/`scoped` recording lists. <!--#037e799bfb43ad93-->
  - `RecordingHub.client_count` (method) — Reports the configured number of connected UI clients so the fan-out code believes someone is listening. <!--#854f4922a8380908-->
  - `RecordingHub.distinct_owners` (method) — Returns the single anonymous owner set `{None}` matching the ownerless flows these tests register. <!--#b1dfd7732fb9e9b5-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_scoped` (method) — Records a per-owner broadcast payload instead of sending it over any socket. <!--#24ae51509d068209-->
  - `RecordingHub.broadcast_owned` (method) — Records an owner-targeted broadcast payload instead of sending it over any socket. <!--#e03c98c48ffe7f09-->
- `_history_pushes` (function) — Helper that filters a `RecordingHub`'s recorded owned broadcasts down to the `history_data` payloads. <!--#b25cfe61843d556e-->
- `_register_flow` (function) — Async helper that registers machine `m1` and reports one flow with the given status and `project_root`, since those fields decide whether a shrinking full frame is rejected. <!--#038fac2f523d12c4-->
- `_paused_worktree_flow` (function) — Convenience wrapper around `_register_flow` that sets up the paused-worktree flow shape which triggers the #287 rejection path. <!--#9830061ff381dc9e-->
- `test_apply_history_frame_flags_a_rejected_shrinking_full` (function) — Asserts `ServerState.apply_history_frame` sets `rejected_full` for shrinking and empty full frames (but not identical ones) while still resolving the pull waiter and leaving the cached bundle intact. <!--#c1f98eecd6056767-->
- `test_rejected_shrinking_full_is_not_broadcast_to_ui` (function) — Regression test for #287: a truncated full frame for a worktree flow is applied-but-rejected and must reach no UI client, with the cache keeping both rounds. <!--#f8ccb3897df5b4d7-->
- `test_shrinking_full_for_a_non_worktree_flow_is_still_broadcast` (function) — Guards the fix's scope: an ordinary (non-worktree) flow's legitimately shrinking full frame is still applied and relayed to the UI as before. <!--#bb649d969e0702f0-->
- `test_growing_full_still_broadcasts_to_ui` (function) — Confirms the suppression doesn't break the worktree self-heal path — a full frame that adds records is accepted and broadcast to the UI. <!--#58b7512d986b9cf0-->

## `tests/commands/` — Test package for SE3's CLI command layer, bundling the `merge` command's own sub-suite alongside tests for `run` (flow orchestration, resume, failure-action/retry decisions, presets, worktree isolation mode), `code-index search`, `worktree gc`, `--from-issue` finalization, merge source-issue backfill, and command-layer i18n key coverage and language switching. <!--#12920df32bf1c921|ed8753e8890e5f3c-->

### `tests/commands/__init__.py` (python) — Package init marker for the se3 command tests directory, containing only a header comment and no functional code. <!--#2e351cd9cd7e4289|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/commands/test_cli_i18n.py` (python) — Test suite guarding the CLI command-layer i18n migration: it AST-extracts every literal `t()` key used by the migrated command modules and asserts catalog coverage in en-US, checks zh-CN keys are a subset of the en-US base with per-key fallback, and runs end-to-end CLI invocations to verify output (including status values in issue/history tables) actually switches language under SE3_LANG. <!--#35fac6eca71021a6|f74bdfe0a5e665dd-->
- `_t_literal_keys` (function) — Test helper that AST-parses a source file and returns the set of string-literal first arguments passed to `t(...)`, i.e. the translation keys that must resolve against the catalog. <!--#124ba74559d1d53a-->
- `test_every_used_key_present_in_en_us` (function) — Parametrized test asserting that every literal `t()` key used by a migrated module exists in the en-US catalog. <!--#cdc6c0782d82c9d5-->
- `test_all_modules_actually_migrated` (function) — Sanity test asserting each module listed in MIGRATED_MODULES actually contains at least one `t()` call site. <!--#d66f3785d1de66ca-->
- `test_zh_keys_are_subset_of_en_base` (function) — Asserts zh-CN introduces no orphan keys, i.e. its key set is a subset of the en-US base catalog. <!--#4f9598f4007c3a89-->
- `test_missing_zh_key_falls_back_to_en_per_key` (function) — Verifies per-key fallback: a key present only in en-US renders the en-US string even when the language is zh-CN. <!--#503206e35e411056-->
- `test_command_output_switches_language` (function) — Parametrized end-to-end test that invokes CLI commands under SE3_LANG=en-US vs zh-CN and asserts the output contains the expected localized substrings and genuinely differs. <!--#be8d6573c1c80fff-->
- `test_se3_lang_env_drives_cli_output` (function) — Asserts the SE3_LANG environment variable (top of the precedence chain) selects the CLI output language, using the `merge` command's error message. <!--#c035ffeb3e10862b-->
- `test_multiline_prompt_chrome_is_resolved_at_call_time` (function) — Regression test that `cli._read_multiline_input` resolves its prompt title/message translations at call time (defaults are None) rather than pinning them at import time. <!--#f0a79d7857ba0360-->
- `_cell_texts` (function) — Test helper that renders a Rich console callable into plain recorded text so table contents can be asserted on. <!--#ca75136990bf0ee5-->
- `test_issue_list_and_show_localize_status_values` (function) — Asserts `issue list`/`issue show` localize the status *value* (e.g. `open` → 待处理) under zh-CN, not just the column header. <!--#62ae44b670ad9351-->
- `test_history_tables_localize_status_values` (function) — Asserts the history flow-list table renders translated engine status tokens (e.g. `completed` → 已完成) under zh-CN instead of the raw enum value. <!--#c57557c7498a391c-->

### `tests/commands/test_code_index_search.py` (python) — Pytest suite driving the `se3 code-index search` CLI (grep-style search over code-index item lines) against a hand-authored `code-index.md`, verifying regex-vs-`-F` literal matching, case sensitivity/`-i`, `-m` max-count and exit codes, symbol path rendering, fingerprint-comment stripping, `-n` no-op acceptance, and rebuild hints for invalid/unbuilt states. <!--#af7e0ba91bb38ed8|f75e7bb6223de2e3-->
- `built_project` (function) — Pytest fixture that writes the hand-authored `_MD` code-index map to a temp project and monkeypatches `get_project_root` so the CLI resolves to it. <!--#979b9f2476dbbe83-->
- `_match_lines` (function) — Test helper that extracts only the emitted item-bullet match lines (those starting with '- `') from command output, dropping diagnostics. <!--#056ae148d158e41a-->
- `test_regex_match_hits_and_exit_zero` (function) — Asserts patterns are treated as regex by default, so `Greet.r` matches the `Greeter` lines and exits 0. <!--#333e9cc6a95a364e-->
- `test_fixed_strings_literal_not_regex` (function) — Verifies the `-F` flag treats the pattern as a literal string, matching only the line containing `a.*b` verbatim rather than as a regex. <!--#5dfd3f6ae508ccaf-->
- `test_case_sensitive_by_default_and_ignore_case` (function) — Checks searches are case-sensitive by default (lowercase `greeter` misses) and that `-i` enables case-insensitive matching. <!--#dc1c4359c11a2045-->
- `test_symbol_match_carries_owning_file_path` (function) — Confirms a symbol hit is rendered with its full `relpath::local_id` path (e.g. `src/mod.py::Greeter.hello`) rather than a bare bullet. <!--#6dc17e774f91a844-->
- `test_output_has_no_fingerprint_comments` (function) — Ensures search output rebuilt from the structured index never leaks the md's embedded `<!--#...-->` fingerprint comments. <!--#2708961ec2df9843-->
- `test_max_count_truncates` (function) — Verifies `-m 2` caps the number of emitted matches at two even when more lines would match. <!--#5316c1705585f9e8-->
- `test_max_count_zero_prints_nothing_exits_one` (function) — Verifies `-m 0` prints no lines and exits 1, matching grep's exit-status behavior. <!--#c1a5c2be6fe0714b-->
- `test_no_match_exits_one_with_message` (function) — Asserts an unmatched pattern exits 1 and prints the 'No code-index item matched' message with no match lines. <!--#820feaceaafb191e-->
- `test_invalid_regex_exits_two` (function) — Asserts a malformed regex (unbalanced `[`) yields grep-style exit 2 and an 'Invalid regular expression' message. <!--#90ae44b0f8839252-->
- `test_line_number_flag_accepted_exit_zero` (function) — Asserts the grep-muscle-memory `-n` flag is accepted (no longer a 'No such option' error) and that a matching code-index search still exits 0 with match lines. <!--#e7aea693883a5e41-->
- `test_line_number_output_identical_to_without` (function) — Verifies `-n` is a true byte-for-byte no-op by asserting a search with `-n` produces identical exit code and output to the same search without it. <!--#230e8880e4f468c5-->
- `test_line_number_combines_with_other_flags` (function) — Confirms `-n` composes cleanly with `-i`, `-F`, and `-m`, leaving each flag's semantics, exit code, and line-for-line output unchanged versus the same call without `-n`. <!--#a339dc6a5cb38654-->
- `test_unbuilt_map_hints_rebuild` (function) — Asserts that with no code-index.md on disk the search exits 1 and hints to run `code-index rebuild`, like the other subcommands. <!--#1b4d50face2f5cec-->

### `tests/commands/test_from_issue_finalize.py` (python) — Test module covering synchronous and worktree `--from-issue` finalization: proving the source-issue lifecycle is closed out from run_flow's persisted terminal status (not the process exit code), that the cli wrapper only self-reverts genuine pre-flow dispatch failures, and that fresh-process resumes and in-flow merges resolve/reopen the issue idempotently end-to-end. <!--#efd39f32acc3de80|967f18f32ab04605-->
- `_make_in_progress_issue` (function) — Test helper that creates an issue on disk and advances it to IN_PROGRESS, mirroring what a from-issue run does before dispatch, and returns the issue id. <!--#f6abe7c9c6b25e3d-->
- `_flow_with_source_issue` (function) — Test helper that builds a FlowInstance carrying source_issue_id and round-trips it through to_dict/from_dict to prove the id survives persistence for process-decoupled finalization. <!--#85f1a810d0a4356b-->
- `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue` (class) — Unit test class exercising run._finalize_sync_source_issue directly across completed/failed/worktree/no-issue/non-in-progress/error/missing cases. <!--#f4b8de6a321c3b00-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_completed_sync_resolves_issue` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED non-worktree flow's source issue is transitioned to RESOLVED. <!--#3bcbd01a60d218c3-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_failed_sync_reopens_issue` (method) — Asserts a FAILED non-worktree flow reopens its source issue back to OPEN. <!--#11f7c2bb1d89ccf9-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_worktree_flow_is_skipped` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED worktree flow does not resolve here (deferred to the trailing merge), leaving the issue IN_PROGRESS. <!--#e465ddc0f0622c7b-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_no_source_issue_is_noop` (method) — Asserts finalize is a safe no-op when the flow has no source_issue_id. <!--#d091839be2f1fdef-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_non_in_progress_issue_is_not_touched` (method) — Asserts an issue not held IN_PROGRESS (already RESOLVED) is left untouched by finalize. <!--#0a7a64915aae6a34-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_best_effort_swallows_update_errors` (method) — Asserts a raising IssueManager.update_status never propagates out of finalization, leaving the issue unchanged. <!--#05a637430da833bc-->
  - `TestFinalizeSyncSourceIssue.test_missing_issue_is_noop` (method) — Asserts finalize is a no-op when source_issue_id points at a non-existent issue. <!--#7c29df7e95951fac-->
- `TestFromIssueWrapperNoExitCodeFinalize` (class) — CLI-level test class verifying the from-issue wrapper does not resolve/reopen based on run_flow's return code, deferring finalization to run_flow's terminal branches. <!--#b30563c5e1852e0b-->
  - `TestFromIssueWrapperNoExitCodeFinalize._invoke` (method) — Helper that invokes `run --from-issue` via CliRunner with get_project_root and run_flow patched to a fixed return code, returning the result and the run_flow mock. <!--#604415abd93c3696-->
  - `TestFromIssueWrapperNoExitCodeFinalize.test_pause_exit_zero_does_not_resolve` (method) — Asserts a run_flow return of 0 (pause/completion) leaves the issue IN_PROGRESS and confirms source_issue_id is threaded through to run_flow. <!--#caa9669649596745-->
  - `TestFromIssueWrapperNoExitCodeFinalize.test_nonzero_exit_with_persisted_flow_does_not_reopen_via_wrapper` (method) — Asserts a non-zero run_flow that persisted an engine.json carrying the source issue is left as run_flow left it (IN_PROGRESS), with the wrapper's revert suppressed. <!--#b0a4d48362340d12-->
- `TestFromIssueEarlyDispatchFailureReverts` (class) — CLI-level test class verifying the wrapper self-reverts OPEN→IN_PROGRESS when dispatch fails before any flow state persists the issue, but not when a flow carries it. <!--#5aa48332def163c5-->
  - `TestFromIssueEarlyDispatchFailureReverts.test_sync_pre_flow_failure_reverts_issue_to_open` (method) — Asserts a non-zero run_flow that persisted no engine.json reverts the source issue back to OPEN. <!--#707cf81a6264729d-->
  - `TestFromIssueEarlyDispatchFailureReverts.test_sync_pre_flow_failure_reverts_despite_stale_prior_engine_json` (method) — Regression test asserting a stale prior-run engine.json carrying the same issue is not mistaken for this dispatch's flow, so a pre-flow failure still reverts to OPEN. <!--#eb381ca7eb0638dd-->
  - `TestFromIssueEarlyDispatchFailureReverts.test_worktree_fork_failure_reverts_issue_to_open` (method) — Asserts a worktree dispatch that fails before any worktree/engine.json exists reverts the issue to OPEN. <!--#07f773d63b6b72d0-->
  - `TestFromIssueEarlyDispatchFailureReverts.test_worktree_completed_merge_failure_is_not_reverted` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED worktree flow whose trailing merge failed keeps the issue IN_PROGRESS (owned by retry-merge) rather than reverting. <!--#e3d04122c852b1bc-->
- `_init_git_repo` (function) — Test helper that initializes a git repo with one commit so the real run_merge can inspect HEAD/branch and take the merge lock. <!--#2597e1701494528c-->
- `_create_ancestor_branch` (function) — Test helper that creates a branch at HEAD so it is an ancestor of the default branch, modeling the post-in-flow-merge landed state that finalize verifies before resolving the source issue. <!--#10e724931d88b980-->
- `_write_wt_engine` (function) — Test helper that writes a worktree engine.json carrying source_issue_id and worktree metadata as a real --worktree from-issue flow would, for process-decoupled finalization. <!--#a2790440f3950470-->
- `_patch_real_merge` (function) — Test helper that lets the real run_merge execute while stubbing only its MergeOrchestrator, branch-existence probe, and render_text output capture. <!--#83be1bf1749c7a0f-->
- `_success_report` (function) — Test helper building a successful MergeReport for the given branch. <!--#f8118a8891a141c9-->
- `_failure_report` (function) — Test helper building a failed MergeReport for the given branch. <!--#d7be6875d50591ed-->
- `TestWorktreeFromIssuePauseResumeMergeResolvedE2E` (class) — End-to-end test class for the worktree from-issue pause→fresh-resume→COMPLETED chain, asserting the real finalize/backfill path resolves the source issue only when the branch genuinely landed (is an ancestor of master), tolerates branch-cleanup failures, and refuses to resolve or report a merge when COMPLETED was reached without landing. <!--#74f3fbcf22f21921-->
  - `TestWorktreeFromIssuePauseResumeMergeResolvedE2E.test_pause_then_fresh_resume_completed_resolves_issue` (method) — Verifies the headline flow: a paused from-issue worktree run is not prematurely resolved, and resuming it in a fresh process to COMPLETED (with the branch landed as an ancestor) has the real cleanup backfill resolve the source issue and return success. <!--#0c4779533dde5c7f-->
  - `TestWorktreeFromIssuePauseResumeMergeResolvedE2E.test_resume_completed_resolves_even_when_branch_cleanup_skips` (method) — Verifies the source-issue resolve is independent of best-effort branch deletion: even when CleanupManager raises, the genuinely-landed branch still resolves the issue and the resume returns success. <!--#038e8372d8b6962c-->
  - `TestWorktreeFromIssuePauseResumeMergeResolvedE2E.test_resume_completed_but_branch_not_landed_does_not_resolve` (method) — Regression test that a resume reaching COMPLETED without the branch being an ancestor of master (never merged) must NOT resolve the source issue nor report a merge, leaving the issue IN_PROGRESS and signalling failure so stranded work is visible. <!--#723efe617e3dbbb1-->
  - `TestWorktreeFromIssuePauseResumeMergeResolvedE2E.test_resume_to_failed_reopens_issue` (method) — Asserts a resumed worktree flow ending FAILED reopens the source issue to OPEN and never attempts a merge. <!--#69ac864941047506-->
- `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E` (class) — End-to-end test class verifying a synchronous from-issue run paused then resumed by a fresh process still finalizes the source issue via run_flow's terminal branches off persisted state. <!--#5af25edbcb7352c2-->
  - `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E._persisted_running_flow` (method) — Helper building a resumable synchronous RUNNING flow with a running IMPLEMENT step, round-tripped through serialization to recover source_issue_id. <!--#a6962e9c1285e0d4-->
  - `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E._persisted_exhausted_flow` (method) — Helper building a resumable synchronous flow whose PENDING step has already hit max retries so the next failure drives run_flow's mid-loop auto-fail branch. <!--#9a42df025303c08c-->
  - `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E.test_resume_completed_resolves_source_issue` (method) — Asserts a fresh-process resume driving the sync flow to COMPLETED resolves the source issue with no wrapper involvement. <!--#15e3d6ce106d1696-->
  - `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E.test_resume_mid_loop_max_retries_reopens_issue` (method) — Asserts a resumed sync flow whose step exhausts retries (mid-loop early return 1) reopens the source issue to OPEN. <!--#75a39b879ea91345-->
  - `TestSyncFromIssueResumeFinalizeE2E.test_resume_mid_loop_abort_reopens_issue` (method) — Asserts a resumed sync flow whose step failure routes to an 'abort' decision (mid-loop early return 1) reopens the source issue to OPEN. <!--#df115019aac25be1-->

### `tests/commands/test_merge_backfill_issue.py` (python) — Test suite for `se3 merge`'s source-issue backfill, verifying that branch→source-issue resolution (via live or archived worktree engine.json), the pre-delete branch→issue mapping, and the idempotent IN_PROGRESS→RESOLVED backfill together resolve a merged branch's source issue end-to-end while correctly skipping paused, failed, open, unmerged, and missing cases. <!--#6231cce3b155c3ea|6440c61811235cd3-->

- `_write_worktree_engine_json` (function) — Test helper that writes a worktree engine.json (live or under .archive/) with configurable name, branch, source_issue_id, status, and worktree flags, returning its path. <!--#5eb9d4fbc550af53-->
- `_make_in_progress_issue` (function) — Test helper that creates an issue and transitions it OPEN → IN_PROGRESS, returning its id. <!--#3d30b404ee84fafb-->
- `_make_report` (function) — Test helper that builds a successful MergeReport with sane default branch lists, overridable via kwargs. <!--#16d9637fe1fa37f6-->
- `_merge_complete_body` (function) — Test helper that finds and returns the 'Merge Complete' render_text body from captured output, tolerating a preceding stash-audit line. <!--#e2747cf6e29e2913-->
- `_patch_merge` (function) — Test helper that monkeypatches merge_cmd's render_text (to capture output), the MergeOrchestrator (to return a canned report), _branch_exists (always true), and the intent-scope scan (to a no-op) so run_merge can be exercised without touching real git refs. <!--#5f9cda29ecbfe8de-->
- `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch` (class) — Test class verifying run.find_worktree_source_issue_by_branch resolves a merged branch back to its source issue from live/archived engine.json while excluding paused, failed, non-worktree, source-less, corrupt, and missing cases. <!--#d87c67a154744bc9-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_live_worktree_match` (method) — Asserts a live worktree's branch resolves to its recorded source issue id. <!--#328038d4974c6154-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_archived_worktree_match` (method) — Asserts a GC'd/archived worktree's engine.json under .archive/ still resolves its branch to the source issue. <!--#d5e8dcafe5979c06-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_completed_flow_not_excluded` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED flow is excluded from resumable runs but is still mapped by the branch→issue scanner. <!--#27bddd0d6759341e-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_paused_flow_not_mapped` (method) — Asserts a PAUSED flow's branch is NOT mapped, so hand-merging partial work never resolves its still-in-progress issue. <!--#2d71825b83a87d99-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_failed_flow_not_mapped` (method) — Asserts a FAILED flow's branch is NOT mapped back to its source issue. <!--#690ceacffe00e276-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_no_match_returns_none` (method) — Asserts an unknown branch with no matching worktree returns None. <!--#8e8be71e70469ecc-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_no_source_issue_returns_none` (method) — Asserts a worktree whose engine.json has a null source_issue_id returns None. <!--#26bc4176bec390df-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_non_worktree_flow_ignored` (method) — Asserts a non-worktree-mode flow's branch is ignored and returns None. <!--#b9b4896765f16db1-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_corrupt_engine_json_skipped` (method) — Asserts a corrupt engine.json is skipped without raising while a valid sibling still resolves. <!--#de3dd0d3aa061b22-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_no_worktrees_dir_returns_none` (method) — Asserts a missing se3/worktrees directory returns None rather than erroring. <!--#53be37be7fac69de-->
  - `TestFindWorktreeSourceIssueByBranch.test_empty_branch_returns_none` (method) — Asserts an empty branch name returns None. <!--#bf91a2d8cedeac40-->
- `TestMapBranchesToSourceIssues` (class) — Test class verifying _map_branches_to_source_issues builds a branch→issue map only for branches with a source issue and captures it before worktree state is deleted so backfill still works. <!--#b4d5caefd0ff3405-->
  - `TestMapBranchesToSourceIssues.test_maps_only_branches_with_source_issue` (method) — Asserts the map includes only branches that have a source issue, excluding source-less and unknown branches. <!--#8133f47c61d124c8-->
  - `TestMapBranchesToSourceIssues.test_captures_before_worktree_deleted` (method) — Asserts a map captured before the worktree is removed still drives backfill to RESOLVED even after the live scanner can no longer find the branch. <!--#96e8fe3df8c76d6a-->
- `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues` (class) — Test class verifying _backfill_resolved_source_issues resolves IN_PROGRESS source issues for merged branches while being idempotent and skipping open, unmerged, empty-map, and missing-issue cases. <!--#5a06fb98d29b4207-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_in_progress_issue_resolved` (method) — Asserts an IN_PROGRESS source issue of a merged branch is transitioned to RESOLVED and returned. <!--#7f2e5f705f1848c8-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_already_resolved_issue_untouched_idempotent` (method) — Asserts re-running backfill on an already-RESOLVED issue is a no-op returning empty, not an error. <!--#2e3f45c9cacbf663-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_open_issue_not_touched` (method) — Asserts an OPEN (never-in-progress) issue is left untouched by the backfill. <!--#37be316f78bab85a-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_only_merged_branches_considered` (method) — Asserts a mapped branch not actually merged this run is skipped, leaving its issue IN_PROGRESS. <!--#82b84d75cc81fc0f-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_already_ancestor_branch_resolved` (method) — Asserts an already-ancestor branch whose issue is still IN_PROGRESS is resolved on retry. <!--#a3770a28734125ac-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_empty_map_returns_empty` (method) — Asserts an empty branch→issue map yields no resolutions. <!--#c7ed768cbccdf8a8-->
  - `TestBackfillResolvedSourceIssues.test_missing_issue_swallowed` (method) — Asserts a stale/missing issue id in the map is swallowed without raising and returns empty. <!--#af8236aac1b7e350-->
- `TestRunMergeBackfill` (class) — Test class exercising run_merge end-to-end to confirm it backfills source issues to RESOLVED on success (including retries and stash-pop-incomplete) while not resolving paused branches or emitting a line when no source issue exists. <!--#b80faaeed07b3819-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_success_resolves_source_issue` (method) — Asserts a successful merge of a completed worktree branch resolves its source issue and renders a 'Resolved source issue' line. <!--#6fd09edec4efff6d-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_merge_of_paused_branch_does_not_resolve` (method) — Asserts hand-merging a PAUSED flow's branch succeeds but leaves the issue IN_PROGRESS with no resolve line. <!--#112eddad5cd5a28d-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_retry_merge_of_leftover_branch_resolves` (method) — Asserts re-merging a leftover branch whose worktree was archived still catches up and resolves the source issue. <!--#64da2698ad245b3b-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_stash_pop_incomplete_still_backfills` (method) — Asserts that when the merge lands but stash-pop recovery fails (exit 1), the source issue is still backfilled to RESOLVED and reported in the recovery output. <!--#36c98a409edfab73-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_success_without_source_issue_no_backfill_line` (method) — Asserts a successful merge with no worktree mapping emits no 'Resolved source issue' line. <!--#57bf3c529b5c8723-->
  - `TestRunMergeBackfill.test_retry_already_ancestor_branch_resolves` (method) — Asserts retrying a branch that now classifies as already-ancestor still resolves its still-IN_PROGRESS source issue via the guaranteed retry path. <!--#7cb2aaa41b293b98-->

### `tests/commands/test_run.py` (python) — Unit tests for the `run` command's flow orchestration, covering resume detection for interrupted RUNNING and FAILED flows, the interactive resume menu, Ctrl-C step interjection handling, and `--output-format` CLI-vs-JSON/NDJSON event emission. <!--#654bd6e1141367b4|5358f62ddfd91fb1-->
- `TestResumeDetection` (class) — Test class verifying run_flow's resume detection for an interrupted (RUNNING) IMPLEMENT step, covering transition to PENDING, resumed-flag injection, output preservation, rejection of COMPLETED flows/snapshots, and logging. <!--#c18755b6e26b4a1c-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.setup_method` (method) — Builds a temp project with a RUNNING flow whose IMPLEMENT step was interrupted mid-execution and persists it for resume tests. <!--#38e9e031921e252d-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#f17fb20a9042d3fa-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_detects_running_step_and_transitions_to_pending` (method) — Asserts that resuming a flow whose current step is RUNNING flips that step's status to PENDING. <!--#5812d5da20636924-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_rejects_completed_active_flow` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED flow in engine.json is refused for resume (returns 1, state machine never runs a step). <!--#fa0b5aafc502cc1d-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_rejects_completed_snapshot_flow` (method) — Asserts a stale COMPLETED per-flow resumable snapshot is not resurrected — never saved back as live nor dispatched. <!--#8b4e8e2a1bee3ac2-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_injects_resumed_flag_into_step_inputs` (method) — Asserts resume sets step.inputs['resumed'] = True on the interrupted step. <!--#5e18f1bee36bb2e4-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_normal_run_does_not_trigger_resume_logic` (method) — Asserts a fresh run without a flow_id creates a new flow rather than entering resume logic. <!--#5ae36a2dcb4bcdfb-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_preserves_existing_step_outputs` (method) — Asserts resume keeps a step's existing partial outputs intact while adding the resumed flag only to inputs. <!--#19388a1e1181a9f4-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_with_non_running_step_does_not_modify_status` (method) — Asserts resuming a non-RUNNING (PENDING) step leaves its status unchanged and injects no resumed flag. <!--#1489efd334e4e216-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_logs_interrupted_step_info` (method) — Asserts resume emits an INFO log naming the interrupted step being resumed. <!--#3b998ae25f8b5055-->
- `TestResumeFailedFlow` (class) — Test class verifying run_flow's resume behavior for a FAILED flow/step: transition to PENDING, flow status reset to RUNNING, retry_count reset, input retry_count increment, and retry logging. <!--#cd2782efa1f19f00-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.setup_method` (method) — Builds a temp project with a FAILED flow whose IMPLEMENT step exhausted its retries and persists it. <!--#1c5d6ce8cfafc752-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#f17fb20a9042d3fa-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_step_transitions_to_pending` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step transitions its status to PENDING. <!--#5f46b1b00006880d-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_resets_flow_status_to_running` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED flow saves it with flow status reset to RUNNING (before further state-machine progression). <!--#be5f24d51a0d60b2-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_resets_retry_count` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step resets the step model's retry_count to 0. <!--#807cf234c69c2145-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_increments_input_retry_count` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step increments inputs['retry_count'] (for conversation history) and sets the resumed flag. <!--#42a3bba6837dbc28-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_logs_retry_info` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step logs a 'Retrying failed step from breakpoint' message naming the step. <!--#914334fefa2d545d-->

  - `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows.test_failed_flow_appears_in_resume_menu` (method) — Asserts a FAILED flow is offered in the interactive resume menu and its id returned on selection. <!--#48b4b08de4acc444-->
  - `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows.test_completed_flow_excluded_from_resume_menu` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED flow is omitted from the resume menu (returns None). <!--#eab01f70ea8dd53f-->

  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_repeated_interjections_compose_against_original_base` (method) — Asserts a second interjection composes against the original base, yielding both bullets under one section header (no nesting). <!--#21baf063966c2a4b-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_empty_input_does_not_persist_or_modify` (method) — Asserts an empty interjection leaves context and task_description untouched while still resetting the step to PENDING for retry. <!--#f1962e262328a342-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_interrupt_on_later_step_does_not_double_section` (method) — Regression test asserting an interrupt on a later step whose task_description already carries a composed section does not double the `## Additional Instructions` header. <!--#297f231b4a01a0d2-->

- `TestOutputFormatEventStream` (class) — Test class verifying --output-format wiring: CLI mode routes step output through render_step_output (byte-identical) while JSON mode emits NDJSON lifecycle events to stdout via a pluggable sink. <!--#46419555aff99a48-->

  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_json_mode_emits_valid_ndjson` (method) — Asserts JSON mode writes the full flow lifecycle (flow_started/step_started/step_completed/flow_completed) as parseable NDJSON. <!--#0d712aaf27148a5a-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_cli_mode_routes_step_output_through_renderer` (method) — Asserts default CLI mode routes step output through `step_renderers.render_step_output` exactly once. <!--#5fa5dcd54fa70f9a-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_json_mode_does_not_call_cli_renderer` (method) — Asserts JSON mode bypasses the Rich step renderer entirely. <!--#0f623c237a23a6a7-->
- `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination` (class) — A test class that locks in the CLI contract for `se3 run --discover --from-issue <id>`, verifying that `--discover` forces the discovery task type while preserving issue description, source linkage, status lifecycle, and help text. <!--#8619858c7225c749-->

  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_discover_from_issue_passes_discovery_task_type` (method) — Asserts `--discover --from-issue` forces task_type=discovery while preserving the issue description, source linkage, and non-worktree mode. <!--#ef9ffbb903adfc79-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_from_issue_without_discover_keeps_default_type` (method) — Asserts `--from-issue` alone keeps the default 'feature' type while preserving the issue source linkage. <!--#8180f65edca1ae04-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_discover_from_issue_runs_issue_lifecycle` (method) — A test asserting that the run wrapper advances the issue only from OPEN to in-progress and no longer resolves it on exit code 0, since finalization now happens inside run_flow's terminal branches. <!--#1958b7d444c15b5b-->

### `tests/commands/test_run_failure_action.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying the retry_decision mutual-exclusion between the CLI TTY prompt and the webui, covering how `_resolve_step_failure_action` adopts an existing webui response or falls back to race/pause/prompt across interactive and non-interactive paths, and how the `_cleanup_retry_decision_artifacts` helper idempotently removes only the deterministic call file and its sibling response variants. <!--#e432d735aa1ddf02|da5a765665f0b15b-->
- `_stub_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal SimpleNamespace flow stub carrying just a `flow_id`. <!--#7fad2141f541dc2b-->
- `_stub_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal SimpleNamespace step stub with `step_id`, a `step_type.value`, and `retry_count`. <!--#de45daacf3680ab8-->
- `test_interactive_with_existing_response_returns_decision_and_cleans_up` (function) — Asserts that on an interactive terminal with a webui-written response present, the resolver adopts the decision and deletes the call file and both sibling response variants. <!--#494525dc9923c8fd-->
- `test_interactive_without_response_returns_race_and_writes_call` (function) — Asserts that interactive with no webui answer returns a 'race' action and writes a retry_decision call file (the webui chip) without consuming any response. <!--#316bbd149addec38-->
- `test_non_interactive_with_existing_response_unchanged` (function) — Asserts the unchanged non-interactive path: first pass writes the call and pauses, then after the webui answers a second pass adopts the decision and cleans up. <!--#bf09076e792d8b4b-->
- `test_non_interactive_without_response_pauses` (function) — Asserts non-interactive with no answer writes a retry_decision-kind call file and returns a 'pause' action. <!--#845e7e1500361f06-->
- `test_interactive_unrecognized_decision_defaults_to_abort` (function) — Asserts a garbled webui decision payload is treated as 'abort' but still consumed and its call file removed. <!--#6fec1394558cfb5c-->
- `test_cleanup_helper_removes_all_three_artifacts` (function) — Asserts `_cleanup_retry_decision_artifacts` removes the call file plus both `.response` and `.response.json` sibling variants after the CLI prompt answers. <!--#85b44953a6b1d2c6-->
- `test_cleanup_helper_is_noop_when_nothing_exists` (function) — Asserts the cleanup helper is a quiet, idempotent no-op when no calls directory or artifacts exist. <!--#d539e3ef1539d3f0-->
- `test_cleanup_targets_only_deterministic_retry_decision_file` (function) — Asserts cleanup deletes only the deterministic retry_decision call file, leaving other call kinds (e.g. a plain confirm call) in the same calls directory intact. <!--#540d93edaa542c0d-->

  - `TestFinalizeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_failed_moves_issue_to_open` (method) — Asserts a FAILED worktree status moves the in-progress source issue back to OPEN. <!--#d94f49ee394b58a5-->
  - `TestFinalizeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_completed_merge_failed_keeps_in_progress` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED status with a failed merge (merge_rc=1) leaves the issue IN_PROGRESS for a later retry-merge. <!--#ddf9d4fa1f059005-->
  - `TestFinalizeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_completed_merge_success_leaves_resolve_to_run_merge` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED status even with a successful merge (merge_rc=0) does not resolve the issue, deferring resolution to run_merge. <!--#d5c8eb86b5618efa-->

  - `TestFinalizeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_non_in_progress_issue_not_clobbered` (method) — Asserts an issue that is not IN_PROGRESS (e.g. still OPEN) is never touched, guarding against a second terminal pass clobbering it. <!--#52697ed5ad655965-->
- `TestRunWorktreeModeSourceIssue` (class) — Integration test class checking that `run_worktree_mode` wires source-issue finalization into its terminal branches — completed flows hand off resolve to cleanup, failed flows reopen the issue, and paused flows leave it untouched. <!--#403b53b315cfd959-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeModeSourceIssue._run` (method) — Helper that runs `run_worktree_mode` with a fake run_flow persisting a worktree engine.json (given status and source issue) and stubbed fork/cleanup, returning the exit code and the cleanup mock. <!--#18ab47d8d738be36-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeModeSourceIssue.test_completed_flow_runs_cleanup_which_owns_resolve` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED worktree flow (already merged in-flow) triggers `_finalize_worktree_cleanup`, which owns resolving the source issue. <!--#022629a1a855de9a-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeModeSourceIssue.test_failed_flow_reopens_issue_and_skips_cleanup` (method) — Asserts a FAILED worktree flow skips cleanup, returns the failure code, and reopens the source issue to OPEN. <!--#83f148b4189fbc7f-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeModeSourceIssue.test_paused_flow_does_not_touch_issue_or_cleanup` (method) — Asserts a json-mode PAUSED flow (exit 0 but on-disk paused) neither resolves/reopens the issue nor runs cleanup, leaving the issue IN_PROGRESS. <!--#a88d1bb1fc570a63-->
- `TestFinalizeWorktreeCleanup` (class) — Unit test class for `_finalize_worktree_cleanup`, verifying post-merge housekeeping (branch deletion) and resolution of the now-merged source issue with git/lock dependencies stubbed. <!--#3d911d6efb094199-->
  - `TestFinalizeWorktreeCleanup.test_resolves_source_issue_after_inflight_merge` (method) — Asserts that, given a landed branch, `_finalize_worktree_cleanup` deletes the merged worktree branch and marks the source issue RESOLVED. <!--#939342d2b6110a64-->
- `TestResumeWorktreeSourceIssue` (class) — Integration test class confirming a fresh `--resume` process finalizes the source issue purely from the persisted worktree status — completed runs cleanup, failed reopen, paused untouched — decoupled from the original wrapper. <!--#5093cb0b1c244d4a-->
  - `TestResumeWorktreeSourceIssue._resume` (method) — Helper that seeds a resumable worktree engine.json, invokes `resume_run` with a fake run_flow persisting the target status/source issue and stubbed cleanup, returning the exit code and cleanup mock. <!--#f2ba0bb57a8e7356-->
  - `TestResumeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_resume_completed_runs_cleanup` (method) — Asserts a resumed worktree flow that completes hands off to `_finalize_worktree_cleanup` (which owns the resolve). <!--#0ac946ef8d6aaffa-->
  - `TestResumeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_resume_failed_reopens_issue` (method) — Asserts a resumed worktree flow that fails skips cleanup, returns the failure code, and reopens the source issue to OPEN. <!--#048959cd9cb6ff08-->
  - `TestResumeWorktreeSourceIssue.test_resume_paused_again_does_not_touch_issue` (method) — Asserts a resumed worktree flow that pauses again leaves the source issue IN_PROGRESS with no cleanup fired. <!--#cf33fed4bc8b6d24-->

### `tests/commands/test_worktree_cmd.py` (python) — CLI tests for the `se3 worktree gc` command that patch the engine GC core (gc_worktree_runs) with crafted WorktreeGCReport objects to assert on flag plumbing (dry-run, --max-age-hours→seconds), the three-section report rendering (archived/reclaimed, unmerged-retention warning, skipped/errors), and non-zero exit-code mapping on errors. <!--#b069ec7953b0f478|fcb22b782aaf2c09-->

- `test_dry_run_passes_flag_and_default_age` (function) — Verifies that --dry-run threads dry_run=True and the default 24h max-age to the core and that the rendered output shows the DRY RUN notice and reclaimed space. <!--#9655d15ade502f5d-->
- `test_max_age_hours_converted_to_seconds` (function) — Verifies that --max-age-hours N is converted to N*3600 seconds passed to the core with dry_run defaulting to False. <!--#2cc5e33f3180fd1f-->
- `test_report_three_sections_and_unmerged_warning` (function) — Checks that the rendered report shows all three sections — archived, retained-unmerged (with a prominent WARNING), and skipped. <!--#1e08f05e6adffca3-->
- `test_errors_map_to_nonzero_exit` (function) — Confirms that a report containing errors causes the command to exit non-zero and display an Errors section. <!--#4dbe2f0f22563aec-->
- `test_empty_report_reports_nothing_and_exits_zero` (function) — Confirms that an empty sweep exits 0 and prints a 'No worktree runs matched' message. <!--#23c854416e79b4bf-->

## `tests/commands/merge/` — Test package for the `se3 merge` command, containing unit, regression, and end-to-end suites that harden every merge subsystem — CLI input validation and reconcile flow, dirty-working-tree preflight, conflict resolution, guardrail amend/reset repair, failure-reason enums, typed result models, post-condition assertions, version aggregation and concurrent version-collision prevention, merge locking, runtime sync, LLM call tracing, and secret redaction. <!--#da86e880d997aece|12c7e48812e6ec54-->

### `tests/commands/merge/__init__.py` (python) — Empty package-initializer marking tests/commands/merge as a Python package so its merge-command test modules can be discovered and imported. <!--#e3b0c44298fc1c14|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_amend_reset_regression.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the merge guardrail-repair amend/reset root-cause fix (accidents A1–A13), asserting the fix-up commit is preferred over amend, rollback uses pre_amend_sha (never HEAD~1) with a HEAD^2 merge-commit assertion, post-repair ancestry post-conditions fail-closed on silent merge loss, plus stall detection, configurable max iterations, shared LLMCaller injection, and None-vs-empty response handling. <!--#a969ffe30ee8ffb1|2ae231d6650524cb-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Test helper that initializes a git repo with an initial commit and returns its SHA. <!--#391e1f1299f3c599-->
- `_create_branch` (function) — Test helper that creates a branch with given file content, commits it, returns its tip SHA, and switches back to master. <!--#16f64b077d444483-->
- `_make_violations` (function) — Test helper returning a sample list with one WEAKENING GuardrailViolation (SHALL→SHOULD) for a base spec file. <!--#4356bd681d0edde8-->
- `_make_original_specs` (function) — Test helper returning the original (pre-merge) spec contents mapping with the stricter SHALL wording. <!--#c8e35260df28a828-->
- `_make_merged_specs` (function) — Test helper returning the merged spec contents mapping with the weakened SHOULD wording. <!--#69602c6197c24744-->
- `_setup_spec_files` (function) — Test helper that writes a weakened (SHOULD) spec.md into the se3/specs/base directory under tmp_path. <!--#cffa6b8260eb27c7-->
- `TestPreAmendShaRollback` (class) — Test class verifying the amend repair path saves pre_amend_sha for rollback rather than resetting to HEAD~1. <!--#656adc7cacfb0547-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_amend_path_saves_pre_amend_sha` (method) — Test that when fix-up fails and amend is used but guardrails still fail, HEAD is rolled back to pre_amend_sha (not HEAD~1). <!--#13f58a56b8c8efac-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_fixup_commit_preferred_over_amend` (method) — Test that the fix-up commit path is tried first and, on success, leaves a new commit with the original merge commit still an ancestor. <!--#c5af1adc1cffb075-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_no_HEAD_tilde1_in_rollback` (method) — Test that scans the repair module source to ensure at most one executable use of 'reset --soft HEAD~1' (the safe fix-up path only). <!--#eb9208b6207d4b37-->
- `TestHeadIsMergeCommitAssertion` (class) — Test class verifying the amend path is rejected via a HEAD^2 check when HEAD is not a merge commit. <!--#b5014db94ec866aa-->
  - `TestHeadIsMergeCommitAssertion.test_amend_rejected_when_head_not_merge_commit` (method) — Test that repair fails with a 'HEAD is not a merge commit' error when amend is attempted on a regular (single-parent) commit. <!--#87079e7af112ad2a-->
- `TestRestoreMergedContent` (class) — Test class verifying _restore_merged_content re-raises write exceptions instead of swallowing them (A6). <!--#418c4d5005aaaca7-->
  - `TestRestoreMergedContent.test_restore_re_raises_on_write_failure` (method) — Test that _restore_merged_content propagates an OSError raised by a patched Path.write_text. <!--#58438c4e036b42ed-->
- `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons` (class) — Test class verifying LLM raw_response and parsed results distinguish None from empty values with distinct errors (A7). <!--#f95c6076b1e50907-->
  - `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons.test_raw_response_none_is_distinct_from_empty_string` (method) — Test that an LLM returning None produces a distinct 'returned None' error. <!--#a3c45cdfc00ff63e-->
  - `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons.test_parsed_empty_dict_is_distinct_from_none` (method) — Test that an LLM returning an empty dict is caught early with a distinct 'empty response' error. <!--#2fa9038dc3c3f35c-->
- `TestAllowedPathsRefresh` (class) — Test class verifying allowed_paths is refreshed after a restore so out-of-spec writes are rejected (A8). <!--#194065c588b957e7-->
  - `TestAllowedPathsRefresh.test_allowed_paths_refreshed_after_restore` (method) — Test that a repair touching a file outside the spec dir fails with 'outside spec dir' and restores the valid file's merged content. <!--#a663ae903528f39f-->
- `TestPostConditionAfterRepair` (class) — Test class verifying repair success is tied to an ancestry post-condition check on the merge commit (A11). <!--#ae938e16cbb5a13c-->
  - `TestPostConditionAfterRepair.test_merge_lost_postcondition_fails` (method) — Test that repair succeeds when the merge commit is a real ancestor, then demonstrates the ancestry check would fail after resetting HEAD away from it. <!--#ef6e625c3fff0197-->
- `TestSharedLLMCaller` (class) — Test class verifying GuardrailRepairer accepts an injected shared LLMCaller and falls back when none is provided (A13). <!--#bc85dd54ca60de59-->
  - `TestSharedLLMCaller.test_llm_caller_injected` (method) — Test that a GuardrailRepairer constructed with an LLMCaller stores it on _llm_caller. <!--#b14e88a6ba4a645e-->
  - `TestSharedLLMCaller.test_llm_caller_none_uses_fallback` (method) — Test that passing llm_caller=None leaves _llm_caller as None for per-call fallback creation. <!--#6eb49994842c41a6-->
- `TestConfigurableMaxIterations` (class) — Test class verifying max repair iterations is read from se3.yaml with a default-of-2 fallback (Task 10 / A10). <!--#33db70be2374b14e-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_default_max_iterations` (method) — Test that _load_max_repair_iterations returns 2 when se3.yaml is absent. <!--#7df6c765c6fdf195-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_configurable_max_iterations` (method) — Test that _load_max_repair_iterations reads a configured value of 5 from se3.yaml. <!--#9eb6d209e0ba63bf-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_invalid_max_iterations_fallback` (method) — Test that a non-numeric max_iterations in se3.yaml falls back to the default of 2. <!--#f061a5e6b28566a7-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_zero_max_iterations_fallback` (method) — Test that a max_iterations of 0 in se3.yaml falls back to the default of 2. <!--#6632b47d1769a199-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_orchestrator_honors_configured_max_iterations` (method) — Test that MergeOrchestrator stores the configured max_iterations (5) on its _max_repair_iterations attribute. <!--#44d3f9b892c3449d-->
- `TestStallDetection` (class) — Test class verifying last_hash stall detection avoids spurious matches on iteration 1 (A9). <!--#f87a83547844c02b-->
  - `TestStallDetection.test_stall_detected_at_iteration_1_with_none` (method) — Test that a None last_hash never registers a stall on the first iteration but matches on the second identical hash. <!--#dcb897f5b4415c9a-->
- `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent` (class) — Test class verifying that stray non-merge commits trip silent_merge_loss when allow_fixup_parent does not apply (no repair, or amend used). <!--#d6e9b6f820d9cd63-->
  - `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent.test_llm_resolved_stray_commit_trips_silent_merge_loss` (method) — Test that an LLM-resolved fast merge with no repair plus an injected stray commit fails the post-condition with silent_merge_loss. <!--#e1d7d288bbe852b4-->
  - `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent.test_amend_then_stray_commit_trips_silent_merge_loss` (method) — Test that when repair used amend (allow_fixup_parent=False), an injected stray commit fires silent_merge_loss since HEAD^1 is not checked. <!--#eb1caf663733c483-->
- `TestTimeoutFailClosed` (class) — Test class verifying a post-condition check timeout is treated as a fail-closed failure rather than a soft warning. <!--#e721ea57a3953dc6-->
  - `TestTimeoutFailClosed.test_postcond_check_timeout_returns_failure` (method) — Test that a TimeoutExpired from assert_branch_merged makes the orchestrator fail with postcond_check_timeout. <!--#18d6ec6efcb9cf8a-->
- `TestEmptyPostShaFallback` (class) — Test class verifying the repairer refuses success when post_sha is empty/unverifiable and the merge has actually been lost. <!--#3763497348e52fa1-->
  - `TestEmptyPostShaFallback.test_empty_post_sha_with_lost_merge_refuses_success` (method) — Test that empty post_sha plus a non-merge HEAD triggers the fallback check and refuses to declare repair success. <!--#ff43200a50d70e4b-->
  - `TestEmptyPostShaFallback.test_empty_post_sha_with_real_merge_succeeds` (method) — Test that empty post_sha still succeeds when HEAD is genuinely a merge commit and the branch is an ancestor, guarding against an over-zealous fallback. <!--#cb316f8073524fea-->
- `TestRollbackRefusesMissingPreRepairSha` (class) — Test class verifying that when pre_repair_sha cannot be captured, repair refuses to commit at all, leaving HEAD unchanged. <!--#783a154d77fac896-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_dirty_preflight.py` (python) — Test module for the merge command's dirty-working-tree pre-flight, verifying via temp git repos that dirty self-managed issue-state files (se3/issues, .next_id, code-index.md) are auto-swept into a 'chore: sync issue state' commit with deterministic NextIdResolver conflict handling, while any dirty path outside the self-managed whitelist (including renames leaving it, exact-path sibling mismatches, and pre-existing merge conflicts) fails loudly as dirty_working_tree with the real git diagnostic preserved, plus edge cases like untracked-only, gitignored whitelist entries, nothing-to-commit syncs, and -z porcelain rename parsing. <!--#2cd64c51475f2189|f2a4db0c28c98d1e-->
- `_git` (function) — Helper that runs a git command in the given repo path with output captured and non-zero exit raising. <!--#cf40306ebf6a3046-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Helper that initializes a temp git repo with test identity, a README, the real se3 .gitignore template (runtime ignored, data dirs whitelisted), and an initial commit. <!--#ef6a629696a2e94f-->
- `_default_branch` (function) — Helper returning the repo's current (default) branch name via rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD. <!--#876df53e47218b67-->
- `_log_subjects` (function) — Helper returning all commit subject lines of the repo's log for assertion on which commits exist. <!--#6e86814f6cdb6277-->
- `_write_next_id` (function) — Helper that writes the given value into se3/issues/.next_id (creating parents) and returns its path. <!--#ac6db68e8d738ec9-->
- `test_dirty_issue_state_auto_committed_and_nextid_resolver_takes_over` (function) — Verifies that dirty self-managed issue state (tracked .next_id plus an untracked issue yaml) is swept into a 'chore: sync issue state' commit before the merge, and that the resulting .next_id conflict is settled deterministically by NextIdResolver to the max value with an LLM-call tripwire proving no LLM resolution occurred. <!--#74437d33841c9acd-->
- `test_dirty_file_outside_self_managed_fails_loud` (function) — Verifies that a dirty tracked file outside the self-managed whitelist blocks the merge with failure_reason dirty_working_tree, names the file in the detail, and produces neither a sync commit nor a merge. <!--#d864d7368c25b0b4-->
- `test_mixed_dirty_lists_both_and_fails` (function) — Verifies that when both whitelisted and non-whitelisted files are dirty, the merge fails listing both paths in failure_detail and no auto-commit is attempted at all. <!--#cd2507f46b7bf610-->
- `test_preexisting_conflict_blocks_merge_not_masked_as_clean` (function) — Regression test ensuring a pre-existing unresolved merge conflict (UU entry with MERGE_HEAD) is seen by the pre-flight and blocks the new merge as dirty_working_tree instead of being skipped as clean, leaving the in-flight merge untouched. <!--#a80fa33478cee25b-->
- `test_clean_working_tree_unchanged_behaviour` (function) — Verifies the baseline behaviour that a clean working tree merges successfully without producing any sync commit. <!--#f018934b10da4c91-->
- `test_untracked_only_does_not_commit` (function) — Verifies that untracked-only issue files do not trigger a sync commit and are left untouched, since only dirty tracked files can provoke git's overwrite refusal. <!--#6cce638bfd3206e5-->
- `test_rename_within_self_managed_with_space_is_committed` (function) — Verifies -z porcelain parsing by auto-committing a staged rename of a space-containing path whose source and destination are both inside the se3/issues/ whitelist. <!--#3a020826f70d08c5-->
- `test_rename_out_of_self_managed_fails` (function) — Verifies that a rename whose destination leaves se3/issues/ (one end outside the whitelist) fails as dirty_working_tree instead of being auto-committed. <!--#c097893c2a49664b-->
- `test_dirty_code_index_is_self_managed_and_auto_committed` (function) — Verifies that a dirty tracked se3/code-index.md is treated as self-managed and folded into the sync commit rather than blocking the merge. <!--#2b9383e1b4365310-->
- `test_self_managed_nothing_to_commit_proceeds` (function) — Verifies that a self-managed file reported dirty but whose staged content equals HEAD ('nothing to commit' on the sync attempt) lets the merge proceed without a spurious sync commit or a dirty_working_tree rejection. <!--#7ee3f035a6d483bf-->
- `test_premerge_failure_not_masked_as_merge_abort_failed` (function) — Regression test ensuring that when git refuses to start a merge (untracked file would be overwritten, no MERGE_HEAD), the harmless 'no merge to abort' outcome does not overwrite the real failure with merge_abort_failed, preserving the genuine git diagnostic in both the compound reason and failure_detail. <!--#bff30de60422de3f-->
- `test_code_index_sibling_is_not_self_managed` (function) — Verifies that a file whitelist entry matches only its exact path, so a dirty tracked sibling like se3/code-index.md.bak fails loudly as dirty_working_tree instead of being prefix-matched as self-managed and left unstaged. <!--#07e2b701cb8564ae-->
- `test_gitignored_code_index_does_not_abort_issue_sync` (function) — Verifies that an existing-but-gitignored whitelist file (pre-migrate code-index.md) is never handed to git as a pathspec, so the sync commit derived from the actual dirty tracked paths (se3/issues) succeeds and the merge proceeds. <!--#6706f2934764a0da-->

  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_dirty_working_tree` (method) — Asserts from_legacy_string("dirty_working_tree") resolves to FailureReason.DIRTY_WORKING_TREE with no detail. <!--#fd7be7355a1a4f11-->

  - `TestLegacyString.test_every_member_has_legacy_map_entry` (method) — Guards against drift by asserting each member's legacy_string is a key in _LEGACY_STRING_MAP that resolves back to the same member. <!--#d634feea1457fe74-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_llm_trace.py` (python) — Unit-test suite for the merge module's LLMTrace per-call JSONL logger and its LLMCallRecord dataclass, covering start/stop lifecycle and context-manager use, record writing (sequence numbering, field serialization, preview truncation, empty fields, auto-start), size-based file rotation with unique filenames, and dataclass-to-dict serialization. <!--#48a7e3930473cf22|f80a066a266f67fb-->
- `tmp_project` (function) — Pytest fixture returning a temporary directory path used as the project root for each LLMTrace test. <!--#148d54b377839e21-->
- `TestLLMTraceLifecycle` (class) — Test class verifying LLMTrace start/stop behavior and its context-manager protocol. <!--#7ee74ab2c11bcd3b-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_start_creates_file` (method) — Asserts that calling start() creates the current trace file on disk. <!--#ade501c12d1ce6d3-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_context_manager` (method) — Asserts that using LLMTrace as a context manager sets started/file on entry and clears started on exit. <!--#a8ecafb1955bdac6-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_stop_closes_file` (method) — Asserts that stop() closes and clears the underlying file handle. <!--#ccae2c1c2811ba8a-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_idempotent_start` (method) — Asserts that a second start() call is a no-op leaving the current path unchanged. <!--#f0af30f54d12f869-->
- `TestLLMTraceRecord` (class) — Test class verifying record() writes correct JSONL output, sequence numbering, previews, and auto-start. <!--#fabad25326ed3477-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_seq_monotonic` (method) — Asserts that successive record() calls return monotonically increasing sequence numbers starting at 1. <!--#c59b5bb482d7718a-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_record_content` (method) — Asserts a recorded entry serializes all fields (agent, previews, duration, outcome, meta, seq, timestamp) correctly to JSONL. <!--#b115470033f7a923-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_preview_truncation` (method) — Asserts that a long prompt is truncated to the configured preview_chars length in the written record. <!--#e0c58e4528b58d34-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_empty_prompt_and_response` (method) — Asserts that omitting prompt/response yields empty-string preview fields. <!--#004463f8fcbee644-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_auto_start_on_record` (method) — Asserts that calling record() without an explicit start() auto-starts the trace. <!--#2fc8e3ca505c85b1-->
- `TestLLMTraceRotation` (class) — Test class verifying log file rotation when the configured size limit is reached. <!--#641ffb6f434260d7-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRotation.test_rotation` (method) — Asserts that exceeding max_file_bytes rotates to a new file while preserving the first file and its record. <!--#a134b69c22057c63-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRotation.test_rotation_filenames_unique_in_same_microsecond` (method) — Regression test freezing the clock to force multiple rotations and verify rotated filenames remain unique. <!--#1e8627d5de225ba4-->
- `TestLLMCallRecord` (class) — Test class verifying LLMCallRecord dataclass serialization. <!--#4dfb415b3d1003d8-->
  - `TestLLMCallRecord.test_to_dict` (method) — Asserts that LLMCallRecord.to_dict() emits the expected key/value fields. <!--#78d9689cb6100eea-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_merge_lock.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the fcntl-based MergeLock exclusive merge lock, covering acquire/release lifecycle, contention/busy errors, stale dead-PID detection and breaking, blocking (queued) acquisition, and cross-process exclusivity via subprocesses. <!--#459a7fbb27fb98eb|723715331b9dbd01-->
- `tmp_project` (function) — Pytest fixture returning a temporary project root with the `se3/state/` directory pre-created for lock-file placement. <!--#beca064ed79eb2ad-->
- `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease` (class) — Test class covering the basic acquire/release lifecycle, context-manager use, PID recording, and idempotent re-acquire. <!--#18faf1f8a6d59f63-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_acquire_creates_lock_file` (method) — Asserts that acquiring the lock creates the resolved lock file on disk. <!--#6ca01a9ff773d7cc-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_release_removes_fd` (method) — Asserts that releasing the lock clears the held file descriptor back to None. <!--#71a776b3137df160-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_context_manager` (method) — Verifies the lock works as a context manager, holding the fd inside the `with` block and releasing on exit. <!--#695257470f18115f-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_lock_file_contains_pid` (method) — Verifies the lock file's contents record the holding process's PID. <!--#7ebf49980dbaa1a1-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_idempotent_start` (method) — Verifies a second acquire on an already-held lock is a no-op rather than an error. <!--#b5bdde0487673e57-->
- `TestMergeLockContention` (class) — Test class covering two lock instances competing for the same lock and the busy-error behavior. <!--#51fb302227f092c8-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_second_acquire_raises_busy` (method) — Asserts a second acquire while one is held raises MergeLockBusy. <!--#be8f6f881202ac48-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_second_acquire_sees_holder_pid` (method) — Asserts the MergeLockBusy exception exposes the current holder's PID. <!--#c2464523a2846cda-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_factory_function` (method) — Verifies the `acquire_merge_lock` factory returns an already-acquired lock. <!--#60272630d1b5c0e4-->
- `TestMergeLockStale` (class) — Test class covering stale-lock (dead-PID) detection and optional break-and-reacquire behavior. <!--#22e491783b69242c-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_stale_lock_raises_stale` (method) — Asserts acquiring over a lock file holding a nonexistent PID raises MergeLockStale carrying that PID. <!--#8395e96978126683-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_break_stale_removes_and_reacquires` (method) — Asserts `acquire(break_stale=True)` clears a stale lock and reacquires it, recording the caller's PID. <!--#01f333dad2a81622-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_unparseable_pid_raises_stale_with_none` (method) — Asserts that when a held lock file has an unparseable PID, MergeLockStale carries holder_pid=None and an 'unparseable' message. <!--#93969f06beece540-->
- `TestMergeLockBlocking` (class) — Test class covering blocking (queueing) acquisition semantics where `acquire(blocking=True)` waits for the holder instead of failing fast. <!--#ce8061cae0cff76e-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_acquire_waits_for_release` (method) — Verifies a blocking acquire waits until a background thread releases the lock, then records the caller's PID. <!--#fa5bf0422f2cd38e-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_context_manager_default` (method) — Verifies constructing `MergeLock(root, blocking=True)` seeds blocking mode for context-manager acquire. <!--#156e03b82948bd73-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_acquire_over_unheld_stale_file` (method) — Verifies a blocking acquire over an unheld stale lock file is granted immediately rather than wedging. <!--#3037ae24a903c952-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_factory_passes_blocking` (method) — Verifies the `acquire_merge_lock` factory forwards the `blocking` flag. <!--#8d86aff6f7facd79-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_serializes_across_processes` (method) — Verifies a blocking acquire queues behind a lock holder running in a separate subprocess. <!--#0ea0d13289c8e33e-->
- `TestMergeLockSubprocess` (class) — Test class verifying the lock is genuinely exclusive across separate OS processes. <!--#17f8ae5f8275ac67-->
  - `TestMergeLockSubprocess.test_subprocess_cannot_acquire_while_parent_holds` (method) — Asserts a subprocess reports BUSY when trying to acquire a lock the parent process already holds. <!--#f089c35213832cc8-->
