### `tests/engine/test_retry_context_safety_cap.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the retry-context safety cap, verifying that spec-text dedup runs before any hard truncation, that the post-dedup `_post_dedup_safety_cap` fallback truncates history-head while preserving the new-prompt tail (including line-boundary, missing-marker/separator, over-limit tail, and retry-of-retry anchoring edge cases), that `_call_with_retry` wires the cap in only on retry paths, and that literal `\n` preprocessing lets dedup collapse JSON-embedded multi-line content. <!--#bb693c199cf2a518|3334ef73f5ac708b-->
- `_make_session` (function) — Test helper that wraps a list of ChatMessages in a ChatSession with fixed flow/step/type identifiers. <!--#c890988af505c899-->
- `_big_spec_block` (function) — Test helper that builds a deterministic ~130K-char multi-line spec text block to exercise dedup and the safety cap. <!--#db69d4f20851724e-->
- `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation` (class) — Test class for scenario (a): repeated spec text is collapsed by dedup and not cut by per-prompt truncation. <!--#c9bdef5aafd018e1-->
  - `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation.test_repeated_spec_not_truncated_by_format_history` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry() preserves the full original spec body and emits no safety-limit truncation warning. <!--#1ff35f0801fd901c-->
  - `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation.test_dedup_eliminates_repetition_below_safety_limit` (method) — Asserts that dedup substantially shrinks a doubly-repeated spec prompt below the safety limit, leaving the cap a no-op and the new-prompt tail intact. <!--#23a6af1e5ac7a8b0-->
- `TestPostDedupSafetyCap` (class) — Test class for scenario (b): the post-dedup _post_dedup_safety_cap fallback truncating non-dedupable history while preserving the new-prompt tail. <!--#682bb2311d928158-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_noop_when_under_limit` (method) — Asserts the cap leaves a small marker/separator prompt unchanged when under the limit. <!--#e6ec454720c716fa-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_noop_when_no_history_marker` (method) — Asserts the cap refuses to truncate an oversized prompt that lacks the retry-history marker. <!--#4a70f2ed500af6db-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_truncates_history_head_preserves_tail` (method) — Asserts the cap truncates the history head to a strict length bound while preserving the separator/new-prompt tail and emitting a warning. <!--#1c218da37ad48999-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_preserves_tail_even_when_tail_exceeds_limit` (method) — Asserts that when the tail alone exceeds the limit, the cap keeps the tail intact, tolerates over-limit size, and logs a distinguishing (not generic) warning. <!--#0b6c1df08ec5aa6b-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_warns_when_separator_missing` (method) — Asserts that with the marker present but separator missing, the cap returns the prompt unchanged and logs the observable failure. <!--#bee6fdf2909ba134-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_kept_body_starts_at_line_boundary` (method) — Asserts the cap rounds its kept-body slice forward to a newline boundary so truncation never starts mid-line. <!--#9c9141937a8699b8-->
- `TestRetryOfRetryAnchoring` (class) — Test class guarding that on a retry-of-retry the cap anchors on the outer separator (rfind), not an inner replayed one. <!--#aa7c368c632db022-->
  - `TestRetryOfRetryAnchoring.test_cap_anchors_outer_separator_on_retry_of_retry` (method) — Asserts that with nested marker/separator blocks the cap anchors on the outer separator so the new-prompt tail survives and invariants hold. <!--#79fcb70181e6eb2f-->
- `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap` (class) — End-to-end test class verifying LLMCaller._call_with_retry actually wires _post_dedup_safety_cap into the retry path. <!--#a68efded05e3a78d-->
  - `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap.test_safety_cap_called_on_retry_path` (method) — Asserts the cap is called once on a retry path with an effective prompt carrying both the marker and separator. <!--#8145214e4495bc1f-->
  - `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap.test_safety_cap_not_called_on_first_call` (method) — Asserts the cap (and dedup) are skipped entirely on a first, non-retry call. <!--#5a788035898f493d-->
- `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing` (class) — Test class covering the backslash-n preprocessing that splits JSON-embedded literal '\n' content into real lines so dedup can collapse it. <!--#0bed9eec699b8c5e-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_lets_dedup_collapse_embedded_blocks` (method) — Asserts dedup misses repeated embedded multi-line tool_result content without the '\n' replace but hits it afterward. <!--#864099dc5971dea6-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_does_not_touch_real_newlines` (method) — Asserts the '\n' replace is idempotent on strings that already contain only real newlines. <!--#93cfc0631f8f5793-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_does_not_touch_other_escapes` (method) — Asserts the replace converts only literal '\n' and leaves other escapes like '\t', '\\', and '\"' intact. <!--#f6a6373e104c2e75-->

### `tests/engine/test_self_check_adjudication.py` (python) — Unit tests wiring the self_check handler to the cross-round adjudication ledger, verifying that every round's validated issues are recorded by fingerprint, that fix-loop resolutions are safely paired to prior issues by position (guarded against cardinality and ordering mismatches), and that detected oscillation suppresses the convergence shortcut to route contradictions into the fix loop. <!--#04fe867c519f369c|aa17d4600ac72083-->
- `_issue` (function) — Test helper that builds a well-formed self_check issue dict (with severity, expected/actual behavior, expectation source quote, and evidence lines) crafted to survive `_validate_and_filter_issues`. <!--#19e5df050b5324eb-->

- `TestRoundRecording` (class) — Test class verifying self-check rounds (including clean rounds) are recorded into the adjudication ledger and that same-step-id replays stay idempotent. <!--#e8d6b2d9cfde43ae-->
  - `TestRoundRecording.test_issues_recorded_into_ledger` (method) — Asserts a validated issue is recorded as a ledger observation with the correct fingerprint and increments round_count. <!--#f41702fcaf902e86-->
  - `TestRoundRecording.test_clean_round_still_records_and_advances` (method) — Asserts an issue-free round still completes and advances round_count while recording no observations. <!--#507210c49ccc81b4-->
  - `TestRoundRecording.test_replay_same_step_id_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts re-running a step carrying the same step_id (resume replay) does not double-count rounds or observations. <!--#bf31c22bfbd58542-->
- `TestResolutionRecording` (class) — Test class verifying how previous-issue resolutions are paired to prior issues (by position, guarded against cardinality mismatch and reordering) and recorded with fingerprints. <!--#d425d626dec72ce8-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_resolutions_by_position` (method) — Asserts equal-count resolutions pair positionally to their corresponding prev issues. <!--#7a2a65b182f279f3-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_cardinality_mismatch_skips_positional_pairing` (method) — Asserts a resolution count differing from prev issue count leaves all resolutions unpaired rather than misaligned. <!--#9818db800ad740ae-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_omitted_first_entry_does_not_mislabel` (method) — Asserts the cardinality guard refuses positional pairing when an entry is omitted, avoiding a wrong-fingerprint 'fixed' verdict. <!--#fdcf0d16fbe1da41-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_preserves_already_identified_issue_on_mismatch` (method) — Asserts a resolution carrying its own machine-identified issue keeps it even when counts mismatch suppresses positional inference. <!--#c286408baca796d0-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_reordered_entries_refuses_wrong_fingerprint` (method) — Asserts the content-match reorder guard leaves reversed-order (but equal-count) resolutions unpaired to avoid stamping verdicts onto the wrong issue. <!--#b28dc8a30b45f6dc-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_pair_in_order_signal_pairs_correctly` (method) — Asserts equal-count, in-order, content-discriminating resolutions pair correctly by position. <!--#eb1f3a9f4be1a75a-->
  - `TestResolutionRecording.test_fixed_resolution_recorded_with_fingerprint` (method) — Asserts a fix round's 'fixed' verdict lands on the ledger paired to the prev issue's fingerprint so trigger (b) can match it. <!--#401dbc8559230c48-->
- `TestConvergenceSuppression` (class) — Test class verifying that ledger-detected oscillation suppresses the convergence shortcut (forcing REVISION_NEEDED) while non-oscillating or convergence-disabled cases behave as before. <!--#c137c5dbe52c25a6-->
  - `TestConvergenceSuppression._seed_prior_round` (method) — Test helper that records a prior self-check round flagging the shared position with a given expected value. <!--#ae316339a892f041-->
  - `TestConvergenceSuppression.test_oscillation_suppresses_convergence` (method) — Asserts an oscillating position blocks convergence and routes the flow into the fix loop (REVISION_NEEDED, fix_needed) instead of converging. <!--#df7f7b2fc27d37ce-->
  - `TestConvergenceSuppression.test_non_oscillation_convergence_unchanged` (method) — Asserts that with no oscillation the convergence shortcut still fires and the pass COMPLETEs as converged. <!--#4bdd79206865cd52-->
  - `TestConvergenceSuppression.test_convergence_disabled_no_suppression_effect` (method) — Asserts that with convergence disabled the oscillation guard is inert and an issue-bearing pass enters the fix loop as usual. <!--#8a2e6e1f5128cc44-->

### `tests/engine/test_self_check_state_machine.py` (python) — Test suite verifying SELF_CHECK integration with the engine StateMachine — that REVISION_NEEDED routes into the shared fix loop (respecting max iterations) while COMPLETED proceeds to VERIFY_SPEC, that fix transitions record/log 'self_check' as their source, that _build_step_inputs supplies SELF_CHECK with test_results/changes_made/fix_iteration and surfaces its outputs downstream, that only feature/bugfix/discovery sequences include SELF_CHECK between TEST and INVARIANT_CHECK, and that the self_check_handler is registered and callable. <!--#9a998ecf845ab5b1|9d2762ed4c1a7b5a-->
- `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext` (class) — Test class checking that StateMachine.transition_to_next correctly routes a SELF_CHECK step's REVISION_NEEDED/COMPLETED outcome into the fix loop or onward to VERIFY_SPEC. <!--#898d5af0489ab88d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture providing a StateMachine instance with PersistenceManager patched out, rooted at a temp path. <!--#63f24a4da29cc019-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext._make_flow_with_self_check` (method) — Helper that builds a FlowInstance with completed IMPLEMENT/TEST steps and a SELF_CHECK step of the given status, returning the flow plus its implement and self-check steps. <!--#b588e220690f4aad-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_revision_needed_triggers_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts a REVISION_NEEDED SELF_CHECK transitions back to the original IMPLEMENT step and increments the fix iteration to 1. <!--#3153c2dabe3f662b-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_revision_sets_implement_fix_inputs` (method) — Asserts the fix loop populates the implement step's inputs with the fix-iteration flag, iteration number, self-check fix instructions, and self_check fix-context reason. <!--#933299815a923e8d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_respects_max_fix_iterations` (method) — Asserts that when max fix iterations are exhausted, a SELF_CHECK revision fails the flow and returns no next step. <!--#9dcbb1b14d1f5e30-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_completed_proceeds_to_verify_spec` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED SELF_CHECK with no fix needed proceeds to the VERIFY_SPEC step. <!--#442d0a1d6384c37c-->
  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_shares_fix_iteration_with_test_and_verify` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK fix triggers increment the same global fix-iteration counter shared with TEST and VERIFY_SPEC across successive revisions. <!--#a36abf80a6bbfa30-->
- `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck` (class) — Test class verifying StateMachine._transition_to_fix records and logs the correct source when the fix loop is triggered by SELF_CHECK. <!--#a149c24d14498fe7-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture providing a StateMachine instance with PersistenceManager patched out, rooted at a temp path. <!--#63f24a4da29cc019-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.test_fix_history_records_self_check_trigger` (method) — Asserts the fix-history entry records trigger_step_type and reason as 'self_check' after a SELF_CHECK-triggered fix transition. <!--#d8e423ef3c54077d-->
  - `TestTransitionToFixFromSelfCheck.test_fix_transition_prints_self_check_source` (method) — Asserts the fix-transition log output identifies the source as 'self_check (code review)' and notes code review found actionable issues. <!--#d39e77ed8163fa51-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck` (class) — Test class verifying StateMachine._build_step_inputs assembles the correct inputs for the SELF_CHECK step and exposes its outputs downstream. <!--#2fafd7e9c7788d5e-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.state_machine` (method) — Pytest fixture providing a plain StateMachine instance rooted at a temp path. <!--#a40360b4f3664c09-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_test_results` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include the test_results carried from the completed TEST step. <!--#ad8504db832a896f-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_changes_made` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include a changes_made bundle with files_changed and implemented_groups from the IMPLEMENT step. <!--#7b6e6b961488ef91-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_receives_fix_iteration_in_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs include the current fix_iteration value when the flow is in a fix loop. <!--#4624881bf8a8bd9d-->
  - `TestBuildStepInputsSelfCheck.test_self_check_no_fix_iteration_when_zero` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK inputs omit the fix_iteration key when the flow is not in a fix loop. <!--#39978e5b64b2f505-->

- `TestSelfCheckHandlerRegistration` (class) — Test class verifying the self_check_handler is properly registered in the engine's step-handler infrastructure. <!--#613e7e5ec2a4b679-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_diff_fallback_guard.py` (python) — Test module for the second hard spec-write protection layer in StateMachine.run_step, which snapshots and diffs se3/specs/** hashes around each non-exempt step to fail steps that touch a spec file (e.g. via a Bash redirect that bypasses the PreToolUse hook). <!--#5a4476ff3e1e1364|00a80585cfb1c41e-->

  - `TestSpecDiffGuardEnabled.test_implement_guarded_by_default` (method) — Asserts that IMPLEMENT steps are guarded by the diff fallback by default. <!--#7011e432d503c850-->

  - `TestSpecDiffGuardEnabled.test_exemption_uses_shared_constant_not_literal` (method) — Asserts the exemption set SPEC_WRITE_ALLOWED_STEPS contains update_spec and all sync steps rather than a hardcoded UPDATE_SPEC check. <!--#fb9122d37d9ec3eb-->
- `TestRunStepDiffGuard` (class) — Test class exercising the diff guard's end-to-end behavior through StateMachine.run_step. <!--#aa8ba15bebccca9f-->

  - `TestRunStepDiffGuard.test_spec_gate_not_flagged_when_no_spec_write` (method) — Asserts a clean SPEC_GATE step (non-exempt but spec-touching only when it writes) passes when it writes no spec. <!--#ea820c382d964f1a-->
  - `TestRunStepDiffGuard.test_disabled_config_does_not_flag` (method) — Asserts that with the fallback disabled in config, a bypass spec write during IMPLEMENT is not flagged and the step completes. <!--#9876884caf453b18-->
  - `TestRunStepDiffGuard.test_handler_failure_keeps_original_error` (method) — Asserts a handler that both writes a spec and raises keeps its own error message, since the guard only overrides a non-FAILED status. <!--#709e9668bfe045de-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_format.py` (python) — Unit test suite for se3.engine.spec_format, verifying parse_spec's requirement/header boundary handling, tags/keywords/refs extraction (with code-block and table skipping), and validate's issue detection for duplicate/illegal names, deep headings with accurate line numbers, and missing Purpose/v1-marker warnings. <!--#86dac75c16fb847c|0f5e46458ff2ab2f-->

  - `TestParseSpecBasic.test_empty_spec_no_requirements` (method) — Asserts a spec with no requirement headers yields empty requirements, a header containing Purpose, and no v1 marker. <!--#cbef8d574d4d809f-->

  - `TestParseSpecBasic.test_requirement_body_excludes_next_boundary` (method) — Asserts a requirement's body stops at the next requirement header boundary. <!--#df8dfa28acb21014-->
  - `TestParseSpecBasic.test_line_start_tracking` (method) — Asserts each requirement records the accurate 1-based source line where its header begins. <!--#1f0c0f6cff98f831-->

  - `TestParseSpecCodeBlocks.test_requirement_in_code_block_ignored` (method) — Asserts a fake requirement header inside a markdown fence is skipped while surrounding real ones parse. <!--#0c4d2f8c0e705b64-->

  - `TestParseSpecTagsKeywords.test_multiple_tags_lines_all_captured` (method) — Asserts multiple **tags** lines (a merge artifact) are all merged into one tag list. <!--#12d2ccbd52bb2ad9-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_adjudicate.py` (python) — Unit tests for the state machine's adjudication-trigger routing, verifying that a SELF_CHECK REVISION_NEEDED diverts to a dynamically-inserted ADJUDICATE step on an oscillation hit or periodic backstop (while a miss stays on the IMPLEMENT fix loop), that only SELF_CHECK-sourced revisions can adjudicate, and that inserted ADJUDICATE steps survive persistence round-trips while the global max-fix-iterations bound still caps the flow. <!--#3bdd3788de338d8c|096963a6f60a3880-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that builds a StateMachine with its PersistenceManager patched out and optionally pins a fixed WorkflowConfig so tests don't depend on an on-disk se3.yaml. <!--#decd3680156c55a1-->
- `_issue` (function) — Test factory that builds a canonical self-check issue dict (severity, expected/actual behavior, expectation source, evidence lines) with overridable expected/path/line/quote fields. <!--#662ca7d1aea26b11-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a running FlowInstance with completed IMPLEMENT and TEST steps plus a trigger step (SELF_CHECK or TEST) in REVISION_NEEDED carrying fix issues, positioned as the current step. <!--#3bf85c76ffb40e02-->
- `_seed_oscillation` (function) — Test helper that records a prior self-check round on the ledger so the current round appears as an expectation-flip oscillation against it. <!--#ebaa02ae19b3874d-->
- `TestTriggerRouting` (class) — Test class verifying how the state machine routes a REVISION_NEEDED trigger — oscillation and periodic-backstop signals route to ADJUDICATE while a clean/below-period miss routes into the normal fix loop. <!--#13dc7133ae10de55-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_oscillation_hit_routes_to_adjudicate` (method) — Asserts that an oscillation on the ledger inserts and routes to an ADJUDICATE step just before SELF_CHECK without entering the fix loop or advancing the fix iteration. <!--#bb41277a9ab4368c-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_miss_routes_to_fix_loop` (method) — Asserts that with no oscillation signal and the period disabled, the trigger routes back to IMPLEMENT (the fix loop) and increments the fix iteration. <!--#73401511f17e81db-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_periodic_backstop_forces_adjudicate` (method) — Asserts that reaching the configured adjudicate_period forces an ADJUDICATE step even without a structural signal and resets the ledger's period baseline to the current iteration. <!--#ef02aa6bf7ef4c81-->
  - `TestTriggerRouting.test_below_period_no_backstop` (method) — Asserts that one iteration short of the adjudicate_period the backstop does not fire and routing stays in the IMPLEMENT fix loop. <!--#0da3364651edd48d-->
- `TestSourceGating` (class) — Test class verifying that only SELF_CHECK-sourced revisions can trigger adjudication. <!--#166ec82ad044fd83-->
  - `TestSourceGating.test_test_revision_never_adjudicates` (method) — Asserts that a TEST-sourced REVISION_NEEDED keeps fix routing (IMPLEMENT) even when the ledger holds an oscillation that would fire for SELF_CHECK. <!--#4b8ad6e35371e9b6-->
- `TestResumeAndBound` (class) — Test class verifying that an inserted ADJUDICATE step survives state serialization round-trips and that the global max-fix-iterations bound still halts a diseased flow. <!--#bafbb55058b88983-->
  - `TestResumeAndBound.test_adjudicate_survives_state_roundtrip` (method) — Asserts that after routing to ADJUDICATE, serializing and deserializing the state preserves the step in selected_steps, its current-step id, and its PENDING status. <!--#6fcfc2410e6e122f-->
  - `TestResumeAndBound.test_max_fix_iterations_still_caps` (method) — Asserts that at the max_fix_iterations bound the flow fails and halts (returns None, no ADJUDICATE inserted) even with an active oscillation on the ledger. <!--#70aee44b593baed9-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_adjudicate_reflow.py` (python) — Unit tests for the state machine's post-ADJUDICATE handling (group G6), covering both the reflow routing (benign no-op rulings passing through to IMPLEMENT vs. effective/fallback rulings reflowing to a fresh SELF_CHECK pass #1, with fix-iteration counting and stash reset) and the confirmation gate (when a CONFIRM step is inserted, skipped, approved, or rejected based on ruling type and reviewer config). <!--#fa6e9089d945ec7e|e3201e089c060315-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Test helper that builds a StateMachine with a patched PersistenceManager and a stubbed workflow config (defaulting to unbounded fix iterations, adjudicate_period=0). <!--#90f99e7092da974f-->
- `_issue` (function) — Test helper that returns a canonical self-check issue dict (high-severity, task-description-sourced) for use as fixture data. <!--#90e9ca2a0f8e0ca4-->
- `_make_post_adjudicate_flow` (function) — Test helper that constructs a FlowInstance parked on a just-completed ADJUDICATE step (with IMPLEMENT/TEST/SELF_CHECK history) mirroring the state left by _transition_to_adjudicate, parameterized by the ruling's outputs. <!--#7e9e0fb960c78ce3-->
- `TestReflow` (class) — Test class covering the post-ADJUDICATE reflow routing — verifying that benign no-op rulings pass through to IMPLEMENT while effective rulings and defensive fallbacks reflow to a fresh SELF_CHECK pass #1. <!--#8b7ff6a694073803-->
  - `TestReflow.test_benign_ruling_passes_through_to_implement` (method) — Asserts a no-op (review_divergence) ruling routes straight to IMPLEMENT with the triggering round's untouched fix_instructions, with only the mechanical effects (ADJUDICATE slot stripped, benign rejected_positions landed, single fix-iteration increment) applied. <!--#b6ee2fc2c9a05667-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_trigger_id_absent` (method) — Asserts a no-op ruling missing its adjudication_trigger_step_id degrades gracefully to the standard reflow (fresh SELF_CHECK pass #1) without raising, still stripping the ADJUDICATE slot and landing ledger effects. <!--#31392e3218d4f2f7-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_trigger_is_non_self_check` (method) — Asserts a no-op ruling whose trigger id resolves to a non-SELF_CHECK step (e.g. IMPLEMENT) also degrades to the standard SELF_CHECK reflow without raising. <!--#2bfb0cf845ceaf7b-->
  - `TestReflow.test_noop_falls_back_to_reflow_when_fix_transition_declines` (method) — Asserts that when _transition_to_fix returns None despite a resolvable trigger, the no-op router falls back to the standard reflow, exercising idempotent double-stripping of the ADJUDICATE slot to still yield a fresh SELF_CHECK. <!--#e76e97b940379283-->
  - `TestReflow.test_reflow_starts_at_pass_1_and_resets_stash` (method) — Asserts a landing (plan-override, 免确认) ruling reflows to SELF_CHECK pass 1 and mechanically clears the cross-pass deferred-issues stash. <!--#4caf55fbbd684749-->
  - `TestReflow.test_reflow_counts_as_fix_iteration` (method) — Asserts a landing plan-override ruling's reflow increments the fix-iteration counter and threads the new count into the SELF_CHECK inputs. <!--#cccc7edc1a20e4d9-->
  - `TestReflow.test_superseded_fix_instructions_never_reach_implement` (method) — Asserts a plan-only 免确认 ruling reflows without replaying the superseded fix_instructions into IMPLEMENT and records fix_instructions_superseded for audit. <!--#73e74f778ebb3af1-->
  - `TestReflow.test_no_synthetic_description_changed_issue` (method) — Asserts the reflow does not fabricate a synthetic description-changed issue, leaving the fresh SELF_CHECK's outputs empty. <!--#ac11d544e5da8cfa-->
  - `TestReflow.test_max_fix_iterations_caps_after_reflow` (method) — Asserts the reflow's iteration increment keeps max_fix_iterations enforceable so a re-run SELF_CHECK tripping REVISION_NEEDED at the cap FAILs the flow. <!--#808f50852561c110-->
- `TestConfirmationGate` (class) — Test class verifying the post-ADJUDICATE confirmation gate: when and how a CONFIRM step is inserted (or skipped) based on ruling type (description rewrite vs plan-only) and reviewer config (human/LLM/unconfigured), including baseline-selection correctness and fix-iteration counting. <!--#9bfbde5204e3a80a-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_description_change_inserts_human_confirm` (method) — Asserts a description-patch ruling inserts a human CONFIRM step (reviewing the adjudicate step) between ADJUDICATE and SELF_CHECK without yet counting a fix iteration. <!--#86f6355041d9336a-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_baseline_is_pre_ruling_task_not_the_rewrite` (method) — Asserts the inserted CONFIRM reviews the description proposal against the pre-ruling task_description baseline, not the ruling's own not-yet-approved rewrite. <!--#538687f572bba8d2-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_description_change_auto_passes_when_unconfigured` (method) — Test asserting that with no confirmation config an adjudicate description rewrite auto-passes, reflowing straight to SELF_CHECK with no CONFIRM step inserted (human gating is opt-in). <!--#c99670f36acc3a83-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_no_config_skips_confirmation` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling with no confirmation config reflows straight to SELF_CHECK, inserting no CONFIRM. <!--#156dbe955ef9ac76-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_llm_reviewer_inserts_confirm` (method) — Asserts a plan-only ruling with an LLM-reviewer config inserts a CONFIRM whose reviewer is the default LLM chain (reviewer=None). <!--#7a11b3371ce0e43c-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_plan_only_human_reviewer_skips_confirmation` (method) — Test asserting that a plan-only ruling is never human-gated—even with reviewer=human configured it reflows directly to SELF_CHECK with no CONFIRM, since human gating governs description rewrites only. <!--#dca9dc17640dca36-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_approved_reflows_and_counts` (method) — Asserts an approved adjudicate-CONFIRM reflows to SELF_CHECK and counts the fix iteration exactly like a direct ruling. <!--#0d384cf8ca91dfcd-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_confirm_rejected_reruns_adjudicate_via_revision` (method) — Asserts a rejected CONFIRM re-runs the same ADJUDICATE step through the shared revision loop with feedback threaded in, reusing the review counter and consuming no fix iteration. <!--#09a06fc7774395ac-->
  - `TestConfirmationGate.test_rejected_then_benign_reruling_removes_stale_confirm_slot` (method) — Asserts that when a rejected description-patch CONFIRM is followed by a benign re-ruling, the no-op pass-through removes both the orphaned CONFIRM and ADJUDICATE slots so the flow reaches IMPLEMENT and keeps running instead of pausing on a spurious TEST confirmation. <!--#e9e4f127a5e4cb86-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_baseline_failures.py` (python) — Unit tests for the StateMachine's pre-implement test-baseline lifecycle (G3), covering _start_baseline_capture (cache hit/miss, resume, launch-failure safety), _ensure_baseline_ready (idempotency, background success, sync fallback, timeout/double-fail degradation to empty, and cache writeback), cleanup_baseline_capture (killing or safely skipping the capture handle), run_step wiring (ensure only on IMPLEMENT, idempotent fix-loop re-entry), and _build_step_inputs injecting a defensive copy of baseline_failures into TEST inputs. <!--#17fde00a48cc7a4f|84848daf1e31f612-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a fresh feature-type FlowInstance for use as a test fixture. <!--#32a40d3cc61515b7-->
- `_fake_capture` (function) — Helper that builds a MagicMock stand-in BaselineCapture whose bounded wait returns a given result and exposes a configurable timed_out flag. <!--#506ee1ac9f9a10d7-->
- `TestStartBaselineCapture` (class) — Test class covering _start_baseline_capture: cache hit, cache miss launching background capture, resume skip, and launch-failure safety. <!--#c2ca53f1b7cce721-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_hit_skips_background_launch` (method) — Asserts a cache hit populates baseline_failures from cache and launches no background capture. <!--#ec2131d20577e2ec-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_miss_launches_background_capture` (method) — Asserts a cache miss launches a background capture and leaves baseline state unmeasured (None) until later resolution. <!--#93133cbf9b178330-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_resume_with_existing_baseline_does_not_relaunch` (method) — Asserts a resumed flow with an already-measured baseline neither recomputes the key nor relaunches capture. <!--#1206af5dbed0965f-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_launch_failure_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts an exception during capture startup is swallowed, leaving baseline_failures None without raising. <!--#17f8c291e912867d-->
- `TestEnsureBaselineReady` (class) — Test class covering _ensure_baseline_ready: idempotency, background success, sync fallback, no-handle/double-fail/timeout degradation, and cache writeback. <!--#a4575554336d1acb-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_idempotent_when_already_measured` (method) — Asserts an already-measured baseline causes no wait and leaves the value unchanged. <!--#65f5014c4333e224-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_success_sets_sorted_baseline` (method) — Asserts a successful background result sets a sorted baseline, saves the cache, and clears the capture handle. <!--#c7662e31944e37eb-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_none_triggers_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts a None background result triggers a synchronous re-measurement that yields the authoritative baseline. <!--#e9b87d5e4a3fb42b-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_no_handle_runs_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts that with no background capture handle (e.g. earlier launch failure) the synchronous fallback runs. <!--#a72c8e10c85644f5-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_both_paths_fail_uses_empty_baseline` (method) — Asserts that when both background and sync captures fail, the baseline degrades to an empty list rather than None. <!--#1e4e61c6c71110cb-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_fix_loop.py` (python) — Unit/integration tests for the StateMachine's test-verify-fix loop, covering fix-iteration counting and capped history, _transition_to_fix routing failed verify/test/self-check steps back to implement, transition_to_next enforcing finite caps versus the unlimited-0 sentinel across all trigger types, fix-context propagation and deep-copying into rebuilt step inputs, and the unlimited-mode/self-check-convergence interaction wired through the real WorkflowConfig load path. <!--#9cdd692e721a5a53|9dbf81215f7059d0-->

  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_increment_fix_iteration_multiple` (method) — Verifies repeated increment_fix_iteration calls increment the counter monotonically. <!--#356bc7627ff31311-->

  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_fix_history_capped_at_max_entries` (method) — Verifies fix_history is capped to a recent-window of FIX_HISTORY_MAX_ENTRIES while the counter keeps growing. <!--#61effe85088e4f43-->
  - `TestFixIterationTracking.test_fix_iteration_serialization` (method) — Verifies fix-iteration count and history serialize correctly via to_dict. <!--#4d3953bd9caa9354-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_partial.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying the StateMachine treats a step's PARTIAL status like COMPLETED — advancing the flow forward, forwarding implement outputs and discovered_issues downstream, and completing (not failing or retrying/fix-looping) the flow — while FAILED steps neither transition nor forward outputs. <!--#aec600f52cd56f35|a44531805dc0ff40-->
- `state_machine` (function) — Pytest fixture building a StateMachine with a temp project root and a mocked PersistenceManager/persistence layer. <!--#d287415db4170f8a-->

### `tests/engine/test_task_description_composer.py` (python) — Unit tests for `compose_task_description_with_interjections`, verifying it deterministically appends a structured '## Additional Instructions' section of `[step@timestamp]`-prefixed bullets onto a base task description while handling edge cases like empty/whitespace text, missing step_type or timestamp, malformed non-dict entries, and empty bases. <!--#5d7a511c99d38133|003ab16606465f9b-->

- `test_single_interjection_appends_section` (function) — Verifies a single interjection appends the section header and a bracketed [step@timestamp]-prefixed bullet after the base. <!--#6db5005c5e16ed3e-->

- `test_interjection_text_is_stripped` (function) — Verifies surrounding whitespace is stripped from each interjection's text in the rendered bullet. <!--#bc8f4827ae5b796b-->
- `test_empty_text_entries_skipped` (function) — Asserts interjections whose text is empty after stripping are dropped, leaving only real bullets. <!--#1616aaa9344e8824-->
- `test_all_entries_empty_returns_base_unchanged` (function) — Confirms that when every interjection has empty text, no section is appended and the base is returned unchanged. <!--#ed811cfb84fbfb1d-->
- `test_missing_step_or_timestamp_omits_prefix` (function) — Verifies an interjection lacking both step_type and timestamp renders a bare bullet with no bracketed prefix. <!--#4122e44fcc13d563-->
- `test_only_step_type_present` (function) — Checks that step_type without a timestamp produces the single-value [step] prefix form. <!--#d76c7505d1c1063d-->
- `test_only_timestamp_present` (function) — Checks that a timestamp without step_type produces the single-value [ts] prefix form. <!--#96df6bddfbc99c4b-->

  - `TestBaselineRoundTripExemptsInheritedFailures.test_failure_absent_from_baseline_is_introduced` (method) — Verifies the negative half: failures absent from an empty measured baseline are classified as introduced and block, guarding against over-exemption. <!--#0cb10bb9045e9a38-->

### `tests/engine/test_test_step_timeout_retry.py` (python) — Unit tests for the test step's two behaviors — the one-shot in-place retry on a timed-out command (when it fires vs. not, its timeout-vs-assertion fix labeling, and that it doesn't bump fix_iteration) and the passed-phase history archive slimming (replacing a passing phase's stored stdout with an accurate count+tail summary while failed phases keep full output), built around helpers that fabricate flows, TEST steps, configs, and normal/timeout command-result dicts. <!--#43eba96ef561a891|48b480f848d8ac62-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_success_continues_normally` (method) — Asserts a first-run timeout followed by a passing retry completes normally with no fix loop or timeout metadata. <!--#268b76975a9aa4a2-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_still_timeout_enters_fix_with_timeout_label` (method) — Asserts two consecutive timeouts enter the fix loop with timeout-not-assertion labeling and the canonical reason text. <!--#9ad7c704fac9c2a4-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_does_not_increment_fix_iteration` (method) — Asserts the in-place retry does not bump the fix-iteration counter and runs exactly once. <!--#316107c3b1a40cba-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_required_phase_timeout_is_retried_once` (method) — Asserts a required configured phase that times out gets the same one-shot retry and recovers without a fix loop. <!--#0db645eea5ecbc2c-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_persistent_required_phase_timeout_labels_fix_context` (method) — Asserts a required phase timing out twice enters the fix loop with timeout-not-assertion metadata naming the phase. <!--#fc74e02e4f275e7c-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_returncode_minus_one_without_marker_is_retried` (method) — Asserts a bare returncode -1 result with no flag or marker is still recognized as a timeout and retried. <!--#02df188980050f87-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_passes_with_timeout_stderr_not_recorded_as_timeout` (method) — Asserts a passing retry that echoes a timeout marker is not classified as a persistent timeout failure. <!--#5b2df7ada0236793-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_exception_fallback_returncode_minus_two_not_retried` (method) — Asserts the subprocess-spawn-exception fallback (returncode -2) is not misclassified as a timeout and is not retried. <!--#ac3a041bbeaceac0-->

### `tests/engine/test_verify_spec_renderer.py` (python) — Unit tests for the VERIFY_SPEC step renderer, verifying that summary and recommendations fall back to the nested verification_result dict (with top-level fields taking precedence) and that issue priorities produce well-formed Rich close tags. <!--#2aad234df505ac09|17e1e29728c5483e-->

  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_reads_from_nested_verification_result` (method) — Asserts the summary is read from outputs['verification_result']['summary'] when no top-level summary exists. <!--#6283d975621d7f5b-->

  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_no_summary_anywhere` (method) — Asserts the renderer still emits a PASSED result when no summary is present anywhere. <!--#20d63b61972b2d03-->
  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_verification_result_not_dict` (method) — Asserts the renderer does not crash when verification_result is a string instead of a dict. <!--#3bbcb095139a336d-->
- `TestRecommendationsFallback` (class) — Test class verifying recommendations are sourced from top-level outputs with fallback to the nested verification_result dict. <!--#60338754984fc417-->
  - `TestRecommendationsFallback.test_reads_from_nested_verification_result` (method) — Asserts recommendations are read from the nested verification_result when no top-level recommendations exist. <!--#4d6290d21205c34b-->
  - `TestRecommendationsFallback.test_toplevel_takes_precedence` (method) — Asserts top-level recommendations are used and nested verification_result recommendations are ignored. <!--#8ff35b98a2dac7d6-->
- `TestRichCloseTag` (class) — Test class verifying issue priorities map to correctly-formed Rich close tags without an extra trailing bracket. <!--#dc905f075be3c1d4-->
  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_red_close_tag_for_high_priority` (method) — Asserts a high-priority issue produces a well-formed [/red] close tag with no stray bracket. <!--#da981b37d75a73e5-->
  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_yellow_close_tag_for_medium_priority` (method) — Asserts a medium-priority issue produces a well-formed [/yellow] close tag with no stray bracket. <!--#1ea4a58932779cc6-->
  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_dim_close_tag_for_low_priority` (method) — Asserts a low-priority issue produces a well-formed [/dim] close tag with no stray bracket. <!--#4f3eff3532513d94-->

### `tests/engine/test_worktree_gc.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the worktree-GC engine module, exercising stale-run discovery (`find_stale_worktree_runs`), the `_dir_size` byte-summing helper, and the full GC sweep across merged, unmerged, unresolvable-base, dry-run, archive-failure, and multi-run-isolation scenarios using real git worktrees and engine.json run headers. <!--#526270795e9e4791|78aa405d786dea02-->
- `_git` (function) — Test helper that runs a `git -C <path>` subcommand with output captured, raising on non-zero exit. <!--#c3617b36133d72b8-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Test helper that initializes a git repo with an identity and an initial README commit, returning the default branch name. <!--#3f2c447fc20652bb-->
- `_branch_exists` (function) — Test helper returning whether a given git ref/branch resolves in the repo. <!--#fe856a428f75db97-->
- `_make_worktree_run` (function) — Test fixture builder that creates a real branch, adds a git worktree under `se3/worktrees/<name>`, and writes an engine.json run header, with knobs for status, worktree-mode, merged-into-base, backdated mtime, and custom JSON. <!--#716f679f0bb20860-->
- `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns` (class) — Test suite verifying `find_stale_worktree_runs` returns only terminal, over-age, worktree-mode runs while excluding fresh, running, non-worktree, corrupt-JSON, archived, and missing-root cases. <!--#09e436928cadbc14-->
  - `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns.test_returns_only_terminal_over_age_worktree_runs` (method) — Asserts only the stale completed worktree run is returned (fresh, running, and non-worktree runs excluded) with its recorded fields intact. <!--#fec728ae6fb0c6dd-->
  - `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns.test_failed_status_is_terminal` (method) — Asserts a `failed`-status over-age run counts as terminal and is reported stale. <!--#e5f4d4508e496fab-->
  - `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns.test_corrupt_json_excluded` (method) — Asserts a run with unparseable engine.json is skipped rather than crashing the scan. <!--#f2601708bfefcb72-->
  - `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns.test_archive_dir_not_scanned` (method) — Asserts engine.json under the `.archive` directory is not scanned as a live stale run. <!--#2fdf7c0ebc20b219-->
  - `TestFindStaleWorktreeRuns.test_missing_worktrees_root` (method) — Asserts an empty list is returned when the `se3/worktrees` root does not exist. <!--#22865e86df6dde0f-->
- `TestDirSize` (class) — Test suite for the `_dir_size` helper covering recursive byte summation and the missing-directory case. <!--#5cfbdc4540b3140f-->
  - `TestDirSize.test_sums_file_bytes` (method) — Asserts `_dir_size` recursively sums file byte counts across nested subdirectories. <!--#8719a6773515b7c5-->
  - `TestDirSize.test_missing_dir_is_zero` (method) — Asserts `_dir_size` returns 0 for a nonexistent directory. <!--#e131c67279883faf-->
- `TestGcMergedBranch` (class) — Test suite verifying that GC archives and deletes worktree runs whose branch is provably merged into its recorded base, even when HEAD sits on an unrelated branch. <!--#b3986da8b6a2a6ad-->
  - `TestGcMergedBranch.test_archives_and_deletes_merged_branch` (method) — Asserts a merged run is archived (under `.archive/worktree_<name>-<epoch>`), its worktree and branch deleted, bytes reclaimed, and its state promoted to the main archive. <!--#1f7c0a8360c91c56-->
  - `TestGcMergedBranch.test_deletes_merged_branch_when_head_on_unrelated_branch` (method) — Regression test asserting GC still deletes a branch proven merged into its recorded base even though the current checkout is a divergent branch that would make `git branch -d` refuse. <!--#df351e1b0946b432-->
- `TestGcUnmergedBranch` (class) — Test suite verifying GC archives and removes an unmerged run's worktree but preserves its branch ref and reports it as retained_unmerged. <!--#4512cc62716a39a2-->
  - `TestGcUnmergedBranch.test_retains_unmerged_branch_ref` (method) — Asserts an unmerged run is archived with its worktree removed but its branch kept and recorded in retained_unmerged with branch/original metadata. <!--#4f02d9d61c87a810-->
- `TestGcUnresolvableBase` (class) — Test suite asserting that when the recorded original branch is missing or unrecorded, merge is undecidable, so the branch is retained even if it is an ancestor of HEAD (no HEAD fallback). <!--#c17b42d4d261ab19-->
  - `TestGcUnresolvableBase._rewrite_original_branch` (method) — Test helper that rewrites or removes the `worktree_original_branch` field in a run's engine.json and re-backdates its mtime. <!--#b0eab5d240a24ae7-->
  - `TestGcUnresolvableBase.test_retains_branch_when_original_branch_missing_ref` (method) — Asserts a branch is retained (with a 'no longer resolvable' reason) when its recorded original branch no longer resolves, despite being a HEAD ancestor. <!--#51bbb4cf3f1eb0e9-->
  - `TestGcUnresolvableBase.test_retains_branch_when_no_original_branch_recorded` (method) — Asserts a branch is retained (with a 'no recorded original branch' reason) when no original branch was recorded at all. <!--#e8be00d31c370061-->
- `TestGcDryRun` (class) — Test suite verifying dry-run GC populates the accounting report while leaving the worktree, branch, and archive directory untouched. <!--#7fdb75a8291efbaa-->
  - `TestGcDryRun.test_dry_run_touches_nothing` (method) — Asserts dry-run reports the run as archived with reclaimable bytes but leaves worktree/branch intact, writes no archive, and returns a None archive path. <!--#18cb3adf21da02ee-->
- `TestGcArchiveFailure` (class) — Test suite verifying that when archiving or worktree removal fails, GC skips destructive steps, preserves the worktree/branch, and records the error instead of phantom reclamation. <!--#22620de52d631de4-->
  - `TestGcArchiveFailure.test_archive_failure_preserves_worktree_and_branch` (method) — Asserts an archive-step exception leaves the worktree and branch intact and records an 'archive' error with nothing reclaimed. <!--#1b3ff49f8e019176-->
  - `TestGcArchiveFailure.test_removal_failure_not_reported_as_reclaimed` (method) — Asserts that a silently-failing worktree removal is caught as a 'removal failed' error rather than reported as reclaimed, keeping the branch for a re-run. <!--#0d41e736760c2491-->
- `TestGcRunIsolation` (class) — Test suite verifying one run's failure during the GC sweep does not abort processing of subsequent runs. <!--#d60ff9e6c91820d9-->
  - `TestGcRunIsolation.test_one_failure_does_not_abort_sweep` (method) — Asserts that when the first (alphabetically) run's archive raises, the later good run is still archived and removed and only the failing run's error is recorded. <!--#134068b60a02ac64-->

## `tests/engine/steps/` — Test directory for se3 engine step handlers, covering the commit step (version auto-repair, baseline diffs, commit-message construction, docs updates, root-whitelist guard), the implement step (DAG parallel execution, leaf-branch merge robustness, cleanup safety nets, re-entry/version preservation, restricted edits, session-commit collection, estimated-duration forwarding), and the plan step (confirmation prompt building and retirement of spec-governance machinery). <!--#b6ff3a89af09e3b9|5cb3b407ee882519-->

### `tests/engine/steps/__init__.py` (python) — Package initializer marking the test directory for se3 engine step tests. <!--#429dc51c11cee801|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_commit.py` (python) — Unit tests for the COMMIT flow step, covering version-read auto-repair paths (RuntimeError/ValueError/KeyError in script vs. file mode, with and without an existing version file), template summary generation and its optional Version Analysis section, and the helpers that collect changed files and test results from the flow's prior steps. <!--#de7ea872305b0b88|5574fe2342349e99-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a MagicMock FlowInstance (with sensible defaults like a bugfix task and non-worktree mode) plus a mock State carrying selected_steps/step_history, for exercising the commit step in tests. <!--#d46fe7cdc4a3b789-->

- `TestRuntimeErrorScriptModeAutoRepair` (class) — Tests that a RuntimeError from read_version() in script mode triggers auto-repair via generate_version_script(), completing on a successful retry and failing the step when the retry also raises. <!--#bf640bef58e4e325-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorScriptModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_script_mode_triggers_generate_version_script` (method) — Asserts a script-mode RuntimeError invokes generate_version_script() and the retried read_version succeeds with COMPLETED. <!--#3405ee68b4e10d7b-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorScriptModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_script_mode_retry_fails_propagates` (method) — Asserts that when script-mode repair runs but the retry still raises, the step is FAILED with the error message propagated. <!--#5ff18813092b9539-->
- `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair` (class) — Tests that a RuntimeError from read_version() in file mode triggers auto-repair via initialize_version_system(), completing on a successful retry and failing the step when the retry also raises. <!--#d88f76724852f1b7-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_file_mode_triggers_initialize_version_system` (method) — Asserts a file-mode RuntimeError invokes initialize_version_system() and the retried read_version succeeds with COMPLETED. <!--#f7373cae17a36bfc-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_file_mode_retry_fails_propagates` (method) — Asserts that when file-mode repair runs but the retry still raises, the step is FAILED with the error message propagated. <!--#6b868950b06bb3c0-->

  - `TestRuntimeErrorNoVersionFileAutoRepair.test_no_version_file_script_mode_runtime_error_triggers_repair` (method) — Asserts that with no version file in script mode, a post-init RuntimeError triggers generate_version_script() and the retry succeeds. <!--#71491b7883ec47b8-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorNoVersionFileAutoRepair.test_no_version_file_file_mode_runtime_error_triggers_repair` (method) — Asserts that with no version file in file mode, a post-init RuntimeError triggers a second initialize_version_system() call and the retry succeeds. <!--#78264579a6a6ed1c-->
- `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression` (class) — Regression tests confirming the pre-existing ValueError/KeyError auto-repair paths still route to the right repair function and still fail the step when the retry fails. <!--#23650ac12a9aaef3-->
  - `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression.test_value_error_triggers_auto_repair_file_mode` (method) — Asserts a ValueError from read_version in file mode triggers initialize_version_system() repair and completes. <!--#c6fe42c156ac5edb-->

  - `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression.test_value_error_retry_fails_propagates` (method) — Asserts that a ValueError whose retry still fails yields FAILED with the error message propagated. <!--#045cdac7ef3433d9-->

- `TestCommitVersionTagIntegration` (class) — Integration tests over real git repos covering annotated version-tag behaviour in the direct commit path: when tags are created or skipped (patch bumps, worktree mode, re-entries), and how tag failures, unreadable commit hashes, and foreign pre-existing tags are surfaced. <!--#1f0f0c2bd6ea3be5-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_self_check_task_groups.py` (python) — Unit tests for the self-check step's task-groups injection, covering the `_format_task_groups` renderer (markdown output, malformed/empty input handling, and oversized-plan degradation that trims criteria then descriptions while keeping every task visible), the `_build_task_groups_section` wrapper's authoritative hard-audit intro, and the handler's prompt injection that adds the strict-audit task-groups section when task groups exist and cleanly omits it without orphan headings otherwise. <!--#28a0a1312ed3561c|5a4cbb303d278df7-->

  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_multiple_groups_all_rendered` (method) — Asserts that multiple task groups each appear in the rendered markdown. <!--#f0dc310ad70f7b77-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_group_without_tasks_shows_placeholder` (method) — Asserts a group with no tasks renders a `_(no tasks)_` placeholder. <!--#08940456851fe81d-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_group_without_id_or_name` (method) — Asserts a group missing id/name renders an `(unnamed group)` label. <!--#d16f9d3f3fa2f5c7-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_task_without_description` (method) — Asserts a task lacking a description renders `(no description)`. <!--#ec5733dbf3fa693c-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_task_without_id` (method) — Asserts a task without an id renders without the bracketed id prefix. <!--#3f7e0f36b712f708-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_acceptance_criteria_not_a_list_is_skipped` (method) — Asserts a non-list `acceptance_criteria` value is skipped rather than rendered. <!--#7b53cd7e321bd7dd-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_empty_acceptance_criteria_entry_skipped` (method) — Asserts blank/whitespace acceptance-criteria entries are skipped while real ones render. <!--#144132229ca231df-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_oversized_input_keeps_every_task_visible` (method) — Asserts that a plan exceeding the render cap keeps every task header visible and offers a retrieval note for trimmed detail, rather than silently head-truncating later tasks. <!--#738f4020050c8ffd-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_ac_dropped_first_when_only_slightly_over_cap` (method) — Asserts the tier-2 degrade path: when dropping acceptance criteria alone fits the budget, full task descriptions are preserved while criteria are removed and a trimmed note is added. <!--#91d59fc0e483b9eb-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_no_truncation_note_when_under_cap` (method) — Asserts that small plans within the cap render without any truncation or trimmed note. <!--#16e4c9f0eb4f9b77-->
  - `TestFormatTaskGroups.test_non_dict_task_entries_skipped` (method) — Asserts non-dict task entries are skipped while valid dict tasks still render. <!--#0849ef5a6ab468e3-->
- `TestBuildTaskGroupsSection` (class) — Test class verifying `_build_task_groups_section` returns empty for blank input and wraps rendered task groups with the authoritative hard-audit intro heading and constant when populated. <!--#2357207f61d9f426-->
  - `TestBuildTaskGroupsSection.test_empty_input_returns_empty` (method) — Asserts None or empty-list input yields an empty section string. <!--#eefb3965759f03eb-->
  - `TestBuildTaskGroupsSection.test_populated_input_includes_intro` (method) — Asserts the populated section includes the authoritative hard-audit heading, intro phrasing, and the rendered task line. <!--#49611401b3cfb9d5-->

  - `TestHandlerPromptInjection.test_prompt_includes_section_when_task_groups_present` (method) — Asserts the final handler prompt contains the task-groups section with its strict hard-audit phrasing and `plan_task` expectation-source guidance, and that the old soft-reference disclaimer text is gone. <!--#70de880132a8699f-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_version_analyze.py` (python) — Unit tests for the VERSION_ANALYZE step handler, covering how it derives and stores commit_message, versions_changes changelog bullets, and the is_tag tag decision (default SemVer vs. custom version rules, worktree intent) from the LLM response, plus how those outputs are forwarded into the commit step's inputs. <!--#3a9291ba0134a8a9|f4ed5a1b9c1ea7bd-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a MagicMock FlowInstance with sensible defaults (notably is_worktree_mode=False to keep tests on the synchronous version-analyze path), overridable via kwargs. <!--#35d2033003262992-->

- `TestDiscoveryRunUsesRealType` (class) — Test class verifying that a --discover run feeds version_analyze the real inferred task type (e.g. 'feature') rather than the 'discovery' run mode, both in the LLM prompt and in fallback commit-message derivation. <!--#9ba2d1102d8e5d59-->
  - `TestDiscoveryRunUsesRealType.test_discovery_flow_injects_real_task_type` (method) — Asserts that for a discovery flow whose context holds analyzed_type='feature', the prompt sent to the LLM contains 'Task Type: feature' and never leaks 'Task Type: discovery'. <!--#ecc030622c19bc6f-->
  - `TestDiscoveryRunUsesRealType.test_discovery_flow_fallback_commit_message_uses_real_type` (method) — Asserts that when the LLM response omits commit_message, the discovery flow falls back to the task description as the stored commit_message without failing or leaking 'discovery'. <!--#39f78a21ebdf9608-->
- `TestVersionChangesOutput` (class) — Test class verifying version_analyze stores changelog bullets (versions_changes) with filtering and fallback rules. <!--#1437ae4fa4d02f8c-->
  - `TestVersionChangesOutput.test_versions_changes_stored_from_llm_response` (method) — Asserts a list of versions_changes bullets from the LLM is stored verbatim. <!--#48d2e0860e224991-->
  - `TestVersionChangesOutput.test_versions_changes_fallback_when_llm_omits_field` (method) — Asserts versions_changes falls back to [commit_message] when the LLM omits the field. <!--#20343f17acc5a8b6-->
  - `TestVersionChangesOutput.test_versions_changes_not_a_list_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a non-list versions_changes value falls back to [commit_message]. <!--#0fb7f398a787c2bd-->
  - `TestVersionChangesOutput.test_versions_changes_filters_non_string_elements` (method) — Asserts non-string and whitespace-only bullet elements are filtered while valid strings are kept. <!--#5210fe5e2aa0834f-->
  - `TestVersionChangesOutput.test_versions_changes_all_non_string_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a list with no usable strings falls back to [commit_message]. <!--#62d39f74d2151ffc-->
- `TestTagDecisionOutput` (class) — Test class covering how version_analyze derives and exposes the `is_tag` tag decision — from SemVer version advance under the default policy, and from the LLM's boolean under custom version rules — plus its propagation into step outputs, the prompt, and worktree version intent. <!--#dba201eeecbad945-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_default_semver_derives_is_tag_from_version_advance` (method) — Parametrized test asserting that under default SemVer, major and minor version advances set is_tag True while a patch advance sets it False. <!--#69f825cf8050561f-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_default_semver_outputs_is_tag_for_minor` (method) — Test that running the handler with a mocked LLM returning a minor bump completes and writes is_tag=True into the step outputs. <!--#943cb2f9103b34b3-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_malformed_bump_type_still_tags_a_minor_suggested_version` (method) — Test that a garbled bump_type is normalized to patch yet the minor suggested_version still drives is_tag=True, proving suggested_version is authoritative. <!--#269dd74cb8f7b843-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_malformed_bump_type_on_patch_advance_does_not_tag` (method) — Test that an unrecognized bump_type combined with a patch-level version advance yields is_tag=False. <!--#dc34544ae375a6ce-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_minor_bump_type_on_patch_advance_does_not_tag` (method) — Test that a claimed 'minor' bump_type cannot force a tag when the suggested version only advances the patch component. <!--#388b680c3f67e261-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_non_comparable_versions_never_tag_under_default_semver` (method) — Parametrized test that non-SemVer or missing versions produce no default-policy verdict, so is_tag stays False regardless of bump_type. <!--#f349c8491b6fd2ff-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_custom_rules_preserve_boolean_is_tag` (method) — Test that when custom version rules are active, an explicit boolean is_tag from the LLM is passed through unchanged. <!--#335d2d4fa189722e-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_custom_rules_non_boolean_is_tag_normalizes_false` (method) — Test that under custom rules a non-boolean is_tag value (string, int, None, dict) is normalized to False. <!--#42bd487f8a353216-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_custom_rules_prompt_and_output_include_is_tag` (method) — Test that with a version-rules.md present the handler injects is_tag guidance into the LLM prompt and surfaces the returned is_tag=True in step outputs. <!--#548b130187916277-->
  - `TestTagDecisionOutput.test_worktree_intent_includes_is_tag` (method) — Test that in worktree mode the tag decision is recorded both in the step's version_intent output and in the persisted intent file read back via read_intent. <!--#e9e7e86f1e177e10-->
- `TestVersionChangesForwarding` (class) — Test class verifying that the state machine forwards version_analyze outputs (versions_changes bullets, is_tag) into the commit step's inputs, defaulting missing keys sensibly. <!--#a4fe8c0707be3f3f-->

  - `TestVersionChangesForwarding.test_is_tag_forwarded_to_commit_inputs` (method) — Test that an is_tag=True output on version_analyze reaches the commit step's built inputs. <!--#1c278047dcc2dd2d-->

  - `TestPromptIncludesSessionCommitsAndPreSession.test_prompt_includes_pre_session_version_and_commit_list` (method) — Asserts the prompt surfaces the pre-session version, the commit list, the disk version, and the 'treat as not-happened' instruction. <!--#3110a3c409b3fcec-->
  - `TestPromptIncludesSessionCommitsAndPreSession.test_prompt_handles_empty_session_commits` (method) — Asserts an empty session_commits input still renders the explanatory line and pre-session version without crashing. <!--#673593d5de65b953-->
  - `TestPromptIncludesSessionCommitsAndPreSession.test_pre_session_version_fallback_to_current_version` (method) — Asserts that when pre_session_version is absent the handler falls back to the disk-read version and logs a warning. <!--#2a1c5bf3b717a0f2-->
- `TestWorktreeIntentPersistenceIsMandatory` (class) — Test class asserting that in worktree mode a version-intent write failure must FAIL the step, a successful persist COMPLETEs and writes the intent file, and disabled versioning emits/writes no intent at all. <!--#6502cbc2dfb2bf2a-->
  - `TestWorktreeIntentPersistenceIsMandatory.test_write_intent_oserror_fails_the_step` (method) — Verifies that when write_intent raises OSError in worktree mode, the step returns FAILED with a 'version-intents' error message and no suggested_version leaks into outputs. <!--#9e79099037f12a7e-->
  - `TestWorktreeIntentPersistenceIsMandatory.test_successful_persist_still_completes` (method) — Verifies that a successful worktree run returns COMPLETED and actually writes the intent JSON under se3/version-intents/ with the expected bump_type. <!--#dca23d4fea66aa53-->
  - `TestWorktreeIntentPersistenceIsMandatory.test_version_disabled_worktree_emits_no_intent` (method) — Verifies that with version bumping disabled in worktree mode the step COMPLETEs without emitting a version_intent, calling write_intent, or creating the intents directory. <!--#1bfe0f0e29fa3f98-->
- `TestEndToEndDoubleBumpReplay` (class) — End-to-end regression test class reproducing the double-bump scenario, verifying that pre_session_version + session_commits flow from implement through version_analyze into commit so the disk write uses the pre-session baseline rather than the already-bumped disk value. <!--#1327699f18b62e19-->
  - `TestEndToEndDoubleBumpReplay._make_implement_step` (method) — Helper building a completed IMPLEMENT Step whose outputs carry pre_session_version and the session_commits list to forward. <!--#6eca39d08174e5cd-->
  - `TestEndToEndDoubleBumpReplay._make_flow_with_implement` (method) — Helper building a real FlowInstance with an implement/version_analyze/commit step sequence and the implement step pre-added. <!--#94133f56048ec984-->
  - `TestEndToEndDoubleBumpReplay.test_e2e_replay_writes_pre_session_baseline_not_disk_baseline` (method) — Wires a real StateMachine/FlowInstance with mocked LLM and git side-effects to assert version_analyze surfaces the 5.1.0 baseline and inadvertent bump commit in its prompt, forwards suggested_version=5.2.0 to commit, and that commit writes that value instead of a second patch bump. <!--#2040732713276338-->
- `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay` (class) — Test class for commit's non-worktree version-race guard, ensuring the flow's own already-committed version isn't mistaken for concurrent drift while genuine drift is still re-analysed and re-analysis correctly forwards the refreshed tag decision. <!--#b030c3efd62b1cd9-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay._guard_flow` (method) — Helper building a mock flow with a real State and a tmp change_path for the guard-race tests. <!--#1892007e57882897-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay.test_own_prior_write_is_not_treated_as_drift` (method) — Verifies _guard_version_race keeps the resolved target and skips re-analysis when _flow_wrote_version reports the disk version is this flow's own prior write. <!--#1f8daeb352e67439-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay.test_true_concurrent_drift_still_reanalyses` (method) — Verifies that when the disk bump was another flow's, the guard re-analyses against the drifted baseline and returns the recomputed version (5.3.0). <!--#730a8b59aae93f9f-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay.test_reanalysis_forwards_refreshed_is_tag` (method) — Asserts that when re-analysis against a drifted baseline downgrades minor→patch, _reanalyze_version_with_baseline updates the commit step's bump_type and is_tag=False so a patch release isn't erroneously tagged. <!--#d2ecfe503a357f4c-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay.test_reanalysis_forwards_is_tag_true` (method) — Mirror case asserting that when re-analysis upgrades patch→minor, _reanalyze_version_with_baseline sets is_tag=True so the recomputed minor release begins getting tagged. <!--#e91a678ab6182f47-->
  - `TestGuardVersionRaceOwnReplay.test_reanalysis_returning_disk_version_halts` (method) — Verifies the guard raises RuntimeError('colliding version') when re-analysis of concurrent drift returns the same drifted disk version, preventing a shared-version collision. <!--#3f30da0d927af542-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_version_rules_file.py` (python) — Pytest module verifying the `_read_version_rules_file` loader across all branches (missing file/se3 dir → None, normal read verbatim, oversize truncation with warning, unreadable-file degradation to None) and pinning the `VERSION_RULES_FILE_RELPATH` constant to `se3/version-rules.md`. <!--#4a4a346a86114ea6|23bc3a2600fda277-->

  - `TestVersionRulesFileLoader.test_returns_none_when_se3_dir_missing` (method) — Asserts the loader returns None when the project root has no `se3/` directory at all. <!--#014e6c0558b1d5e5-->
  - `TestVersionRulesFileLoader.test_returns_full_content_for_normal_file` (method) — Asserts a normal-sized rules file is returned verbatim and untruncated. <!--#4d3f29b5922d7d4a-->
  - `TestVersionRulesFileLoader.test_truncates_oversized_file_and_warns` (method) — Asserts a file exceeding the byte cap is truncated with an appended notice and an 'exceeds' warning logged. <!--#a9fc460d864bfdbf-->
  - `TestVersionRulesFileLoader.test_returns_none_when_file_unreadable` (method) — Asserts that an OSError during read degrades to None with a 'Could not read' warning, by patching `Path.read_bytes` to raise only for the rules file. <!--#0c5325868b0401a8-->
- `TestVersionRulesFileRelPath` (class) — Test class that pins the `VERSION_RULES_FILE_RELPATH` constant as an explicit contract. <!--#20fa80e2daccb3ce-->
  - `TestVersionRulesFileRelPath.test_relpath_is_the_documented_location` (method) — Asserts the relpath constant equals the documented `se3/version-rules.md` location. <!--#9d9d463c758139e7-->

## `tests/frontend/` — The frontend test suite for the SE3 web console (server static app.js), combining a shared Node/browser-stub harness (test_app_pure.mjs plus render_in_browser.mjs / render_real_records.mjs drivers) with dozens of registerable *.test.mjs modules that pin the console's chat-stream rendering and interaction behavior — live append/self-heal and WebSocket-vs-full-pull consistency, step grouping/lane continuity and sticky headers, scroll-anchoring at step boundaries, confirm/adjudicate/tool-chip and reply-box interactions, history index delta merge, i18n, token-usage badges, flow resume/end and issue/user management, mobile responsiveness — backed by fixtures/ of real captured transcripts and daemon frames and a manual SMOKE_CHECKLIST.md. <!--#39b64562df331d7e|3adc9cf1ddd93047-->

### `tests/frontend/SMOKE_CHECKLIST.md` (markdown) — A manual smoke-test checklist for accepting the web console's full-screen running-flow chat view, walking through setup, layout, reply input, conversation/intervention rendering, progressive disclosure, CLI↔Web parity, targeted bugfix and regression checks, and a recorded automated-run results table. <!--#8b01cd448a920d43|d282cc8d28b6c66e-->
- `Running-Flow Chat View — Manual Smoke Checklist` (heading) — Top-level title and scope statement describing the full-screen chat view under test and which backend/static files trigger a re-run of this checklist. <!--#792347f5ecc19cd2-->
  - `Setup` (heading) — Step-by-step environment setup for the smoke pass: install server, start central server and daemon, launch a flow, and open the web console. <!--#54b20d62b22c8130-->
  - `Pure-function regression` (heading) — A single check that the pure-function interaction-view test suite reports zero failures before manual testing. <!--#27e8aaa7b1ed2f88-->
  - `Layout` (heading) — Checks that the running flow renders as a full-screen view with the conversation as the main scrollable column and no legacy drawer or context-free call modal. <!--#a7f59a53399f7006-->
  - `Reply input box` (heading) — Checks the always-present bottom reply box behavior: enabled textarea, Send as the gate, pending/no-pending placeholders, and the inline Interject (✎) button. <!--#43636e585cf618e6-->
  - `Conversation rendering` (heading) — Checks that assistant/intervention records render expanded while user/system template records collapse into one-line chips classified by structured role. <!--#5b9dc5aa14172c0b-->
  - `Three-tier progressive disclosure (message paradigm)` (heading) — Checks the B1 message paradigm's layered disclosure for user/assistant turns, paradigm-named step headers, and long-payload wrapping. <!--#658af6c353d97756-->
  - `Intervention items (one per kind, default-expanded & prominent)` (heading) — Checks that each intervention kind (call, interjection, retry_decision, cli_confirm) appears as a distinct, default-expanded, visually separate item. <!--#a11676c589c0c151-->
  - `Standards 1–5 CLI ↔ Web parity (G6 acceptance)` (heading) — Step-by-step parity checks pinning that the web flow view matches CLI Rich output across five standards, each backed by named automated tests. <!--#23530143e28feba2-->
  - `Bugfix smoke (actual-render acceptance)` (heading) — Actual-render acceptance checks for two bugfixes: shorter mobile folded tool-call cards and desktop replies showing exactly once without duplication. <!--#5b4ca3ce0e03018c-->
  - `Bugfix smoke (collectJsonRegions structural robustness)` (heading) — Checks that structured-step assistant turns with literal triple backticks inside JSON content still render as prose plus a structured card, not a raw json blob. <!--#fcec8c0ef74bcad3-->
  - `Regression` (heading) — Checks that the full pytest suite and both frontend JS test files pass before sign-off. <!--#cdfc2d0ee842253d-->
    - `Recorded automated results (2026-05-21)` (heading) — A recorded table of the last automated test run's pass/skip counts plus a note on pre-existing out-of-scope test_steps.py failures. <!--#6b3c940aa0ca3b76-->

### `tests/frontend/adjudicate_review.test.mjs` (text) — Dual-mode Node/browser-stub frontend test suite for the web console's `renderAdjudicateReview`, asserting that an ADJUDICATE confirm target renders its rationale panel, a baseline→adjudicated_description unified diff, and covered-surface justifications, while degrading gracefully on missing fields and rendering nothing for non-adjudicate or null targets — exported as `registerAdjudicateReviewTests(ctx)` for the shared harness and also runnable standalone. <!--#267a147d515f2131|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/agent_badge_live.test.mjs` (text) — A Node-stub frontend test module (Group G3) exporting registerAgentBadgeLiveTests() that drives the parent harness's app module to verify live accumulating-bubble agent/model badge behavior: the first streaming fragment with an agent_name shows a badge, a later model_name upgrades the same badge in place to "agent · model", agent rotation clears the stale model, and fragments lacking agent metadata render no badge. <!--#1e4c2bd75fbb98dd|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/confirm_chip.test.mjs` (text) — Dual-mode Node/browser-stub frontend test suite (exportable via `registerConfirmChipTests` or runnable standalone) verifying that the web console renders a `kind: 'confirm'` pending call as an explicit Approve/Reject chip with an optional note textarea, POSTs a structured `{response:{approved,feedback}}` decision, degrades kind-less legacy calls to the plain free-text box, and maps recognized approval/rejection words while gating unrecognized notes behind a confirmation prompt. <!--#3cc50b3c9e76eb18|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/discovery_analyze_scroll_anchor.test.mjs` (text) — A node-stub frontend test suite (issue #260, group G5) that pins the discovery→analyze boundary scroll-anchor fix: after a silent progression rebuild, a bottom-follower (intent flag true) sticks to the new bottom despite a frozen-DOM isNearBottom misjudge, while a genuinely scrolled-up reader (flag false) keeps their anchored bubble's viewport offset when the analyze label appends below. <!--#a101f9422df42083|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/end_session.test.mjs` (text) — DOM-free Node.js test module that exercises the pure End-session helper functions (isFlowEndable, isWorktreeSessionPath) exported from the server's static app.js, asserting which flow statuses/sources/worktree paths are endable. <!--#bec8f4a7142d43fc|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/marker_dedup_ordinal.test.mjs` (text) — A Node test module (registerMarkerDedupOrdinalTests, loaded by test_app_pure.mjs) pinning the WebUI console's ordinal-identity reconcile behaviour: recordKey is a content-independent `stepId#ordinal` (with legacy content-key fallback when no ordinal), empty-content marker records no longer collide, and reconcileAppendRecords treats identical re-deliveries as no-ops while updating retry rewrites of the same ordinal in place. <!--#b0f7577fb0aee27c|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

## `tests/server/` — Pytest package covering the SE3 web-console server surface: the `/api/history/{flow_id}` token+signature delivery protocol and its full/not_modified/delta state machine, `ServerState` history bundle integrity (cursor/`cursor_base` gap handling, head-truncation and self-heal recovery on paused worktree flows), the WebUI i18n locale manifest endpoint, and static frontend asset guardrails for app.js/style.css/index.html. <!--#51387953a7ea2628|133d1a2a59ea2284-->
