### `tests/server/test_history_cursor_base_coverage.py` (python) — Regression tests for the `ServerState` history cursor/`cursor_base` gap logic (issue #287), covering skipped blank lines, windows starting past the water mark, advanced files with no declared read window, overlapping re-sends, and an end-to-end run of the real `DaemonHistoryReader` feeding a real `ServerState`. <!--#7cf34f7bd85e4408|50bbe1cbe0cc187b-->
- `_record` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal discovery-step history record dict with the given ordinal and a matching assistant message. <!--#5d09d7ad027e7090-->
- `_running_flow` (function) — Async test helper that pushes a status update into `ServerState` declaring a single running flow `FLOW` on machine `MACHINE`, so history frames are accepted. <!--#4093ece5a797b1b4-->
- `_seed_bundle` (function) — Async test helper that seeds an authoritative history bundle via a `HISTORY_MODE_FULL` frame of *lines* records, establishing the step file's cursor water mark. <!--#5163c745e198ecb5-->
- `_append` (function) — Async test helper that applies a `HISTORY_MODE_APPEND` frame with explicit `cursor`/`cursor_base` and returns the resulting outcome. <!--#3cad69aa7d9b6928-->
- `test_append_that_skipped_a_line_is_contiguous_and_applies` (function) — Asserts an append whose declared window starts exactly at the water mark applies to the bundle even though its record count is short of the cursor advance (a skipped/blank line), and arms no recovery pull. <!--#14bf90375635296f-->
- `test_append_whose_window_starts_past_the_water_mark_is_still_a_gap` (function) — Asserts an append whose declared `cursor_base` starts past the water mark is rejected as a gap — neither records nor cursor are adopted — and arms a recovery pull. <!--#2debb764fbb24ec3-->
- `test_advanced_file_with_no_declared_window_is_a_gap` (function) — Asserts a frame that advances another step file's cursor without declaring a read window for it is judged a gap (the #287 root shape) rather than silently adopted. <!--#5768b386b9e2cf6b-->
- `test_overlapping_resend_window_still_applies` (function) — Asserts a window starting before the water mark is treated as a harmless re-send that still applies and arms no recovery pull. <!--#b723ac982be033ff-->
- `test_real_daemon_delta_over_a_blank_line_reaches_the_bundle` (function) — End-to-end test driving the real `DaemonHistoryReader` over a step file containing a mid-stream blank line and feeding its frames to a real `ServerState`, proving the cursor-vs-record-count mismatch no longer reads as a hole. <!--#5202d56236fa5a7e-->

### `tests/server/test_history_endpoint_signature.py` (python) — Integration/unit test suite for the `/api/history/{flow_id}` REST endpoint's token+signature delivery protocol, covering the full/not_modified/delta state machine, stale-token fallback, gzip size floor, full-pull throttling, and the paused-worktree self-heal reconcile (#287) with its ADD-only guarantee and blast-radius guards for non-worktree flows. <!--#8fe965a38b1a8212|2af5a86299627548-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture that builds an authenticated FastAPI app, logs in a TestClient, and yields the (client, app) pair for the endpoint tests. <!--#c78c8fc0ec5446bd-->
- `_seed_bundle` (function) — Test helper that connects a daemon over WebSocket, pushes a full history bundle for a flow, and polls the REST endpoint until that bundle is visible via the cache-hit path, returning the live daemon socket plus the first response. <!--#488fa951cec311a3-->
- `test_full_then_not_modified_then_delta` (function) — End-to-end test driving the history REST endpoint through its three delivery states — full (token+signature issued), not_modified (echoed token+sig), and delta (only the appended tail after the daemon adds a record). <!--#b1d101e5c8acc101-->
- `test_stale_token_falls_back_to_full` (function) — Test that a garbage/unvalidatable token+signature makes the endpoint fall back to a full rebuild carrying the complete bundle rather than a slice. <!--#24419869a9dd8a20-->
- `test_full_bundle_response_is_gzipped` (function) — Test that a full bundle exceeding the gzip size floor is served with Content-Encoding: gzip when the client accepts it. <!--#4708c6ab30265bd3-->
- `test_small_reply_is_not_gzipped` (function) — Test that a tiny not_modified reply stays below the gzip size floor and is left uncompressed. <!--#36d1b2a29ad69228-->
- `test_full_pull_throttle_rate_limits_repeated_misses` (function) — Async ServerState unit test verifying full_pull_throttled/mark_full_pull rate-limiting: a just-marked pull is throttled within the floor window, a zero window never throttles, and other flows are unaffected. <!--#af4149617b098746-->
- `_ReconcileDaemon` (class) — Test helper that impersonates a connected daemon over a real `/ws` WebSocket, serving `MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST` pulls from a background thread (so the server's self-heal reconcile can complete inside a blocking `TestClient.get`) while counting requests and letting tests dictate the reply payload. <!--#5ed72bd4e78a5707-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon.__init__` (method) — Opens an authenticated daemon WebSocket, consumes the WELCOME frame, and starts the daemon-side serving thread with an empty canned reply set and a zeroed request counter. <!--#095295df4a2a356e-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon._serve` (method) — Background loop that reads incoming frames and answers each `MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST` with a `HISTORY_MODE_FULL` data frame carrying the test-configured `reply_records`, bumping the request count. <!--#503798fbb3eec917-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon.push_full` (method) — Unprompted daemon push of a `HISTORY_MODE_FULL` history-data frame for the flow, simulating the live history broadcast. <!--#146c60cf9dd13410-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon.report_flow` (method) — Sends a status update registering the flow with a given status and project root, so the server sees it as worktree/non-worktree and running/paused. <!--#164efebd83cbec7f-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon.seed` (method) — Pushes records and polls `/api/history/{flow_id}` until the server-side cache serves them, returning the cached bundle (or failing if it never appears). <!--#9e18e83eb903ecf6-->
  - `_ReconcileDaemon.close` (method) — Stops the serving thread and closes the daemon WebSocket context. <!--#8425f1499b69c7eb-->
- `test_paused_worktree_reconcile_record_count_never_decreases` (function) — Regression test for #287 asserting the paused-worktree self-heal reconcile is ADD-only at the endpoint boundary: empty or truncated daemon replies must never be served as a `full` rebuild that blanks or shrinks the cached bundle, while a longer reply is still applied. <!--#97e4486b0146a653-->
- `test_non_worktree_flow_is_served_from_cache_without_any_daemon_pull` (function) — Blast-radius guard that a running non-worktree flow never triggers a `MSG_HISTORY_REQUEST` pull and keeps its ordinary `not_modified`/`full` cache-served delivery behaviour. <!--#2cb44ab26b2ea0b7-->
- `test_paused_non_worktree_flow_never_reconciles` (function) — Blast-radius guard that `paused` status alone does not open the self-heal gate: a paused non-worktree flow is still served purely from cache with zero daemon pulls. <!--#b94dc12019c7133c-->
- `test_signature_moves_with_record_count` (function) — Unit test that bundle_signature acts as a content-version stamp — stable for identical state but changing when the record count or generation changes. <!--#957941fed00fb82c-->
- `test_not_modified_requires_a_signature` (function) — State-level test that not_modified is opt-in: an echoed token with a matching signature yields not_modified, while the same token without a signature degrades to a backward-compatible empty delta. <!--#79e7169a88e59d49-->

### `tests/server/test_history_gap_recovery.py` (python) — Regression suite driving ServerState.apply_history_frame directly to lock the server's history bundle against head truncation: it asserts that an empty `full` frame on an active worktree flow with no cached bundle is rejected (arming exactly one self-heal recovery pull) while ordinary flows still accept genuinely empty fulls, that `append` frames whose per-step-file cursor does not continue the bundle's water mark are refused wholesale and healed by the following full, and that contiguous/overlapping appends still apply cleanly. <!--#ec6a4d361c2e6e24|8a22d8c656687575-->
- `_record` (function) — Test helper that builds one daemon history record for the fixed STEP_ID at a given physical line ordinal. <!--#bf5e26816bed4529-->
- `_cursor` (function) — Test helper that builds a single-step-file cursor dict mapping STEP_FILE to a line count. <!--#0201f7aa1442d0ca-->
- `_active_worktree_flow` (function) — Async helper that registers FLOW on MACHINE as a live `--worktree` discovery flow (project_root under se3/worktrees) with the given status, so the empty-full guard applies. <!--#8b424023c0964194-->
- `_ordinary_flow` (function) — Async helper that registers FLOW as a plain non-worktree flow (project_root `/repo`) with the given status, the control case where the guard must not apply. <!--#242a4277397d009f-->
- `_full` (function) — Async helper that pushes a `full` history frame with the given records and cursor into ServerState.apply_history_frame. <!--#67b4f78656d0b3ea-->
- `_append` (function) — Async helper that pushes an `append` history frame with the given records and cursor into ServerState.apply_history_frame. <!--#0ba4df01a12c5a76-->
- `test_empty_full_on_empty_cache_is_rejected_and_keeps_selfheal_armed` (function) — Asserts an empty `full` on an active worktree flow with no cached bundle is rejected (no bundle, no pull resolution), leaves the recovery pull armed exactly once, and that the daemon's next resolved full heals the flow. <!--#bd5e2ff4a51c1aa5-->
- `test_empty_full_on_ordinary_flow_still_establishes_a_bundle` (function) — Asserts the empty-full guard is scoped to active worktree flows: an ordinary/terminal flow's genuinely empty full is still cached as an empty bundle and resolves the pull. <!--#0e71f18efee1742b-->
- `test_gapped_append_on_existing_bundle_is_refused_and_heals` (function) — Asserts an append whose cursor jumps past the bundle's water mark is discarded whole (records and cursor untouched), arms exactly one recovery pull across repeated gapped frames, and is healed by the following full. <!--#85a72815a9aaff30-->
- `test_nonzero_start_append_on_empty_bundle_is_refused` (function) — Asserts a first append starting at a nonzero line on a legitimately empty bundle is refused rather than extending onto nothing, arming the recovery pull whose full reply then rebuilds the history from line 0. <!--#fa5ef75ce32d60dc-->
- `test_gap_in_any_one_file_refuses_the_whole_frame` (function) — Asserts per-step-file water marks are checked independently, so a frame contiguous on one step file but gapped on another is refused in its entirety and arms the recovery pull. <!--#a52829f50f29bbd2-->
- `test_contiguous_and_overlapping_appends_apply` (function) — Parametrized happy path: appends that continue or overlap the bundle's water mark are applied, resolve the pull, produce the expected ordinals, and arm no recovery pull. <!--#eaaf70e425926000-->
- `test_timeline_empty_full_then_appends_still_serves_a_complete_history` (function) — End-to-end regression of the observed live failure: an unresolved empty full followed by later appends leaves no bundle, the self-heal fires once, and the resolved full then serves every client the complete history from line 0 with the live stream resuming. <!--#f6f001d230cb6baf-->

### `tests/server/test_i18n_manifest.py` (python) — Test module covering the WebUI i18n language manifest: that GET /i18n/index.json is served unauthenticated with the shipped locales and their endonym labels, and that locale discovery picks up newly dropped locale files, skips malformed ones without failing, and falls back to the locale code when a dictionary lacks its own endonym. <!--#e2c55a4c21f2071b|d4f69fbb458c2644-->
- `client` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a FastAPI TestClient over an authenticated app instance for exercising the server's i18n manifest endpoint. <!--#70dfbef10d3a1b20-->
- `test_manifest_lists_the_shipped_languages_unauthenticated` (function) — Asserts GET /i18n/index.json is reachable without login and lists the shipped locales (en-US, zh-CN) with their endonym labels drawn from each dictionary's own lang.<code> entry. <!--#5a4e889eb159af68-->
- `test_a_new_locale_file_is_discovered_without_a_code_change` (function) — Verifies _discover_ui_languages() picks up any locale JSON dropped into the locales directory (e.g. a new fr-FR) with no code change, returning code/label pairs in sorted order. <!--#e0154532f83fbeb6-->
- `test_a_malformed_locale_file_is_skipped_not_fatal` (function) — Verifies an unparseable locale JSON file is silently skipped rather than raising, so discovery still returns the valid locales. <!--#0bfed6196ed4a788-->
- `test_a_locale_without_its_own_endonym_labels_itself` (function) — Verifies a locale dictionary lacking its own lang.<code> endonym falls back to using the locale code itself as the display label. <!--#b33ded6decdd61a0-->
